Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Role Overview

Klaviyo is consolidating its Australia and New Zealand sales business under a single country leader. This is a newly shaped role: one leader accountable for the entire ANZ number across both Commercial and Enterprise, based in Sydney, reporting to the APAC Managing Director.

ANZ is currently the region's largest team and market. We are looking for someone who has personally taken a sales and supporting functions organisation from good to great — and who can tell us exactly how, including the key decisions they made and when.

The role also carries the senior Klaviyo presence in the Australian market: partner and agency relationships, executive sponsorship on major customers, and site culture.

This is not a BAU mandate, if you want a business with real headroom, a strong front line already in place, and a mandate to build and fix what's needed to scale and win, this may be the right opportunity for you.

What You'll Do

Own the ANZ Number

  • Full accountability for ANZ revenue across Commercial and Enterprise
  • Lead front-line sales managers and their teams
  • Lead the sales organisation to deliver on the growth potential of the ANZ market. Own customer acquisition and growth, team culture, pipeline health and forecast across segments and route to market, and be able to deliver results and “know the score” in detail.

Diagnose and Fix Performance

  • Establish quickly and honestly whats needed for growth
  • Act on the diagnosis, including making decisions in the first 90 days
  • Raise the performance bar visibly, and hold it when it's uncomfortable
  • Remove obstacles and be able to roll up your sleeves and get into deals when necessary, building capability in the team as your core priority.
  • Distinguish between problems a leader can fix and problems that need a broader conversation — and escalate the second kind early

Build and Develop the Leadership Layer

  • Coach and develop front-line managers to be world class in their craft and inspire their creativity and results
  • Hire, develop and retain best-in-class sellers; create real career paths and succession depth
  • Set a high bar for talent and act on the gap between the bar and reality
  • Model Klaviyo's values in how you lead, especially when the pressure is on
  • Model our “win as one” cross functional spirit. Building trust and collaboration across the entire team.

Bring Operating Rigour

  • Install and hold weekly cadences — pipeline inspection, forecast, deal review, 1:1s — that are consistent enough that problems surface early
  • Use data as the primary instrument, combined with instinct. Know the score - distribution, coverage trend, tenure cohorts and win/loss reasons
  • Partner with Ops to strengthen the reporting and operating systems currently being built out
  • Drive a culture of being meticulous in your craft across the organisation
  • Put AI and automation as core capabilities of how the team works

Represent Klaviyo in ANZ

  • Senior Klaviyo presence in market: agency and partner relationships, events, and community engagement
  • Executive sponsorship on the region's most significant customers and deals
  • Own site culture in Sydney — the person the team looks to, and the person the market sees

Work Across the Business

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Partnerships, Business Development, Solution Engineering, Enablement, RevOps, Product and Customer Success to drive ANZ growth
  • Influence regional and global GTM strategy and investment decisions with evidence from the market
  • Collaborate with the Asia sales leaders as peers within one APAC business
  • Represent the APAC regions priorities as a senior member of the APAC Leadership team

Who You Are

Required

  • A demonstrated builder and fixer. You have personally taken a sales team or organisation through a performance step change. You can name what you diagnosed, what you changed, when, and what the numbers looked like before and after..
  • 8+ years leading sales teams, including leading leaders — managing front-line managers, not just ICs
  • Commercial-motion native. Deep fluency in velocity, cadence, activity discipline and ramp rigour. This business is majority Commercial; this role needs depth in the high velocity and capacity driven mechanics of the commercial/SMB segments.
  • Credible across both segments. You can lead an Enterprise deal review and coach a manager on it — MEDDPICC or an equivalent large account strategic sales methodology as well as a high velocity sales motion in the Commercial segment.
  • Sydney-based or genuinely relocating. In-market presence is a requirement of the role, leading from the front and building culture in our offices and rituals.
  • Data-led operator. Metrics drive your decisions and you can show which ones and why
  • Willing to make decisions with intentionality and to be accountable on having made them
  • Comfortable in collaboration. Our culture is intentionally about winning together. We invite inspection and deep collaboration both within the reporting lines and across functions. 
  • Strong SaaS sales economics — forecasting, pipeline management, segmentation, coverage
  • Proficient with Salesforce and a modern stack (Gong, Clay or similar) and deliberate about making these part of the everyday workflow.

Soft Skills

  • Clear, confident communicator with genuine executive presence — internally and in front of customers
  • Structured, analytical and decisive under pressure
  • High energy but calm under pressure. This business needs a bringer of energy with steadiness
  • High ownership over annual and quarterly planning
  • Curious, adaptable, biased toward action

Nice to Have

  • ANZ market depth — you know the retail and e-commerce landscape and the agency ecosystem
  • MarTech, e-commerce or PLG-adjacent experience
  • Experience in a business transitioning upmarket
  • Prior country-leader or site-leader scope

How Great Looks Like For This Role? 

We'll be direct about what we're testing

  • You've done the step change, not just watched one. A pattern of hitting the number, and at least one real turnaround with the specifics attached.
  • You diagnose from data. Not from the last conversation you had — and you can get a team aligned behind what you've found.
  • You build people up before you write them up. Deliberate development, underperformance coached before it's formalised, decisions that are right for the person and the business.
  • You run a cadence, not a vibe. Structured, evidence-led, and willing to change course when the evidence does.
  • You do the unglamorous work. No passengers, no ego.
  • You carry the room. In Sydney, and in the market.

Klaviyo Values

  • Put customers first — start with what's best for our customers and their customers, and work back from their biggest pain points
  • Win together — one team: honest, direct, respectful, inclusive; willing to disagree and commit
  • Know the score — clear on what success looks like and how it ladders up; results over activity
  • Be meticulous in your craft — rigorous, prepared, the expert others turn to
  • Move fast, no shortcuts — speed matters, but never at the cost of quality or ethics
  • Drivers wanted — no passengers: act like owners, fix what's broken, do the unglamorous work
  • Stay hungry, stay humble — curious, high-slope learners who seek feedback and don't tolerate brilliant jerks
  • We're 1% done — beginner's mindset, benchmarked against the best

Klaviyo in APAC

The Sydney team has been built out since 2022 across sales, CS, partnerships, marketing, recruiting and product support, with a growing Singapore presence. This is still an early-stage APAC business with significant headroom — a team established across the region today, and a leadership bench largely promoted from within.

You'd be joining at a genuinely formative moment: the country model for ANZ is new, the operating systems are being built now, and the person in this seat will shape how Klaviyo runs this market for years rather than inheriting someone else's design.

At Klaviyo, we value the different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives that each Klaviyo brings to work. If you are close, but not an exact match, we hope you will still apply.

About the team

Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls how people, services, integrations, and AI agents access Klaviyo.

We build authentication and authorization for users, agents, and machines that access the Klaviyo platform.

This is a chance to solve hard identity problems that affect nearly every part of our product.

How you will make an impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead complex projects across several components while staying hands-on with the software. You will:

  • Lead business-critical projects from design through launch and long-term operation.

  • Partner with Security, Product, Platform, and product engineering teams.
  • Create reusable patterns that make IAM easier and safer for other teams to adopt.
  • Mentor engineers and help project contributors succeed.
  • Apply new engineering and AI tools responsibly, then share what you learn with the team.
  • Take on important unowned work that helps the team move faster.

Who you are

  • You have hands-on experience developing production services in Go or Python.
  • You have experience with authentication, authorization, identity, or related security systems.
  • You have built networking systems, API gateways, APIs, or SDKs.
  • You have led complex projects that spanned multiple engineers and several months.
  • You take end-to-end ownership and stay with your work after launch.
  • You communicate clearly, work well across teams, and make practical technical decisions.
  • You mentor other engineers and raise the quality bar through feedback and example.
  • You balance long-term improvements with steady customer delivery.

Nice to have

  • Experience with auth or policy systems.
  • Experience building secure platforms used by other engineering teams.
  • Experience with AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, React, or Django.
  • Experience with enterprise security, auditability, data residency, or compliance needs.

You do not need to know every part of our stack on day one. We care most about strong judgment, ownership, and care for the customer experience.

descriptionHtml:

About the team and role:

Klaviyo's Treasury team manages the company's global cash, liquidity, insurance and foreign exchange (FX) risk so the business can operate and grow with confidence. As Lead Treasury Analyst, you'll take ownership of day-to-day global cash positioning and forecasting while building the FX, risk-management, and cross-functional skills needed to grow further into a Treasury career. This role is ideal for someone with a foundation in treasury or corporate finance who is eager to take the next step: you already know the fundamentals of cash management and forecasting, have basic exposure to FX concepts, and are ready to own more of the process and partner directly with banking, accounting, and FP&A stakeholders. This is a highly collaborative role — you'll work closely with the Treasury Director and cross-functional partners in an environment where ideas and perspectives are shared constantly, and strong interpersonal skills matter as much as technical ones.

How you'll make a difference:

The essential job duties for this role include:

  • Synthesize complex cash, forecasting, and FX data into clear, concise analysis and reporting for the Treasury Director and senior management, with confidence presenting findings and recommendations.
  • Monitor the company's FX exposure arising from international receivables, intercompany transactions, and foreign currency balances, and flag emerging risks.
  • Support the development and execution of FX hedging strategies in partnership with the Treasury Director, including trade execution and settlement tracking.
  • Prepare treasury reporting and KPIs (cash position, forecast accuracy, FX exposure, liquidity metrics) for senior leadership.
  • Own daily global cash positioning across multiple entities, currencies, and banking partners, ensuring accurate visibility into consolidated cash balances.
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve sophisticated short- and long-term cash flow forecasting and financial models to support liquidity planning and working capital decisions.
  • Initiate and review wire transfers, funds transfers, and intercompany settlements, ensuring appropriate controls and approvals are followed.
  • Manage bank account administration, including account opening/closing, signatory updates, KYC documentation, and banking fee analysis.
  • Monitor cash and investment balances for compliance with the corporate investment policy, and evaluate short-term investment options for excess cash.
  • Partner with Accounting on treasury-related reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close activities.
  • Identify and help implement process improvements and automation opportunities within the Trovata (the Treasury forecast system) and banking platforms.
  • Support external audit and bank requests as needed.
  • Collaborate closely and continuously with Accounting, FP&A, Tax, and Legal, actively contributing ideas and perspective in a highly collaborative team environment.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Who you are:

  • Very strong interpersonal and communication skills; genuinely enjoys a collaborative environment built on openly sharing thoughts and ideas.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, with the ability to independently build, stress-test, and explain cash flow models.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage global, multi-currency cash positions across several banking relationships.
  • Basic working knowledge of FX concepts (exposure, hedging, spot/forward transactions) and a genuine eagerness to deepen that expertise.
  • Confidence and skill in synthesizing complex data into clear insights, narratives, and recommendations for senior management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and data accuracy with assistance of AI.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • A self-starter mindset with the ambition and readiness to grow into a treasury management role.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while knowing when to escalate.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with CitiDirect and banking/FX platforms (e.g., FXAll) is a plus.
  • High intellectual curiosity and a bias toward improving and simplifying existing processes via AI.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 8+  years of progressive experience in treasury, corporate finance, or cash management, typically including time as a Treasury Analyst or Senior Treasury Analyst.
  • Experience with treasury management systems, ERP systems, and banking portals preferred.
  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) or progress toward the certification is a plus, but not required.

Klaviyo is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to add to our growing Detection & Response Team. This is an engineering role that spans the full detection and response lifecycle - leveraging software development practices to build detections, triaging alerts, lead investigations, respond to incidents, perform threat hunting, and build the tooling that keeps us from doing the same work twice. As a member of the team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex large-scale security challenges across Klaviyo’s enterprise, cloud, and product environments, and shape how an engineering-first D&R function uses automation and AI in production, at scale, alongside talented and ambitious colleagues spanning multiple regions and timezones.

How you will make a difference:

  • Leverage engineering practices to develop, test, and deploy high-fidelity rule-based and anomaly-based detections-as-code 
  • Detect and respond to cyber threats using security data lake, SIEM, and cloud platforms
  • Respond to alerts, cyber threats, and drive end-to-end incident response investigations
  • Perform digital forensic investigations to include collection and analysis of evidence   
  • Automate and codify detection and response workflows and processes
  • Build security tooling to drive automation across D&R lifecycle 
  • Improve and maintain detection and response pipelines and underlying systems
  • Work with our Threat Intelligence team to identify and respond to sophisticated threats
  • Develop AI-first security systems to automate detection and response operations 
  • Conduct threat hunts across corporate, cloud and product environments
  • Support data engineering workflows for core security data lake and SIEM platforms 
  • Be an active member of D&R on-call rotations
  • Coach and mentor security engineers within the detection & response team

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of hands-on security experience in modern cloud environments
  • Experience in triaging and responding to cyber threats
  • Experience in large-scale log analysis, incident response and/or digital forensics
  • Experience with centralized security data lakes and SIEM solutions
  • Hands-on experience in writing detections-as-code
  • Solid data querying skills (e.g. SQL, Splunk) 
  • Familiarity with large-scale data pipelines and data engineering techniques 
  • Proficient in programming languages to automate / build (e.g., Python, Go or similar)
  • Proven experience with git/GitHub and CI/CD automations 
  • Familiarity with tactics, techniques, and procedures used by threat actors
  • Experience being part of detection and response or incident response on-call 
  • Engineering-first and AI-first approach for all work performed
  • Strong passion for continuous learning and staying updated on evolving technology 
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Team player with a strong, self-managing work ethic

Location: Boston, Hybrid 3x per week

Reporting to: Senior Manager, GTM Incentive Compensation

About the Team

The GTM Incentive Compensation owns the design, governance, administration, and operational integrity of incentive compensation programs across Klaviyo’s go-to-market organization, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Experience, Partnerships, Finance, HR, and Business Systems.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Senior CS Compensation Analyst to support the administration and continuous improvement of incentive compensation programs for Klaviyo’s Customer Experience organization. This is a mid-level role, ideal for someone who wants to build deep expertise in compensation operations while developing broad exposure to sales operations, finance, and systems work.

You’ll specialize in Customer Experience compensation- owning plan design, crediting data logic, modeling expected commission expense, and inquiry resolution for that population- while also contributing to the incentive compensation process more broadly, including reporting, data integrity, and cross-functional projects that support the full GTM organization. This role requires strong analytical and modeling skills, comfort working in Salesforce and BI tools, and the communication skills to explain compensation outcomes clearly to plan participants and leaders alike.

How You’ll Make a Difference

Customer Experience Compensation Administration

  • Administer monthly/quarterly incentive compensation calculations for the Customer Experience organization, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of payouts
  • Apply crediting logic and plan rules consistently, flagging exceptions or edge cases for review
  • Maintain compensation plan documentation, quota/target records, and payee assignments for the CX population
  • Partner with CX leaders to answer plan questions and explain payout calculations

Ticket Resolution & Stakeholder Support

  • Serve as a first point of contact for compensation inquiries and disputes submitted via ticketing systems, researching and resolving issues within SLA
  • Investigate discrepancies by tracing transactions through Salesforce and underlying data sources
  • Escalate complex or policy-level questions to the Senior Manager with clear context and recommendations

Reporting, Analytics & Modeling

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau/Looker to track attainment, payouts, and plan performance
  • Write SQL queries to pull, validate, and reconcile compensation and transaction data
  • Support financial modeling and scenario analysis for plan design changes, budgeting, and accruals
  • Identify data quality issues and partner with Systems teams on fixes and process improvements

Cross-Functional Process Support

  • Support the broader Incentive Compensation team during planning cycles (plan rollouts, quota loading, documentation)
  • Partner with Systems and Finance teams on process improvements, automation, and audit/controls work
  • Contribute to team operating cadences and documentation standards that scale across all GTM functions, not just CX

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience in compensation, on either sales/revenue operations or finance teams.
  • SQL experience required; comfort querying and validating data from multiple sources
  • Experience working with Salesforce (or a comparable CRM), and compensation management tools
  • Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Tableau or Looker, and ETL tools (Python, Alteryx, etc.) preferred
  • Strong modeling skills (advanced Excel/Google Sheets); financial or compensation modeling experience a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain compensation logic clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills, with experience managing a queue or ticket volume a plus
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with CX leaders, Systems, Operations and Finance teams

You May Be a Good Fit If You

  • Enjoy solving problems that combine data, process, and people
  • Take ownership of your queue and follow through until issues are fully resolved
  • Are curious about how compensation design connects to business behavior
  • Want to grow your career in compensation, revenue operations, or GTM strategy
  • Communicate clearly and build trust with stakeholders at all levels

We’re looking for a versatile Product Marketing Lead—a true Swiss Army knife—to join our K:Marketing PMM team. Mobile communication—spanning SMS, MMS, push notifications, and emerging channels—is no longer an add-on; it is a foundational pillar of modern omnichannel commerce and a top priority driving revenue growth across our entire customer base.

descriptionHtml:

Why You Should Join the Developer Infrastructure Team

Our core focus is empowering engineers to ship code efficiently and safely. We own the CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation that drastically improves developer productivity. As the Lead for this team, you will define the technical roadmap for the software pipeline from idea to delivery, enabling every engineer in the company to ship at terminal velocity with total confidence. By building the foundational tools that streamline the path to production, you will play a pivotal role in maximizing developer throughput, minimizing deployment friction, and ensuring our organization can move fast without the fear of breaking things.

What You'll Achieve: Key Responsibilities

As the technical leader for this team, you will drive the evolution of our CI/CD pipeline to enable fast, seamless development and deployments across the organization:

  • Define Architectural Vision: Lead the long-term strategy for our CI/CD pipelines and frameworks across both backend and frontend stacks. You will ensure these systems are not just reliable, but world-class in their ease of adoption.
  • CI/CD Strategy: Architect how we execute fast, reliable deployments and rollbacks. You will own the end-to-end delivery pipelines, ensuring the highest standards of security, efficiency, and compliance from code commit to production.
  • Set Engineering Standards: Establish the standards for our repositories. You will define the benchmarks for PRs, cycle time, velocity, code quality metrics, and systemic reliability that all teams will follow.
  • Scalable Tooling & Coverage: Design and build the next generation of tools that simplify CI/CD pipelines. You will lead efforts to help bring all teams and repos up to best in class standards at scale .
  • AI-Driven Strategy: Spearhead our efforts to leverage AI within the CI/CD lifecycle as well as using AI to accelerate our own development efforts. 
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a consultant to feature teams to solve their most complex engineering challenges. You will use root-cause analysis from major incidents to propose and implement pillar-wide velocity improvements.
  • Operational Excellence: Oversee the health and performance of our entire CI/CD pipeline, taking ultimate responsibility for the stability of the environment that hundreds of engineers rely on daily.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • High-Leverage Leadership: You are not just building features; you are building the platform that defines the developer experience for the entire company.
  • Innovation at the Edge: You will have the autonomy to experiment with emerging technologies like AI and LLMs to solve the age-old problems of flakiness and slow feedback loops.
  • Pillar-Wide Influence: As a Lead, your decisions on testing standards and infrastructure will directly impact the speed and quality of every shipping team in the organization.

Who You Are: 

  • Seasoned Technical Leader: You have 7+ years of software engineering experience with a history of leading complex, high-impact technical projects. You are a hands-on lead who stays close to the code while steering the broader vision.
  • Master of Root-Cause Analysis: You don't just fix symptoms; you hunt down systemic failures. You excel at debugging deep-stack issues and transforming those lessons into automated preventions.
  • Full-Stack Architect: You are comfortable designing systems across the stack. Whether it is a React-based quality dashboard or a Python service for data seeding, you understand how to build for scale.
  • AI Visionary: You are passionate about the intersection of AI and Software Quality. You have a clear perspective on how AI can automate the mundane parts of testing and accelerate the SDLC.
  • You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.
  • Extreme Ownership: You take pride in the end-to-end health of the platform. You are proactive in identifying technical debt and are a relentless advocate for engineering excellence.
  • CI/CD Expert: You have deep experience with modern CI/CD tools and a sophisticated understanding of how to integrate automated testing into high-frequency deployment pipelines.

Technologies we use (not exhaustive):

  • Backend: Python, Django, Go
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript
  • Testing Frameworks: Playwright, Cypress, Pytest, Jest
  • Infrastructure and CI: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Buildkite
  • Data: MySQL, Redis, Kafka
  • AI Tools: Integration with Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or internal AI enablement frameworks

descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.

About the team:

Klaviyo’s global corporate Information Technology (IT) team is responsible for providing technology systems, administration, and support to Klaviyos around the world. Our main goal is to ensure that Klaviyos everywhere have a strong technology foundation to do great work. The IT Team solves problems using technology and provides Klaviyo’s continued scalability and sustainable employee growth in a rapidly evolving environment.

The IT Systems team is primarily responsible for SaaS systems administration and end-to-end lifecycle management, building automation, and engineering solutions for both other internal teams and the business. The IT Systems team is highly collaborative, working closely with the IT Searchbar team, our end-user support team as well as with our Security, Risk, and Trust teams and the broader Engineering department. 

About the role:

As a Senior IT Systems Engineer on the IT Systems team, you own the design, implementation, and long-term health of the enterprise systems Klaviyo runs on identity, endpoint management, and the SaaS platforms every Klaviyo touches. You will lead projects end to end, from SSO/SCIM rollouts to complex multi-tool integrations and automations, and you will be trusted to take an ambiguous business problem, define the problem statement yourself, and deliver a solution that scales. You will partner with operations, engineering, Security, and the IT Searchbar team, and act as a technical escalation point when systems break.

Klaviyo is building an AI-first future, and IT is where a lot of that gets real. You will use AI fluently in your own work and help design AI-assisted workflows into the systems we run for the rest of the company. This is a senior individual contributor role: no direct reports, high autonomy, and real ownership. We are looking for someone who has already run systems at scale, holds opinions grounded in experience, and can be handed a domain and trusted to run it.

How you’ll have an impact

  • Own systems, not tickets. You will take a domain identity, endpoint, or a set of core SaaS platforms and be accountable for its reliability, security, and roadmap, raising the decisions that need to go higher and driving everything else yourself.
  • Lead projects end to end at pace: scope the work, design the solution, plan the rollout and the rollback, communicate the change, and land it without skipping testing, peer review, or documentation to hit a date.
  • Turn ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements and systems that hold up, so Klaviyos spend their time on their work instead of fighting their tools.
  • Set the technical bar: clean configuration, least-privilege access by default, automation over manual toil, and runbooks the rest of the team can operate from without you in the room.
  • Define what success looks like before you build, then prove it with data tickets deflected, provisioning time saved, coverage and compliance gaps closed.
  • Raise the people around you: review others’ work, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and give and receive direct, useful feedback.
  • Act as a technical escalation point for complex system issues, drive root cause rather than symptoms, and feed what you learn back into the platform so the same incident does not happen twice.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience as a systems engineer or systems administrator, with a track record of owning enterprise systems in production not just operating them, but deciding how they should work.
  • You define problem statements yourself. You can take a vague or contested business need, scope it, drive alignment with stakeholders, and deliver with minimal direction without losing the thread when priorities shift.
  • Deep working knowledge across a wide range of IT systems, including enterprise device management, identity and access management, and endpoint security.
  • You have deployed and managed macOS and iOS devices at scale through an MDM (Jamf preferred), including configuration profiles, policies, and OS update strategy. Windows management (Intune, Autopilot) is a strong plus.
  • You have administered core SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and Zoom, including their security and admin controls.
  • Hands-on experience with IdP configuration, management, and maintenance: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group and role design, and app onboarding. Experience with Okta or Entra ID (Azure AD) is preferred.
  • You have owned the identity lifecycle in practice onboarding, role changes, and offboarding and understand the security and audit consequences of getting it wrong.
  • AI proficiency: AI is already part of how you work, and you can show it. You use LLM assistants and agents to research, write and debug code, draft documentation, and compress routine work, and you exercise judgment about when to trust the output. You are actively interested in putting AI into the systems you run automating triage, enrichment, and repetitive workflows for the wider company.
  • You automate by default, and you have the scripting skills to do it: Bash, PowerShell, or Python. Python is preferred and AWS Lambda experience is a plus. You have replaced manual, repetitive work with automation other people now rely on, and you can safely read and modify someone else’s script.
  • Comfortable working with APIs REST, JSON, authentication, and rate limits and building integrations between systems that do not natively talk to each other.
  • You value clean, concise controls and easily editable security functionality within tools, and you can produce evidence for access reviews and audits (SOC 2, SOX) without it derailing your week.
  • Disciplined change management: you test, get peer review, plan rollback, communicate to affected users, and document what changed including under pressure.
  • You can debug a system problem you have never seen before, drive it to the root cause, and communicate clearly to non-technical stakeholders while it is still unresolved.
  • You can evaluate vendors and tools on their merits: security posture, integration surface, total cost and make a defensible recommendation.
  • Strong written communication. Your documentation, runbooks, and change notices are good enough that other people can act on them without asking you.
  • Participation in an after-hours on-call rotation with the IT Systems team is required for site-specific or business-blocking issues.

Nice to have

  • You have worked with Workato, Okta Workflows, n8n, or other similar SSO and automation solutions, and have built something non-trivial in one.
  • Experience with enterprise-scale networking topics, including routing, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and building and maintaining multiple global office networks.
  • Experience as a systems administrator or systems engineer in a fast-paced, high-growth IT environment, ideally supporting a globally distributed workforce.
  • Experience building with AI beyond the chat window prompt and context engineering, connecting an LLM to systems via APIs or MCP, or running an AI-assisted workflow or agent in production.
  • Experience with VPC, EC2, Security Groups, ACLs, and IAM in AWS and GCP.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) or version-controlled configuration management for IT systems.
  • Experience administering an ITSM platform such as Freshservice or Jira Service Management, including forms, workflows, SLAs, and reporting.
  • Relevant certifications such as Jamf 200/300, Okta Certified Professional or Administrator, or associate-level AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Klaviyo is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to add to our growing Detection & Response Team. This is an engineering role that spans the full detection and response lifecycle - leveraging software development practices to build detections, triaging alerts, lead investigations, respond to incidents, perform threat hunting, and build the tooling that keeps us from doing the same work twice. As a member of the team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex large-scale security challenges across Klaviyo’s enterprise, cloud, and product environments, and shape how an engineering-first D&R function uses automation and AI in production, at scale, alongside talented and ambitious colleagues spanning multiple regions and timezones.

How you will make a difference:

  • Leverage engineering practices to develop, test, and deploy high-fidelity rule-based and anomaly-based detections-as-code 
  • Detect and respond to cyber threats using security data lake, SIEM, and cloud platforms
  • Respond to alerts, cyber threats, and drive end-to-end incident response investigations
  • Perform digital forensic investigations to include collection and analysis of evidence   
  • Automate and codify detection and response workflows and processes
  • Build security tooling to drive automation across D&R lifecycle 
  • Improve and maintain detection and response pipelines and underlying systems
  • Work with our Threat Intelligence team to identify and respond to sophisticated threats
  • Develop AI-first security systems to automate detection and response operations 
  • Conduct threat hunts across corporate, cloud and product environments
  • Support data engineering workflows for core security data lake and SIEM platforms 
  • Be an active member of D&R on-call rotations
  • Coach and mentor security engineers within the detection & response team

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of hands-on security experience in modern cloud environments
  • Experience in triaging and responding to cyber threats
  • Experience in large-scale log analysis, incident response and/or digital forensics
  • Experience with centralized security data lakes and SIEM solutions
  • Hands-on experience in writing detections-as-code
  • Solid data querying skills (e.g. SQL, Splunk) 
  • Familiarity with large-scale data pipelines and data engineering techniques 
  • Proficient in programming languages to automate / build (e.g., Python, Go or similar)
  • Proven experience with git/GitHub and CI/CD automations 
  • Familiarity with tactics, techniques, and procedures used by threat actors
  • Experience being part of detection and response or incident response on-call 
  • Engineering-first and AI-first approach for all work performed
  • Strong passion for continuous learning and staying updated on evolving technology 
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Team player with a strong, self-managing work ethic

Klaviyo is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to add to our growing Detection & Response Team. This is an engineering role that spans the full detection and response lifecycle - leveraging software development practices to build detections, triaging alerts, lead investigations, respond to incidents, perform threat hunting, and build the tooling that keeps us from doing the same work twice. As a member of the team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex large-scale security challenges across Klaviyo’s enterprise, cloud, and product environments, and shape how an engineering-first D&R function uses automation and AI in production, at scale, alongside talented and ambitious colleagues spanning multiple regions and timezones.

How you will make a difference:

descriptionHtml:

About the team:

Klaviyo’s global corporate Information Technology (IT) team is responsible for providing technology systems, administration, and support to Klaviyos around the world. Our main goal is to ensure that Klaviyos everywhere have a strong technology foundation to do great work. The IT Team solves problems using technology and provides Klaviyo’s continued scalability and sustainable employee growth in a rapidly evolving environment.

The IT Systems team is primarily responsible for SaaS systems administration and end-to-end lifecycle management, building automation, and engineering solutions for both other internal teams and the business. The IT Systems team is highly collaborative, working closely with the IT Searchbar team, our end-user support team as well as with our Security, Risk, and Trust teams and the broader Engineering department. 

About the role:

As a Senior IT Systems Engineer on the IT Systems team, you own the design, implementation, and long-term health of the enterprise systems Klaviyo runs on identity, endpoint management, and the SaaS platforms every Klaviyo touches. You will lead projects end to end, from SSO/SCIM rollouts to complex multi-tool integrations and automations, and you will be trusted to take an ambiguous business problem, define the problem statement yourself, and deliver a solution that scales. You will partner with operations, engineering, Security, and the IT Searchbar team, and act as a technical escalation point when systems break.

Klaviyo is building an AI-first future, and IT is where a lot of that gets real. You will use AI fluently in your own work and help design AI-assisted workflows into the systems we run for the rest of the company. This is a senior individual contributor role: no direct reports, high autonomy, and real ownership. We are looking for someone who has already run systems at scale, holds opinions grounded in experience, and can be handed a domain and trusted to run it.

How you’ll have an impact

  • Own systems, not tickets. You will take a domain identity, endpoint, or a set of core SaaS platforms and be accountable for its reliability, security, and roadmap, raising the decisions that need to go higher and driving everything else yourself.
  • Lead projects end to end at pace: scope the work, design the solution, plan the rollout and the rollback, communicate the change, and land it without skipping testing, peer review, or documentation to hit a date.
  • Turn ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements and systems that hold up, so Klaviyos spend their time on their work instead of fighting their tools.
  • Set the technical bar: clean configuration, least-privilege access by default, automation over manual toil, and runbooks the rest of the team can operate from without you in the room.
  • Define what success looks like before you build, then prove it with data tickets deflected, provisioning time saved, coverage and compliance gaps closed.
  • Raise the people around you: review others’ work, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and give and receive direct, useful feedback.
  • Act as a technical escalation point for complex system issues, drive root cause rather than symptoms, and feed what you learn back into the platform so the same incident does not happen twice.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience as a systems engineer or systems administrator, with a track record of owning enterprise systems in production not just operating them, but deciding how they should work.
  • You define problem statements yourself. You can take a vague or contested business need, scope it, drive alignment with stakeholders, and deliver with minimal direction without losing the thread when priorities shift.
  • Deep working knowledge across a wide range of IT systems, including enterprise device management, identity and access management, and endpoint security.
  • You have deployed and managed macOS and iOS devices at scale through an MDM (Jamf preferred), including configuration profiles, policies, and OS update strategy. Windows management (Intune, Autopilot) is a strong plus.
  • You have administered core SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and Zoom, including their security and admin controls.
  • Hands-on experience with IdP configuration, management, and maintenance: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group and role design, and app onboarding. Experience with Okta or Entra ID (Azure AD) is preferred.
  • You have owned the identity lifecycle in practice onboarding, role changes, and offboarding and understand the security and audit consequences of getting it wrong.
  • AI proficiency: AI is already part of how you work, and you can show it. You use LLM assistants and agents to research, write and debug code, draft documentation, and compress routine work, and you exercise judgment about when to trust the output. You are actively interested in putting AI into the systems you run automating triage, enrichment, and repetitive workflows for the wider company.
  • You automate by default, and you have the scripting skills to do it: Bash, PowerShell, or Python. Python is preferred and AWS Lambda experience is a plus. You have replaced manual, repetitive work with automation other people now rely on, and you can safely read and modify someone else’s script.
  • Comfortable working with APIs REST, JSON, authentication, and rate limits and building integrations between systems that do not natively talk to each other.
  • You value clean, concise controls and easily editable security functionality within tools, and you can produce evidence for access reviews and audits (SOC 2, SOX) without it derailing your week.
  • Disciplined change management: you test, get peer review, plan rollback, communicate to affected users, and document what changed including under pressure.
  • You can debug a system problem you have never seen before, drive it to the root cause, and communicate clearly to non-technical stakeholders while it is still unresolved.
  • You can evaluate vendors and tools on their merits: security posture, integration surface, total cost and make a defensible recommendation.
  • Strong written communication. Your documentation, runbooks, and change notices are good enough that other people can act on them without asking you.
  • Participation in an after-hours on-call rotation with the IT Systems team is required for site-specific or business-blocking issues.

Nice to have

  • You have worked with Workato, Okta Workflows, n8n, or other similar SSO and automation solutions, and have built something non-trivial in one.
  • Experience with enterprise-scale networking topics, including routing, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and building and maintaining multiple global office networks.
  • Experience as a systems administrator or systems engineer in a fast-paced, high-growth IT environment, ideally supporting a globally distributed workforce.
  • Experience building with AI beyond the chat window prompt and context engineering, connecting an LLM to systems via APIs or MCP, or running an AI-assisted workflow or agent in production.
  • Experience with VPC, EC2, Security Groups, ACLs, and IAM in AWS and GCP.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) or version-controlled configuration management for IT systems.
  • Experience administering an ITSM platform such as Freshservice or Jira Service Management, including forms, workflows, SLAs, and reporting.
  • Relevant certifications such as Jamf 200/300, Okta Certified Professional or Administrator, or associate-level AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

title: Senior Lead Technical Program Manager - Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. Klaviyo's infrastructure is the foundation that every product, every customer, and every engineer depends on. In this role you will be the connective tissue between our Infrastructure organization and the rest of engineering, driving the rollout of critical, cross-cutting programs that affect how we build, operate, and secure our platform at scale.

You will juggle a high volume of parallel efforts across cloud infrastructure, FinOps, build systems, software migrations, security operations, and more, keeping each moving, supporting teams to be successful, and escalating quickly when capacity or priority decisions need to be made. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. It's a role for someone who drives.

How you'll make a difference

  • Own the rollout of infrastructure initiatives across engineering. Drive programs from planning through completion, coordinating across teams that don't report to you and don't always have capacity to prioritize infrastructure work. Keep things moving.
  • Manage a high volume of concurrent efforts. At any given time you'll be tracking security operations improvements, FinOps initiatives, build system changes, software migrations, and other cross-cutting infrastructure programs simultaneously. Clear prioritization and status visibility are non-negotiable.
  • Hold teams accountable and escalate when needed. You know how to build the relationships and create the visibility that keeps infrastructure work from getting deprioritized. When a team genuinely lacks capacity, you surface that quickly, bring the right people into the conversation, and get a trade-off decision made — not absorb the delay quietly.
  • Develop a way to provide program health continuously. Establish and maintain clear, actionable reporting on the status of all infrastructure rollouts. Leadership should always know what's on track, what's at risk, and what decisions are needed from them.
  • Partner with Infrastructure leadership on planning and prioritization. Work closely with engineering and SRE leadership to build and maintain a rolling roadmap, sequence work across teams, and ensure infrastructure investments align with engineering and business priorities.
  • Define clear ways of working across teams. Create frameworks, templates, and coordination models that make it easier for infrastructure and product engineering teams to work together effectively. Build the playbook as you go.
  • Develop deep technical fluency in the programs you own. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being built, why it matters, and what the technical risks are well enough to ask the right questions, identify blockers early, and represent the work credibly to engineering leadership.
  • Drive automation and operational excellence. Challenge manual processes wherever you find them. Partner with infrastructure teams to identify opportunities to centralize and automate change rather than default to simply assigning out the same work to different teams.

Who you are

  • Technically fluent. You've worked closely with infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering teams. You understand security operations, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and software migrations well enough to engage substantively, not just track status.
  • A driver, not a facilitator. You move work forward. You follow up, push back, escalate, and hold people accountable, constructively, but consistently. You don't wait for the next meeting to surface a problem.
  • Influential and relationship-driven. You know that infrastructure work gets done through trust, not authority. You build strong relationships across engineering teams, understand what motivates different stakeholders, and use that context to create alignment
  • AI-first in how you work. You don't just talk about AI, you use it daily to move faster, work smarter, and do more with less. You bring that mindset to the teams you work with and actively look for opportunities to automate, accelerate, and improve how programs are run.
  • Comfortable with high volume and ambiguity. You can manage many parallel workstreams without losing track of any of them, and you don't need a clean problem statement to get started.
  • Clear and direct communicator. You tailor your message by audience, engineering teams need different information than engineering VPs, and you make it easy for leadership to understand status and make decisions quickly.
  • Outcome-oriented. You measure success by realizing the impact and what improves, not by the quality of your tracking.

Preferred experience (guidance, not gates)

  • 8+ years of experience in technical program management within a fast-paced product engineering environment, ideally SaaS or high-growth tech.
  • Demonstrated experience driving large-scale infrastructure rollouts across multiple engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, FinOps, security operations, and software migration programs.
  • Strong fluency in tools such as Jira, Linear, Asana, or Smartsheet.
  • Track record of managing competing priorities and delivering results without direct authority over engineering teams.

Nice to haves

  • Experience in both infrastructure and product engineering contexts.
  • Familiarity with FinOps frameworks and cloud cost optimization programs.
  • Experience building or evolving TPM practices in a nascent or growing function.
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling, build systems, or security compliance frameworks.

We're past the demo stage: the team ships changes against live customer traffic, measures quality with real evaluation frameworks, and treats reliability as a product feature, not an afterthought.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll set the technical and product direction for a core area of Customer Agent end to end, building a 0-to-1 agentic product with the speed and ownership of a startup, backed by the scale and resources of one of the most innovative tech companies on the East Coast, while staying hands-on with the hardest problems yourself. We're looking for an engineer who owns complex, ambiguous problems, who has built, scaled, and supported a production agentic system through everything that comes after the demo, and who up-levels the people, process, and technology around them.

  • Set the technical and product direction for a core area of Customer Agent, from architecture through production, and contribute to the direction of the platform overall.
  • Take on the hardest technical problems in your area: orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, memory & context, failure handling for non-deterministic systems.
  • Write and ship code, review designs, and make the hard calls in your area when there’s no obvious right answer.
  • Define patterns that other engineers adopt, and mentor through design reviews rather than direct management.
  • Partner with product, design, data science, and go-to-market leaders to shape what gets built, not just how it’s built.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and bring the ones worth betting on into production.

What We're Looking For:

  • You've built, scaled, and supported production agentic systems, not just prototyped them: real orchestration, evals, guardrails, and non-deterministic failure handling. You've owned your part of one through launch, incidents, and the operational reality after the demo.
  • You've learned the hard lessons that only come from running agents in production: securing them against misuse and abuse, and the operational scar tissue of keeping a non-deterministic system reliable as usage grows.
  • You've owned technical and product direction for a significant area before, not just your own component, and you can point to something you designed and championed that shipped and that other engineers built on.
  • You're hands-on: writing code, reviewing your own and others’ architecture decisions, and debugging production issues yourself, not delegating the hardest problems away.
  • Your patterns and designs are reused by other engineers, and you've unblocked many others’ projects, not just your own.
  • You communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly across engineering and product audiences, and you can turn an undefined problem into a plan others rally behind.

  • Experience working on a multi-tenant agent platform at production scale, where external customers configure their own agent behavior on shared infrastructure.

descriptionHtml:

Lead Engineer, Applied AI (Customer Agent)

About the Team:

Our Engineering team builds the AI systems that power how brands run their businesses on Klaviyo. We move fast, ship in production, and hold a high bar for what "AI-native" actually means: systems that make real judgment calls, not demos.

The Customer Agent team is one of the newest and most ambitious groups in that org, based in Boston and working in-office: we're building a conversational AI system that lets brands serve their own customers at a scale no human support team could match. We're still small enough that one engineer’s work visibly shapes how the whole platform evolves. We're past the demo stage: the team ships changes against live customer traffic, measures quality with real evaluation frameworks, and treats reliability as a product feature, not an afterthought.

About the Role:

As Lead Engineer, you'll set the technical and product direction for a core area of Customer Agent end to end, building a 0-to-1 agentic product with the speed and ownership of a startup, backed by the scale and resources of one of the most innovative tech companies on the East Coast, while staying hands-on with the hardest problems yourself. This is a lead role, with a wide footprint across our agentic product - from orchestration to governance - that grows based on where the product is when you join. We're looking for an engineer who owns complex, ambiguous problems, who has built, scaled, and supported a production agentic system through everything that comes after the demo, and who up-levels the people, process, and technology around them.

How You'll Make an Impact:

  • Set the technical and product direction for a core area of Customer Agent, from architecture through production, and contribute to the direction of the platform overall.
  • Take on the hardest technical problems in your area: orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, memory & context, failure handling for non-deterministic systems.
  • Write and ship code, review designs, and make the hard calls in your area when there’s no obvious right answer.
  • Define patterns that other engineers adopt, and mentor through design reviews rather than direct management.
  • Partner with product, design, data science, and go-to-market leaders to shape what gets built, not just how it’s built.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and bring the ones worth betting on into production.

What We're Looking For:

  • You've built, scaled, and supported production agentic systems, not just prototyped them: real orchestration, evals, guardrails, and non-deterministic failure handling. You've owned your part of one through launch, incidents, and the operational reality after the demo.
  • You've learned the hard lessons that only come from running agents in production: securing them against misuse and abuse, and the operational scar tissue of keeping a non-deterministic system reliable as usage grows.
  • You've owned technical and product direction for a significant area before, not just your own component, and you can point to something you designed and championed that shipped and that other engineers built on.
  • You're hands-on: writing code, reviewing your own and others’ architecture decisions, and debugging production issues yourself, not delegating the hardest problems away.
  • Your patterns and designs are reused by other engineers, and you've unblocked many others’ projects, not just your own.
  • You communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly across engineering and product audiences, and you can turn an undefined problem into a plan others rally behind.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working on a multi-tenant agent platform at production scale, where external customers configure their own agent behavior on shared infrastructure.
  • Experience building 0-to-1 products or working in startup environments.
  • A track record with production evaluation systems, AI observability, or human-in-the-loop workflows for LLM-powered products.

At Klaviyo, we're on a mission to empower creators to own their destiny. Our AI-first B2C CRM platform empowers 176,000+ brands in 80+ countries to cultivate relationships with hundreds of millions of consumers. We love solving hard problems and look for people who specialize in certain areas while being passionate about building, owning, and scaling solutions end-to-end, overcoming any obstacle in their way. We are a team of ambitious, customer-obsessed peers who are insatiably curious and meticulous in our craft. We push each other to grow beyond our comfort zone, learn new things, and work hard to ensure each day is better than the last.

As a Lead Security Trust & Compliance Engineer at Klaviyo, you'll be the primary owner of two or more of our Trust & Compliance programs — compliance operations & audits, continuous control monitoring, security policies & standards, security education & awareness, and customer trust operations among them. You'll set the strategy for the programs you own, run our audits end to end, engineer the controls and evidence pipelines that make them sustainable, and raise the technical bar for the practitioners around you. You won't have direct reports, but you will tactically lead the team on your programs: delegating work, setting teammates up to succeed, and mentoring analysts on their technical growth and career goals. This is your opportunity to take a leading role in cybersecurity, applying and deepening your expertise in security automation, risk analysis, control design, audit management, modern SaaS platform architectures, and many domains of information security (just about all of them!)

What you'll be doing

  • Own internal and external audits and examinations end to end from scoping and readiness through fieldwork and evidence delivery; act as our primary point of contact for auditors and assessors, and develop action plans to correct findings and exceptions
  • Identify gaps against frameworks we do not yet meet, define the strategy to close them, and drive the implementation when Klaviyo takes on a new certification or regulation
  • Own security policies and standards end to end — author and maintain the policy, standard, and procedure hierarchy, decompose standards into testable requirements mapped to frameworks, and run the review, ratification, and exception management
  • Determine control design and implementation details for net-new controls, provide technical guidance to partner teams on control design best practices, and diagnose deficiencies by reviewing system configurations, technical documentation, security tool data, and occasionally application code
  • Define control health metrics and build the pipelines behind them from the systems we already run, so control health is a live signal rather than a quarterly assertion
  • Automate and streamline our Security Trust & Compliance workflows — control testing, continuous control monitoring, evidence collection, identity governance, and security Q&As for employees and customers — with a penchant for creating excellent self-service experiences, and define new approaches, systems, and tools for the team where none exist yet
  • Proactively identify internal and external risks and opportunities relevant to our Trust & Compliance programs, and propose the plans to address them

We'd love to hear from you if you have most of the following:

  • In-depth understanding of multiple security and privacy frameworks — such as NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Critical Security Controls, CSA STAR, ISO 27001, ISO 27002, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, SOX ITGCs, GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA — including the ability to identify gaps against a framework that is new to the organization, define the strategy, and execute the implementation
  • A track record of personally owning security and privacy compliance audit programs end to end, including acting as the primary interface to internal and external auditors through scoping, walkthroughs, and findings resolution
  • Experience writing policies and standards that are precise enough to test and clear enough for engineers to follow, including ownership of the review and exception processes around them
  • Deep experience designing, assessing, and continuously monitoring modern security and privacy controls, including determining control design for net-new controls and diagnosing deficiencies from system configurations, technical documentation, security tool data, and application code
  • Experience with GRC engineering and security automation in general, especially applying AI and automation to eliminate toil
  • Knowledge of various enterprise SaaS applications, cloud infrastructure such as AWS and Kubernetes, modern software engineering practices/tools, databases, operating systems, secure network design, and other technology relevant to cybersecurity
  • Experience owning programs against defined KPIs and SLAs, including setting quarterly strategy, planning the work, and reporting on progress
  • A track record of mentoring practitioners, delegating effectively, and driving technical direction without formal authority
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to form relationships with internal and external teams.

Bonus points if you have any of the following:

  • Familiarity with modern compliance automation or trust management platforms (Drata, Vanta, Anecdotes, HyperProof, etc.)
  • Experience with SQL, building tools with REST APIs, and Python
  • Infrastructure-as-code or policy-as-code experience (Terraform, OPA/Rego, Conftest)
  • Building with agentic AI tooling (MCP, agent skills, evals and guardrails) and/or governing AI controls against ISO 42001 or NIST AI RMF
  • Experience implementing Identity Governance tools and processes, such as for user access reviews (UARs) and just-in-time access (JITA)
  • Experience working in security operations, security engineering, and/or security architecture roles
  • Relevant certifications, such as CISA, CISSP, or CCSP

Everyone on our team needs to have the following:

  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
  • Solutions oriented mindset
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Working collaboratively inside and outside your direct team
  • Strong alignment with Klaviyo’s core values

We’re looking for a Marketing Operations Lead to own and optimize the systems, processes, and integrations that power our inbound and demand generation engine. This role sits at the intersection of Marketing and Sales and is responsible for ensuring top-of-funnel demand is captured, qualified, routed, and delivered to Sales with speed and accuracy.

This is a hands-on role focused on marketing automation, data flow, and funnel operations. You’ll work closely with Inbound Sales, Demand Generation, Web, Analytics, and Systems teams to improve lead quality, conversion, and velocity across product-led and sales-assisted motions. The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, and curious about how AI and automation can improve process speed, accuracy, and operational efficiency.

How You'll Make a Difference:

  • Act as the primary marketing operations partner to the Inbound Sales team, ensuring high-quality handoffs.
  • Own day-to-day configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of the marketing automation platform.
  • Build and maintain workflows, lifecycle automation, and event-based logic supporting inbound and product-led growth.
  • Own lead and PQL scoring models and routing logic to ensure fast, accurate delivery to the right sales teams.
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Web teams to capture and activate top-of-funnel signals (web, product, form, behavioral).
  • Support audience creation, segmentation, and funnel experimentation to improve conversion from first touch to sales-ready demand.
  • Monitor inbound funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve volume quality, speed, and efficiency.
  • Monitor handoff metrics (e.g., response time, acceptance rates) and drive continuous improvement.
  • Own core marketing system integrations with CRM and other GTM tools, ensuring data accuracy and sync health.
  • Manage a large and evolving marketing technology stack, including tool setup, integrations, permissions, troubleshooting, vendor coordination, and evaluation of new capabilities as needs evolve.
  • Experiment with automation and AI-powered capabilities to reduce manual work and improve process speed, accuracy, and scalability.

Who You Are:

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing operations or GTM operations supporting inbound, demand generation, or PLG motions in a B2B environment.
  • Hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms, including workflows, lifecycle stages, scoring, and routing.
  • Strong working knowledge of CRM concepts (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities) and how data flows across GTM systems.
  • Comfortable working with funnel and handoff metrics (e.g., conversion rates, response time, acceptance rates) to drive operational improvements.
  • Curious and practical about AI and automation, with experience testing ways to improve process speed, accuracy, or scale.
  • Highly organized, execution-focused, and comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments while owning outcomes end to end.

descriptionHtml:

At Klaviyo, we're on a mission to empower creators to own their destiny. Our AI-first B2C CRM platform empowers 176,000+ brands in 80+ countries to cultivate relationships with hundreds of millions of consumers. We love solving hard problems and look for people who specialize in certain areas while being passionate about building, owning, and scaling solutions end-to-end, overcoming any obstacle in their way. We are a team of ambitious, customer-obsessed peers who are insatiably curious and meticulous in our craft. We push each other to grow beyond our comfort zone, learn new things, and work hard to ensure each day is better than the last.

As a Lead Security Trust & Compliance Engineer at Klaviyo, you'll be the primary owner of two or more of our Trust & Compliance programs — compliance operations & audits, continuous control monitoring, security policies & standards, security education & awareness, and customer trust operations among them. You'll set the strategy for the programs you own, run our audits end to end, engineer the controls and evidence pipelines that make them sustainable, and raise the technical bar for the practitioners around you. You won't have direct reports, but you will tactically lead the team on your programs: delegating work, setting teammates up to succeed, and mentoring analysts on their technical growth and career goals. This is your opportunity to take a leading role in cybersecurity, applying and deepening your expertise in security automation, risk analysis, control design, audit management, modern SaaS platform architectures, and many domains of information security (just about all of them!)

What you'll be doing

  • Own internal and external audits and examinations end to end from scoping and readiness through fieldwork and evidence delivery; act as our primary point of contact for auditors and assessors, and develop action plans to correct findings and exceptions
  • Identify gaps against frameworks we do not yet meet, define the strategy to close them, and drive the implementation when Klaviyo takes on a new certification or regulation
  • Own security policies and standards end to end — author and maintain the policy, standard, and procedure hierarchy, decompose standards into testable requirements mapped to frameworks, and run the review, ratification, and exception management
  • Determine control design and implementation details for net-new controls, provide technical guidance to partner teams on control design best practices, and diagnose deficiencies by reviewing system configurations, technical documentation, security tool data, and occasionally application code
  • Define control health metrics and build the pipelines behind them from the systems we already run, so control health is a live signal rather than a quarterly assertion
  • Automate and streamline our Security Trust & Compliance workflows — control testing, continuous control monitoring, evidence collection, identity governance, and security Q&As for employees and customers — with a penchant for creating excellent self-service experiences, and define new approaches, systems, and tools for the team where none exist yet
  • Proactively identify internal and external risks and opportunities relevant to our Trust & Compliance programs, and propose the plans to address them

We'd love to hear from you if you have most of the following:

  • In-depth understanding of multiple security and privacy frameworks — such as NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Critical Security Controls, CSA STAR, ISO 27001, ISO 27002, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, SOX ITGCs, GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA — including the ability to identify gaps against a framework that is new to the organization, define the strategy, and execute the implementation
  • A track record of personally owning security and privacy compliance audit programs end to end, including acting as the primary interface to internal and external auditors through scoping, walkthroughs, and findings resolution
  • Experience writing policies and standards that are precise enough to test and clear enough for engineers to follow, including ownership of the review and exception processes around them
  • Deep experience designing, assessing, and continuously monitoring modern security and privacy controls, including determining control design for net-new controls and diagnosing deficiencies from system configurations, technical documentation, security tool data, and application code
  • Experience with GRC engineering and security automation in general, especially applying AI and automation to eliminate toil
  • Knowledge of various enterprise SaaS applications, cloud infrastructure such as AWS and Kubernetes, modern software engineering practices/tools, databases, operating systems, secure network design, and other technology relevant to cybersecurity
  • Experience owning programs against defined KPIs and SLAs, including setting quarterly strategy, planning the work, and reporting on progress
  • A track record of mentoring practitioners, delegating effectively, and driving technical direction without formal authority
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to form relationships with internal and external teams.

Bonus points if you have any of the following:

  • Familiarity with modern compliance automation or trust management platforms (Drata, Vanta, Anecdotes, HyperProof, etc.)
  • Experience with SQL, building tools with REST APIs, and Python
  • Infrastructure-as-code or policy-as-code experience (Terraform, OPA/Rego, Conftest)
  • Building with agentic AI tooling (MCP, agent skills, evals and guardrails) and/or governing AI controls against ISO 42001 or NIST AI RMF
  • Experience implementing Identity Governance tools and processes, such as for user access reviews (UARs) and just-in-time access (JITA)
  • Experience working in security operations, security engineering, and/or security architecture roles
  • Relevant certifications, such as CISA, CISSP, or CCSP

Everyone on our team needs to have the following:

  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
  • Solutions oriented mindset
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Working collaboratively inside and outside your direct team
  • Strong alignment with Klaviyo’s core values

title: Senior Manager, Corporate Development
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements.
