Senior Manager, Corporate Development

About the Role

At Klaviyo, we believe in the power of technology to help businesses build smarter, more personalized relationships with their customers. As we continue to expand our platform, product capabilities, and global reach, Corporate Development plays an increasingly important role in accelerating our long-term strategy.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Corporate Development to help shape and execute Klaviyo's inorganic growth strategy, spanning acquisitions, strategic investments, partnerships, and other opportunities that accelerate our product and business ambitions.

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Development, you will serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership while independently driving complex, high-impact initiatives from initial thesis development through execution and integration. This is a highly visible, hands-on role with significant autonomy, requiring a unique combination of strategic judgment, financial sophistication, commercial acumen, and the ability to navigate complex transactions across multiple stakeholders.

As Klaviyo's platform and ambitions continue to evolve, you will play a critical role in expanding our ability to identify, evaluate, and execute transformative opportunities. Success requires someone who can operate as both a strategic thinker and an exceptional executor, translating market insights into actionable opportunities and driving transactions forward with speed, precision, and sound judgment.

How You Will Make a Difference

  • Own end-to-end transaction execution: Independently lead acquisitions, strategic investments, and other inorganic initiatives from opportunity identification and initial evaluation through valuation, diligence, negotiation, internal approvals, closing, and integration planning.
  • Shape Klaviyo's inorganic growth strategy: Partner with the Head of Corporate Development and executive leadership to identify strategic priorities, assess build/partner/buy opportunities, and develop investment theses aligned with Klaviyo's long-term product and business objectives.
  • Drive sophisticated financial and strategic analysis: Build and evaluate complex financial models, transaction structures, valuations, business cases, and synergy analyses to inform investment decisions and capital allocation.
  • Expand deal pipeline and execution capacity: Proactively source, prioritize, and advance multiple opportunities simultaneously, bringing the ownership and operational rigor needed to increase the organization's transaction throughput.
  • Influence executive-level decisions: Develop clear, compelling investment recommendations and present complex strategic, financial, and commercial considerations to senior executives and key decision-makers.
  • Lead cross-functional deal teams: Coordinate Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Security, and other stakeholders through complex diligence and transaction processes, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely execution.
  • Build relationships across the technology ecosystem: Develop and maintain a strong network of founders, investors, advisors, and industry leaders to identify emerging opportunities and strengthen Klaviyo's market presence.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and markets: Assess evolving industry dynamics, competitive landscapes, AI-driven innovation, and adjacent product opportunities to identify areas where inorganic growth can accelerate Klaviyo's strategy.
  • Navigate complex deal structures: Evaluate and negotiate transaction economics, governance, strategic rights, and commercial considerations across acquisitions, minority investments, and strategic partnerships.
  • Drive post-transaction value creation: Partner with functional leaders to define integration priorities, establish success metrics, and ensure transactions deliver against their strategic and financial objectives.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of relevant experience across Corporate Development, investment banking, private equity, strategic finance, or related transaction-focused roles, including meaningful experience independently leading complex transactions.
  • Demonstrated track record executing acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, or other sophisticated strategic transactions, ideally within technology, software, fintech, or high-growth businesses.
  • Exceptional financial modeling, valuation, and analytical capabilities, with experience evaluating complex business models, transaction structures, and long-term strategic and financial implications.
  • Strong commercial and strategic judgment, with the ability to evaluate opportunities beyond financial returns and understand their implications for product strategy, competitive positioning, and long-term enterprise value.
  • Proven ability to operate with significant autonomy, independently manage competing priorities, and drive multiple complex workstreams from ambiguity to execution.
  • Experience partnering with senior executives and cross-functional leaders, translating complex analysis into concise, actionable recommendations that influence high-stakes decisions.
  • Deep understanding of M&A processes, including strategic evaluation, due diligence, transaction structuring, negotiation, internal governance, and integration planning.
  • Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with founders, investors, external advisors, and senior business leaders.
  • An entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset with a willingness to move seamlessly between high-level strategic thinking and detailed transaction execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop executive-ready investment materials and clearly articulate complex business decisions.
  • High intellectual curiosity and a strong interest in technology, AI, commerce, and the evolving software ecosystem.

Nice to Have

  • Experience executing transactions within a large-scale technology company, high-growth SaaS business, or similarly complex corporate environment.
  • Exposure to international transactions, cross-border investments, or global market expansion.
  • Experience evaluating emerging technologies, AI-enabled businesses, fintech, or adjacent software platforms.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.
  • Experience building or improving Corporate Development processes, transaction frameworks, or analytical infrastructure within a lean, high-performing team.

Why This Role Matters

Corporate Development is a critical lever for accelerating Klaviyo's growth, expanding our capabilities, and strengthening our competitive position.

As our product portfolio and strategic opportunities expand, the ability to independently evaluate and execute complex transactions becomes increasingly important. This role will directly increase the organization's capacity to pursue high-value opportunities, reduce execution bottlenecks, and ensure that strategically important deals receive the attention and rigor required to move forward.

You'll work closely with senior leadership, influence decisions with meaningful long-term implications, and have the opportunity to shape not only the transactions Klaviyo pursues, but how Corporate Development contributes to the company's next phase of growth.

About the team

Klaviyo's Onboarding team sets new customers up for long-term success from the moment they sign. We guide businesses of every size through setup, integration, and their first customer experiences on Klaviyo so they reach value quickly and build a strong foundation for growth. We work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Engineering so every customer has a smooth path from signed contract to live revenue.

Our best Onboarding Specialists are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and strong project leaders. They turn complex implementations into clear plans, build trust quickly with every stakeholder, and measure their success by customer outcomes, not tasks completed.

About the role

As Senior Onboarding Specialist, APAC, you'll be the first point of contact for new Klaviyo customers in the region. You'll guide them through their first 30 to 90 days, from sale to a successful go-live, and help them launch the first customer experiences that drive revenue.

You'll join as a founding member of our Singapore team, so this role is both hands-on and foundational. Alongside owning a portfolio of onboardings, you'll help shape how Klaviyo onboards customers across APAC: what great looks like, which processes scale, and where the product and onboarding experience need to improve for this market.

Our customers vary widely in size, maturity, and technical setup. This role suits someone who enjoys solving unique problems creatively, thrives in challenging situations, and can move easily between technical troubleshooting and strategic marketing advice.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own new customer relationships from sale through successful go-live, acting as their trusted guide and advocate throughout onboarding.
  • Lead the implementation phase for each customer, including scope definition, project plans, resourcing, and timelines.
  • Give proactive, strategic advice on Klaviyo best practices so customers hit their initial business goals and build their first campaigns and flows with confidence.
  • Support customers on technical and non-technical questions, including integrations, data setup, marketing strategy, and wider ecommerce configuration.
  • Explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical users across a wide range of technologies and platforms.
  • Diagnose software issues, resolve customer concerns through established processes, and escalate appropriately when needed.
  • Review customer dashboards proactively, address open issues early, and keep messaging consistent across every touchpoint.
  • Monitor onboarding health, including time to first KAV, across your portfolio and act as a point of escalation when customers are at risk.
  • Set priorities and build technical health plans for open problems so issues are resolved quickly.
  • Run onboarding post-mortems, identify what worked and what didn't, and turn lessons learned into documented best practices.
  • Document troubleshooting and resolution steps to build a shared knowledge base for the growing APAC team.
  • Act as a product expert and bring customer insights to Product and Engineering to improve integrations, setup, UI, and anything else slowing customers down.
  • Surface, coordinate, and drive new ideas to improve onboarding processes as a founding member of the Singapore team.
  • Contribute to a team culture of collaboration, customer empathy, equality, and inclusion.

What success looks like

  • New customers reach go-live on time and achieve their first KAV quickly, with strong early engagement on the platform.
  • Customers finish onboarding with a clear strategy, working integrations, and live campaigns and flows that drive revenue.
  • High customer satisfaction and confidence at the end of onboarding, with smooth handoffs to Customer Success.
  • Issues are spotted early, escalated appropriately, and resolved efficiently, with few surprises for customers or internal teams.
  • A growing library of documented best practices, playbooks, and troubleshooting guides tailored to APAC customers.
  • Measurable improvements in onboarding processes and time to value, driven by your post-mortems and feedback.
  • Product and Engineering see you as a credible source of customer insight that shapes real improvements.
  • Customers and internal stakeholders view you as a trusted, proactive operator who can manage complex implementations without heavy manager involvement.

Who you are

  • 4+ years of customer onboarding, implementation, or related customer-facing SaaS experience, with a track record of building relationships with multiple stakeholders on an account.
  • Strong project manager with excellent organization skills and experience running several implementations at once.
  • Clear, thoughtful communicator across phone, video, and email, able to adapt to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience helping end users reach key business goals with software.
  • A track record of creative problem-solving for customers.
  • Experience in marketing or advising customers on marketing strategy is a plus.
  • Experience with email marketing and ecommerce platforms is a plus.
  • Foundational knowledge of APIs is advantageous.
  • Comfortable managing customer relationships in Salesforce or a similar CRM, and proficient with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Google Sheets.
  • AI fluent and comfortable using AI responsibly to improve productivity, sharpen thinking, and model modern ways of working.
  • Curious, eager to learn, and able to adapt in a fast-changing environment.
  • Collaborative by nature, thriving in cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive, accountable, and solutions-oriented; you own outcomes, raise issues early, and improve how work gets done.
  • Fluency in Business Mandarin is required given the customer base across the region.
  • Full authorisation to work in Singapore without restrictions is required.

Why this role is compelling

APAC is a high-growth region for Klaviyo, and onboarding is where every long-term customer relationship begins. As a founding member of our Singapore team, you'll directly shape how customers across the region experience Klaviyo from day one, build the playbooks others will follow, and have a visible impact on customer growth and retention.

If you're excited by helping businesses grow, solving hard customer problems, and building a team from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.

descriptionHtml:

About the Role

Klaviyo is seeking a Sr. Lead MarTech & AI Solutions Architect — an individual contributor role for someone who wants deep, hands-on ownership. In this role, you'll design and build the end-to-end architecture of how marketing data moves through our systems, from initial lead and data intake through to conversion and insights, embedding AI and automation directly into that journey to accelerate it. 

In this role, you'll also architect and own a centralized marketing hub spanning the full marketing lifecycle — from budget allocation and planning, through campaign execution, to using performance insights to accelerate the next planning cycle and improve ROI.

This role carries high ownership and visibility: you're the architect who understands how every system connects, why it's built that way, and where it needs to go next — building the technical foundation that turns customer journeys and personalization, planning cycles, and cross-functional decisions into a single, connected ecosystem.

How You'll Make a Difference

  • Design and build AI-powered marketing capabilities into our systems, from generative AI use cases to predictive scoring and intent-based automation, that accelerate the intake-to-conversion journey.
  • Serve as the technical owner of how marketing systems integrate with one another — proactively catching where data breaks or logic conflicts, and implementing the architectural solutions needed to evolve the ecosystem to support business growth.
  • Build and connect an ecosystem that accelerates customer journeys through personalization across the funnel — leveraging behavioral, product, and intent signals to maximize acquisition, conversion, and expansion
  • Turn performance data and business requirements into architecture and process improvements that shorten planning cycles and improve marketing ROI.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Lifecycle, Marketing Analytics, Sales Ops, and other technical teams to align system architecture with business needs — representing the technical point of view in planning and governance conversations.
  • Perform solution architecture reviews and serve as a critical advisor on technical design decisions — flagging trade-offs and ensuring alignment across systems, teams, and outcomes
  • Build and own a centralized marketing hub spanning the entire execution lifecycle: budget allocation and planning, campaign execution, and the feedback loop that turns performance insights into faster planning cycles.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in MarTech, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale system architecture — not just implementing tools, but architecting how data, process, and strategy connect across the full marketing lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building AI-powered marketing capabilities, from generative AI use cases to predictive scoring and intent-based automation, that solve real marketing problems.
  • Deep experience architecting HubSpot, Salesforce, and in-house systems at scale, including lead scoring, lifecycle automation, customer journey and personalization, campaign/opportunity data models, and cross-system data association.
  • Strong understanding of marketing budgeting, planning cycles, and ROI measurement — able to connect spend data directly to performance outcomes through architectural decisions.
  • Experience building scalable integrations — using APIs and middleware — across marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, NetSuite, Coupa).
  • A proven track record contributing to vendor evaluation and platform implementation for enterprise organizations.
  • A natural cross-functional partner — able to sit with cross-functional teams, translate their requirements into system architecture, and be the technical advisor they trust.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.

About the role

The world's largest brands are consolidating their marketing, customer data, and service onto one platform, and more of them are choosing Klaviyo. That shift has made Enterprise our fastest growing segment, with our biggest customers spending well over seven figures a year and, this year, the largest deal in company history.

As a Large Enterprise Sales Manager, you'll lead 6 to 8 Account Executives who win new logos and grow our existing customers in the Western U.S. You'll bring out the best in each of them and turn those wins into a repeatable motion. Every deal your team lands is a household name the rest of the market notices.

We're looking for a leader who has built enterprise teams before and still loves being in the deal. In your first 90 days, you'll know the book and the top opportunities well enough to help in any of them. Twelve months in, you'll have delivered the year and grown average contract size through multi-product attachment.

What you'll do

  1. Own the number and the forecast
  • Deliver team bookings against quarterly and annual targets.
  • Call a commit the company can rely on, built from rigorous inspection.
  1. Keep the pipeline full
  • Protect the coverage your team needs to hit its numbers.
  • Show AEs how to create territory plans, tier accounts, and map a buying group for every priority account.
  • Raise the standard of AE-led [prospecting / expansion] and what it produces.
  1. Win the big deals
  • Sharpen your AEs' discovery, qualification, executive engagement, value cases, and negotiation.
  • Step in yourself where it matters most.
  1. Grow the team
  • Hire continuously and get new AEs productive quickly.
  • Run weekly 1:1s that invest in each seller's skills and career.
  • Weave AI into how the team operates.
  1. Rally cross-functional partners
  • Work with leaders across Klaviyo so your team never walks into a big meeting alone and has the support it needs.
  • Carry field insight to Product and Enablement.
  • Diagnose what's holding the team back, fix what you can, and escalate the rest early.

What you bring

  • 4+ years leading quota-carrying enterprise AEs in B2B SaaS
  • Plus 8+ years of enterprise selling with a record of personal overachievement.
  • Proven ability to teach MEDDPICC or an equivalent methodology.
  • A history of recruiting and developing enterprise sellers who self-source pipeline and hit targets consistently.
  • A track record of building strong tool habits across a team, with Salesforce, Gong, Clari, and AI part of the everyday workflow.
  • Credibility with C-suite executives.
  • Experience leading teams that sell more than one product into the same account.
  • Nice to have: MarTech or ecommerce experience, ideally competing against Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe, or Braze.

When we talk, be ready to walk us through a team you moved and a deal you personally changed. We'll go deep on both.

Travel

descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

About the role

Klaviyo is a public company with more than $1.5 billion in annual revenue. Enterprise is our fastest growing segment, where global brands are consolidating their marketing and customer data onto Klaviyo and spending over seven figures a year with us. We have expanded beyond retail into hospitality, media, healthcare, and business services.

You will go after some of the largest brands in the world, including Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, prospecting your way in and taking full responsibility for your pipeline target.

Most of these companies run separate tools for email, SMS, customer data, and service. We win by bringing it all onto one platform and getting the customer to results faster. Once they are live, you will keep growing the account and lead the renewal.

What you will do

  • Prospect your own territory. Research every account, find a way in, and build relationships where Klaviyo has none today. BDR, marketing, and partner leads add to the pipeline you build.
  • Be the CEO of your territory. Build a plan for every named account, create and prospect into a relationship map, and pull in solutions engineering, value management, partners, and marketing at the right time.
  • Run business-value discovery. Find the real problem, put a number on it with the customer, and build a business case for the full platform that their finance team will support.
  • Sell to the full buying committee. Get to the CMO, CFO, CIO or CDO. Build champions and test them.
  • Win the competitive deals. Displace the incumbent, hold your price, and have a clear answer on why Klaviyo and why now.
  • Close and forecast with discipline. Run the mutual action plan, security and legal review, and procurement. Forecast against what the customer has agreed to.
  • Grow and renew. Expand into more products and teams, spot risk early, and negotiate renewals that make room for growth.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in enterprise software sales, with 7+ years selling to C-level executives from a field sales position
  • A proven hunter who has built pipeline from scratch through your own research and outreach, and closed new logos from it
  • Experience selling into organizations above $1B in revenue
  • A track record of closing annual contracts of $1M or more
  • At or above quota in at least two of the last three years, on a multi-million dollar target
  • Experience leading complex deals from start to finish, coordinating your internal team and the customer's decision makers
  • Experience running several complex deals that can last between nine and eighteen months
  • Multi-product platform selling, with more than one product sold into the same account
  • A deep understanding of MEDDPICC and a value-based selling methodology, including building business cases
  • Domain experience in MarTech, CDPs, customer engagement platforms, ecommerce, or an adjacent data platform
  • Partner-led selling experience, and a record of winning competitive deals against existing platforms
  • Experience growing existing accounts through expansion and renewal
  • Strong executive presence, and fluency in CRM, forecasting, conversation intelligence, and AI tools

Travel

This role requires approximately 30 to 40 percent travel for customer meetings, executive briefings, partner work, and industry events.

title: Engineering Manager, Marketing Engineering & AI Agents - Amplify
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Team Overview:The Amplify Engineering team builds internal tools, platforms, and AI-powered automation that help Klaviyos work more efficiently and at scale as the company grows. We partner across the organization, including Sales, Marketing, Engineering & Product, and Customer Service & Success to solve real operational problems with practical, well-designed software.

Our work spans internal applications, 3rd party integrations, interactive dashboards, CMS integrations, and robust AI systems and agents that automate repetitive tasks, surface the right information at the right time, and help teams make better decisions. We operate in tight feedback loops with our internal customers, shipping quickly, learning fast, and seeing the impact of our work immediately in how deals move faster, tickets resolve sooner, and launches go more smoothly.

As an Amplify EM, you will own klaviyo.com, Klaviyo Academy and the Help Center, along with the systems behind them: our Sanity CMS, the localization pipeline that publishes the site in multiple languages, personalization, and the tooling Marketing uses to produce campaign assets. We are replacing manual content and translation work with AI agents, from agentic translation scored against Smartling's own quality scale, to brief and bill-of-materials generation for campaigns, to automated asset creation in Figma.

This role is for builders and leaders who enjoy turning real-world pain points into reliable, scalable solutions. The work is highly visible and deeply impactful, shaping how thousands of Klaviyos get their work done every day through fast iteration, high ownership, and clear outcomes.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

The Amplify team builds the internal platforms, automation, and AI-driven systems that power how Klaviyos work every day. As an Engineering Manager, you will:

  • Lead the Amplify Marketing and Content Platform engineering teams and set the technical vision for klaviyo.com, Klaviyo Academy, the Help Center, and the content systems behind them.
  • Set and drive the roadmap for moving Marketing's content generation, translation, and asset production onto AI agents. You'll agree on quality bars with stakeholders, decide where a human stays in the loop, and measure each automation by the time and cost it removes.
  • Work side by side with Marketing, Brand, and Localization to map how content actually gets made today, and proactively replace the manual steps with AI agents, from copy and translations to campaign briefs and design assets. 
  • Balance technical leadership and people leadership, setting direction, modeling best practices, and enabling teams to deliver efficiently.
  • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and leaders across Marketing, Brand, Growth, and Localization to turn their biggest bottlenecks into scalable, high-quality software.
  • Own the reliability, performance, and security of klaviyo.com, including on-call, incident response.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, systems thinking, technical excellence, and an AI-first mindset.
  • Build the quality systems that let agents take over human steps safely, including evaluations, observability, and review gates, so Marketing can trust what ships.

Who You Are:

  • You are passionate about building software effectively and for the long term, balancing technical quality, velocity, and business impact.
  • BA or BS Degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent experience.
  • You have 8+ years of hands-on software development experience building and operating high-traffic web products at scale, including 4+ years as an engineering manager leading teams through complex, cross-team initiatives using an agile, iterative approach.
  • You are an AI-native technical leader who stays hands-on, whether that means reviewing code, prototyping an agent, or debugging a production issue. You and your teams build with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, and you set the standards for how they use them.
  • You have shipped LLM-powered agents or workflows to production that replaced real manual work, with measured outcomes such as hours saved or cost, and you know what makes them reliable: tool use and MCP integrations, multi-step orchestration, human-in-the-loop review, and graceful fallback when the model is wrong.
  • You treat quality as an engineering problem. You use evaluations (golden sets, LLM-as-judge scoring, regression checks), observability for cost and failure rates, and brand and compliance guardrails to decide when an agent is ready to replace a human step.
  • You have a strong track record of end-to-end ownership, from design through delivery and operation, including estimating work, managing risk, meeting commitments, and running on-call, SLOs, and incident response for the systems your teams own.
  • You have led engineering for a high-traffic marketing website built on a modern front end such as TypeScript and React, owning its performance, SEO, conversion paths, analytics and tagging, and its reliability during launches.
  • You have partnered directly with Marketing, Brand, Growth and Localization teams, and you understand how campaign and content production actually works: briefs, creative review, approvals, launch calendars and last-minute changes.
  • You are a people-first leader and coach, experienced in hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and developing engineers through constructive feedback and growth opportunities, while fostering a healthy, collaborative team culture.
  • You like to question convention and thrive in small, autonomous teams that serve internal customers, ship early and often, and measure success by outcomes such as faster launches, lower cost per asset, and more localized content shipped.

Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on experience with internationalization and localization at scale, especially AI-driven translation with tools such as Smartling.
  • Experience using and integrating with headless CMSs like Sanity or Contentful.
  • Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, and personalization platforms such as Optimizely, AB Tasty, or Adobe Target.
  • Experience with Astro, Cloudflare Workers, Figma automation, digital asset management tools such as Bynder, or HubSpot.

Klaviyo’s platform is primarily built with Python and React and runs on AWS. New hires join us from a wide range of technical backgrounds and are supported in learning our stack. Core technologies for the Amplify team include:

  • Python / Django / FastAPI
  • TypeScript / React / Astro
  • Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, MCP, and Claude Code for agentic development
  • Braintrust for LLM evaluation and observability
  • Sanity CMS
  • Optimizely
  • Figma
  • Smartling
  • HubSpot
  • Tableau
  • Cloudflare Pages/Workers
  • MySQL / Redis / Memcached
  • AWS

Location & Work Model:

This role is based in Boston, Massachusetts and follows a hybrid working model. Klaviyo supports work authorization and relocation for this position.

At Klaviyo, we enjoy tackling meaningful engineering challenges and value people who take ownership, learn continuously, and collaborate openly. We are committed to building inclusive teams and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Klaviyo is growing fast and we have openings for all skill levels across all of our teams. Learn more about our engineering culture at https://klaviyo.tech

  • Transform workflows by putting AI at the center, building smarter systems and ways of working from the ground up.
  • Travel: up to 25%, to meet and develop relationships with our agency partners / events.

  • Have partnerships, sales, or account management experience.

  • Obsessed with understanding your customer or partner.
  • Comfortable operating independently.
  • Comfortable presenting in large groups & showcasing yourself as a thought leader in our industry.
  • Proactively solicit and act on feedback from your customers, partners, and peers.
  • Are excited to be a part of and have an impact on a rapidly-growing, profitable startup.
  • Have a positive outlook and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Have 4-5 years of SaaS account management, channel and/or sales experience.

The world's largest brands are consolidating their marketing, customer data, and service onto one platform, and more of them are choosing Klaviyo. That shift has made Enterprise our fastest growing segment, with our biggest customers spending well over seven figures a year and, this year, the largest deal in company history.

As a Large Enterprise Sales Manager, you'll lead 6 to 8 Account Executives who win new logos and grow our existing customers in the Western U.S. You'll bring out the best in each of them and turn those wins into a repeatable motion. Every deal your team lands is a household name the rest of the market notices.

We're looking for a leader who has built enterprise teams before and still loves being in the deal. In your first 90 days, you'll know the book and the top opportunities well enough to help in any of them. Twelve months in, you'll have delivered the year and grown average contract size through multi-product attachment.

  • Carry field insight to Product and Enablement.

What you bring

About the team

Klaviyo’s Partnerships team helps drive durable growth through our ecosystem of agency, systems integrator, and consultant partners. We work closely with partners to create demand, unlock new revenue, improve customer outcomes, and bring the full value of Klaviyo to market.

Our best Partner Managers are commercial, partner-first, and highly collaborative. They know how to turn strong relationships into measurable business outcomes through joint go-to-market planning, co-sell execution, and partner enablement.

About the role

As a Partner Account Manager, Mid-Market, you will own and grow a portfolio of strategic agency and services partners while also recruiting and activating new partners across your territory. You will be responsible for driving partner-sourced pipeline, building repeatable co-sell motions and GTM plans, and helping partners expand their Klaviyo practice and profitability.

This role is ideal for someone who can move fluidly between executive relationship management, partner enablement, pipeline creation, and hands-on deal execution. You should be comfortable leading joint business planning, identifying whitespace, building partner account plans, and working side by side with Klaviyo sellers to move opportunities forward.

You will also help partners bring Klaviyo’s broader platform story to market, including our evolving B2C CRM, AI-powered capabilities, and service offerings.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own and grow a portfolio of 15–20 partners across your territory, building trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, sales leaders, and delivery teams
  • Recruit, onboard, and activate high-potential new partners to expand Klaviyo’s mid-market ecosystem and improve regional coverage
  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline through structured joint GTM plans, partner business plans, and co-sell execution
  • Build and manage a healthy referral and co-sell pipeline, with a strong focus on opportunity volume, velocity, and quality
  • Lead joint account planning and account mapping with partners and Klaviyo AEs to identify whitespace, unlock new logos, and accelerate expansion opportunities
  • Help partners strengthen their Klaviyo positioning, service offerings, and go-to-market motion to grow the commercial value of their practice
  • Partner closely with Partner Marketing to execute joint GTM programs that generate awareness, demand, and pipeline
  • Drive regular business reviews with partners, using data and insight to improve performance and long-term impact
  • Travel up to 25% to meet with partners, support field engagement, and attend events

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel, account management, business development, sales, or a related SaaS go-to-market role
  • You have experience working with partners that support mid-market and/or enterprise customers and can speak credibly to that segment and its buying dynamics
  • You are a strong relationship builder, have a challenger mindset with commercial instincts and are motivated by revenue outcomes, not just partner activity
  • You have prior quota-carrying experience, with a track record of hitting monthly and quarterly partner or revenue targets
  • You have experience building and executing joint GTM plans across co-sell, co-marketing, and partner-led demand generation
  • You are confident working directly with AEs and sales teams on account planning, pipeline generation, and deal acceleration
  • You are comfortable presenting product, solution, and value-based discussions with partners and customers
  • You are highly collaborative, operate well independently, and can set priorities and drive outcomes in a fast-moving environment
  • You hold a valid work authorisation to work in Australia 


Klaviyo in APAC:

We are “1% done” but have big plans for Klaviyo in APAC. Our Sydney team began to take shape throughout 2022 and has now built out our go to market teams in sales, customer success, services, partnerships, marketing, employee experience and product support. We opened our Singapore Hub in late 2025 and are scaling fast. As the team grows we will see a continued expansion of Klaviyo’s customer base and the building of a fantastic working culture in line with what we see elsewhere in Klaviyo but with its own local identity within our Sydney based team. This is your unique opportunity to join us at an early stage and help to shape our future Klaviyo in APAC.

One of our values as a company is ‘always learning’ and you can feel that in APAC. People are looking to grow and develop and Klaviyo provides a great platform to do so. As we are still early in our journey in APAC this means there is a lot of headroom to grow and develop within your role - we are looking for the leaders of the future. At Klaviyo we aim to hire within first, Klaviyos (our team members are called Klaviyos) are regularly being promoted or moving into new functional areas - it really is an education through experience here.

About the team

Klaviyo's Partnerships team helps drive durable growth through our ecosystem of agency, systems integrator, and consultant partners. We work closely with partners to create demand, unlock new revenue, improve customer outcomes, and bring the full value of Klaviyo to market.

Klaviyo is shipping faster than ever. Our product doesn't wait on multi-year plans; it evolves in weekly sprints. A business moving at this speed needs an ecosystem that keeps up, and our partners are central to how we grow. Program Partners are a vital part of that story. So we design for self-service first, then wrap it in a local community and a network of peers, so every partner still feels a human connection. A partner who doesn't feel valued can't make their full impact.

At Klaviyo, we serve our partners through two experiences. Managed partners have graduated to a dedicated, high-touch Partner Account Manager by meeting our tier requirements and graduation thresholds.

Program Partners are building their Klaviyo practice, from newly onboarded agencies and boutique specialists to established firms who work with Klaviyo on select projects and referrals. Every Program Partner gets an always-on experience of digital enablement, workshops, office hours, community, and joint go-to-market opportunities, with a clear path to a named Partner Account Manager as their Klaviyo business grows.

Our best Partner Managers are commercial, partner-first, and highly collaborative. They know how to turn strong relationships into measurable business outcomes through joint go-to-market planning, co-sell execution, and partner enablement. In this role, you'll bring that approach to every Program Partner at scale.

About the role

This role primarily supports our Commercial segment, which serves small to medium brands with under $30M in company revenue. As a Partner Account Manager, Program Partners, you will own our Program Partners across the segment: the hundreds of partners who have not yet graduated to managed status.

Program Partners are not a consolation prize. They drive new logos and Commercial coverage that other partners won't pursue, and we activate them through self-service portals, on-demand enablement, AI, and community.

You'll build a one-to-many growth model that combines partner lifecycle marketing, enablement, community, commercial activation, data, and automation. Your mission: help more partners build and grow a thriving Klaviyo practice, more frequently, so their business and their clients' results grow alongside measurable revenue growth with Klaviyo. You will turn that untapped potential into a reliable, repeatable source of partner-sourced revenue.

Our motto is that no partner is left behind, and our north star is that we have no inactive partners. The Klaviyo partner program should be a valuable asset and community for every partner, helping their business, and in turn their clients, grow.

Success is measured by partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won attached revenue. We also track the health of the Program Partner book of business through reach (how many partners are active), frequency (how often they source or attach deals), and yield (the value of each deal). Leading indicators such as certification progress, community engagement, portal adoption, and enablement cohort participation show us where to focus next.

How you'll make an impact

Drive activation and commercial growth

  • Increase the number of partners generating qualified opportunities and repeatable partner-sourced revenue.
  • Build growth plays that help partners move from onboarding to first registered lead, first opportunity, and repeat sourcing.
  • Partner with sales leaders, account executives, and BDRs on partner engagement, lead handoffs, and effective co-selling, including attaching certified, enabled partners for implementation and ongoing Klaviyo management and optimization.
  • Drive the right behaviors with push and pull across content, resources, tasks in the partner portal, and lead registration adoption.
  • Identify high-potential partners through performance and engagement signals, and trigger targeted support when it accelerates results. Fast-track the strongest toward managed status in partnership with the PAM team.

Create an exceptional partnership experience at scale

  • Deliver a predictable cadence of digital enablement, partner workshops, office hours, community activities, and demand generation.
  • Ensure partners feel connected and supported, and are enabled to use the right channels and avenues for their needs.
  • Work with Partner Marketing and regional Partner Enablement to build sales plays, enablement cohorts, and demand-gen motions that partners can run with us.
  • Market to our partners, and market through our partners to generate sourced opportunities. Build ecosystem and community along the way.

Run the book with data and AI

  • Use partner health data and leading indicators (portal and content engagement, certification progress, lead registrations, pipeline, time to first deal) to decide where monthly GTM motions and sales plays should focus.
  • Catch partners before they go inactive, and re-activate those who have.
  • Surface accounts, opportunities, and untapped revenue or service opportunities for partners, proactively and at scale.
  • Use AI and automation daily to segment the book, personalize outreach, build plays, and clear admin.

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel, business development, sales, or a related SaaS go-to-market role.
  • You have driven partner-sourced pipeline or revenue through programs and scaled motions, not only through a handful of strategic relationships.
  • You have worked with agencies, consultancies or tech partners that serve small and medium brands, ideally in ecommerce or martech.
  • You have a data-first mindset: you read leading indicators, build segments, and turn them into action in tools like Salesforce and Tableau.
  • You are AI native: you know how to use the content, frameworks, and program resources at your disposal, and you build repeatable workflows, templates, and plays.
  • You communicate well at scale, running webinars, cohorts, office hours, and campaigns that change partner behavior.
  • You are confident working with sales leaders, AEs, and BDRs, and with Partner Marketing, Enablement, and Operations.
  • You have a knack for uncovering revenue opportunities and surfacing them to partners and sales teams.

You thrive in a high-pace environment, with a "1% done" mentality: you move fast, ship, learn, and iterate, with no shortcuts in an industry and product that keep innovating.


Klaviyo in APAC:

We are “1% done” but have big plans for Klaviyo in APAC. Our Sydney team began to take shape throughout 2022 and has now built out our go to market teams in sales, customer success, services, partnerships, marketing, employee experience and product support. We opened our Singapore Hub in late 2025 and are scaling fast. As the team grows we will see a continued expansion of Klaviyo’s customer base and the building of a fantastic working culture in line with what we see elsewhere in Klaviyo but with its own local identity within our Sydney based team. This is your unique opportunity to join us at an early stage and help to shape our future Klaviyo in APAC.

One of our values as a company is ‘always learning’ and you can feel that in APAC. People are looking to grow and develop and Klaviyo provides a great platform to do so. As we are still early in our journey in APAC this means there is a lot of headroom to grow and develop within your role - we are looking for the leaders of the future. At Klaviyo we aim to hire within first, Klaviyos (our team members are called Klaviyos) are regularly being promoted or moving into new functional areas - it really is an education through experience here.

We use Covey as part of our hiring and / or promotional process. For jobs or candidates in NYC, certain features may qualify it as an AEDT. As part of the evaluation process we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound on April 3, 2025.

descriptionHtml:

About the role

The world's largest brands are consolidating their marketing, customer data, and service onto one platform, and more of them are choosing Klaviyo. That shift has made Enterprise our fastest growing segment, with our biggest customers spending well over seven figures a year and, this year, the largest deal in company history.

As a Large Enterprise Sales Manager, you'll lead 6 to 8 Account Executives who win new logos and grow our existing customers in the Western U.S. You'll bring out the best in each of them and turn those wins into a repeatable motion. Every deal your team lands is a household name the rest of the market notices.

We're looking for a leader who has built enterprise teams before and still loves being in the deal. In your first 90 days, you'll know the book and the top opportunities well enough to help in any of them. Twelve months in, you'll have delivered the year and grown average contract size through multi-product attachment.

What you'll do

  1. Own the number and the forecast
  • Deliver team bookings against quarterly and annual targets.
  • Call a commit the company can rely on, built from rigorous inspection.
  1. Keep the pipeline full
  • Protect the coverage your team needs to hit its numbers.
  • Show AEs how to create territory plans, tier accounts, and map a buying group for every priority account.
  • Raise the standard of AE-led [prospecting / expansion] and what it produces.
  1. Win the big deals
  • Sharpen your AEs' discovery, qualification, executive engagement, value cases, and negotiation.
  • Step in yourself where it matters most.
  1. Grow the team
  • Hire continuously and get new AEs productive quickly.
  • Run weekly 1:1s that invest in each seller's skills and career.
  • Weave AI into how the team operates.
  1. Rally cross-functional partners
  • Work with leaders across Klaviyo so your team never walks into a big meeting alone and has the support it needs.
  • Carry field insight to Product and Enablement.
  • Diagnose what's holding the team back, fix what you can, and escalate the rest early.

What you bring

  • 4+ years leading quota-carrying enterprise AEs in B2B SaaS
  • Plus 8+ years of enterprise selling with a record of personal overachievement.
  • Proven ability to teach MEDDPICC or an equivalent methodology.
  • A history of recruiting and developing enterprise sellers who self-source pipeline and hit targets consistently.
  • A track record of building strong tool habits across a team, with Salesforce, Gong, Clari, and AI part of the everyday workflow.
  • Credibility with C-suite executives.
  • Experience leading teams that sell more than one product into the same account.
  • Nice to have: MarTech or ecommerce experience, ideally competing against Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe, or Braze.

When we talk, be ready to walk us through a team you moved and a deal you personally changed. We'll go deep on both.

Travel

This role requires approximately 30 to 40 percent travel for customer meetings, executive briefings, partner work, and industry events.

descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day.   Own the technical direction and delivery for Klaviyo's data platform - streaming, batch compute, storage/lakehouse, and governance - now the foundation for autonomous, agent-driven experiences. Klaviyo's data platform processes billions of events daily across billions of consumer profiles for hundreds of thousands of brands, and increasingly that data is consumed not just by people but by a growing number of AI agents acting on customers' behalf. The footprint grows on two axes at once, ever‑larger data volumes and a steady stream of new data scenarios (new sources, domains, and consumption patterns) and your systems have to scale on both.
You'll design and ship systems that are fast, reliable, cost‑efficient, and safe for autonomous access, creating paved roads for data producers and consumers, human and agent alike. This is an individual‑contributor role (no direct reports); you lead through architecture, code, and influence. Expectations align to Lead/Principal IC behaviors: establishing SLOs, driving technical evolution, and acting as the interface across teams.
What You'll Do
  • Design and implement core data platform capabilities (e.g., event ingestion/CDC, stream processing, batch orchestration, data lake/warehouse patterns, catalog/lineage, governance, access, and compliance).
  • Define and uphold SLOs for data freshness, availability, and correctness; author/run readiness reviews, incident response, and post‑incident learning for your domain.
  • Author ADRs/RFCs, land data contracts and schema governance, and standardize connectors and templates that accelerate developer velocity.
  • Profile, tune, and right‑size systems for performance and cost; partner with FinOps on unit‑economics guardrails.
  • Pair with product teams and analytics/ML to expose the right abstractions and unblock customer value quickly.
  • Contribute high‑quality code and reviews; mentor Staff/ Sr. engineers across pillars through example and enablement (not line management).
  • Use AI to streamline data workflows, from authoring and testing pipelines to catalog/search and DQ, so analysts, ML, and product teams move faster with confidence.
Who You Are
  • Experience: 10+ years building and operating distributed data systems (e.g., Kafka/PubSub, Flink/Spark/Beam, Airflow/Dagster, Iceberg/Delta/Hudi; Snowflake/BigQuery; object storage) with multi‑tenant reliability.
  • Technical expertise: Data ingestion/CDC, stream processing, batch orchestration, lakehouse patterns, catalog/lineage, governance, and access controls, measured by freshness, availability, and correctness SLOs.
  • AI tools & automation: You apply ML/GenAI to data platforms - semantic catalog search, auto‑docs, data‑quality anomaly detection, SQL/pipeline generation - with human‑in‑the‑loop review and privacy controls.
  • Influence & enablement: You land data contracts, connectors, and templates that speed delivery for producers and consumers; you mentor via design docs and pairing.
  • AI fluency (Klaviyo default): You experiment, learn fast, and share AI wins responsibly.
Nice to Haves
  • Regional isolation/replication strategies, privacy‑by‑design, and data governance in regulated contexts.
  • Adopted paved roads: Producers/consumers are on standard ingestion, processing, and storage paths; schema governance and contracts reduce breakage.
  • SLOs & efficiency: ≥99.9% freshness for key domains; measurable cost/TB reductions; production debugging is faster with defined readiness reviews and incident learning.
  • AI‑augmented data operations: Semantic discovery and auto‑documentation cover the majority of high‑value datasets; AI‑assisted DQ monitors reduce data incidents on top pipelines by 25–40%; pipeline authoring and review times drop 15–25% with AI in the loop.
Success in 6 - 12 Months
  • Adopted “paved roads” for producers/consumers; ≥99.9% freshness SLO for key domains; measurable cost/TB reductions.
  • One or more step‑change improvements (e.g., 2× faster ingest → analytics latency) demonstrated with metrics and post‑incident trend‑down.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth (PLG)
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Senior Product Manager, Product-Led Growth (PLG)

About the Team

Klaviyo's Growth team is responsible for making it easier for businesses to discover, adopt, and grow with Klaviyo. We build the product experiences that connect customer value to sustainable business growth, spanning onboarding, activation, self-service purchasing, subscriptions, billing, and monetization.

As Klaviyo continues to expand its platform and introduce new products and AI-powered capabilities, our team plays a critical role in helping customers realize value quickly, understand the full breadth of what Klaviyo offers, and seamlessly grow their investment over time.

We believe the best growth strategies are built into the product itself. By combining customer empathy, thoughtful design, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making, we create intuitive experiences that drive adoption, conversion, retention, and long-term customer success.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help define and accelerate Klaviyo's product-led growth strategy, with a focus on creating seamless, high-converting customer experiences across the entire product lifecycle.

This role sits at the intersection of product experience, growth, and monetization. You'll own key initiatives that help customers move from initial signup to activation, discover and adopt additional capabilities, and expand their relationship with Klaviyo through intuitive self-service experiences.

This isn't just about optimizing conversion funnels or running experiments. We're looking for someone who understands that sustainable growth comes from delivering meaningful customer value, removing friction, and building experiences that make it easy for customers to get started, see results, and grow.

You'll partner closely with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, finance, and go-to-market teams to identify growth opportunities, shape product strategy, and deliver measurable business impact. You'll have the opportunity to influence how Klaviyo scales its self-service business while supporting an increasingly sophisticated product portfolio and customer base.

How You'll Make a Difference

  • Own key product-led growth initiatives across the customer lifecycle, including signup, onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion, with a focus on improving customer experience and driving measurable business outcomes.
  • Optimize the self-service customer journey by identifying and removing friction across product discovery, account setup, trial experiences, purchasing, and upgrades.
  • Accelerate time to value by building intuitive onboarding and activation experiences that help customers quickly understand Klaviyo's capabilities and achieve meaningful outcomes.
  • Drive conversion and monetization through thoughtful in-product experiences that help customers understand available plans, evaluate additional capabilities, and seamlessly upgrade or expand their usage.
  • Partner on pricing, packaging, and billing experiences to ensure customers can easily understand, purchase, and manage their subscriptions as their businesses grow.
  • Build a culture of experimentation by developing hypotheses, designing and evaluating experiments, and translating insights into product improvements that drive sustainable growth.
  • Define and measure success through clear growth metrics, including activation, trial-to-paid conversion, feature adoption, retention, expansion, and revenue impact.
  • Leverage customer insights and behavioral data to identify opportunities, understand points of friction, and prioritize initiatives with the greatest potential customer and business impact.
  • Collaborate across product and go-to-market teams to connect self-service and sales-assisted growth motions, creating consistent experiences for customers across different segments and stages of maturity.
  • Develop and execute a product roadmap that balances near-term growth opportunities with longer-term investments in scalable, customer-centric product experiences.

Who You Are

  • You have 3–5+ years of product management, start-up. consulting, or investment banking experience and have a desire to create and drive growth strategies across the customer lifecycle, including signup, onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. 
  • You have strong product and UX instincts, with a demonstrated ability to simplify complex customer journeys and build intuitive, high-quality experiences that drive adoption and engagement.
  • You understand the fundamentals of product-led growth and have experience improving meaningful business metrics through product improvements rather than relying solely on marketing or acquisition strategies.
  • You're highly analytical and comfortable defining success metrics, interpreting behavioral data, identifying opportunities, and using experimentation to inform product decisions.
  • You have a strong customer-first mindset and regularly leverage research, feedback, and product usage insights to understand customer needs and inform your roadmap.
  • You understand how product experience and monetization intersect, including the tradeoffs between reducing friction, delivering customer value, and driving revenue growth.
  • You've worked closely with engineering and design teams to ship impactful products, balancing speed, quality, and long-term scalability.
  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, can identify opportunities without a predefined playbook, and bring a strong bias for action and execution.
  • You can influence cross-functional stakeholders, communicate a clear product vision, and align teams around measurable outcomes.
  • You think like a builder, with the curiosity, creativity, and ownership mindset to challenge assumptions, experiment with new approaches, and continuously improve the customer experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning PLG initiatives at a high-growth B2B SaaS company with both self-service and sales-assisted customer journeys.
  • Experience with subscription monetization, pricing and packaging, billing, checkout, or self-service upgrade experiences.
  • Familiarity with growth experimentation, funnel analytics, cohort analysis, and tools used to understand customer behavior and product performance.
  • Experience building onboarding, activation, or expansion experiences for complex, multi-product SaaS platforms.
  • Background in martech, ecommerce, CRM, or other data-driven SaaS products.

Klaviyo is growing fast and we have openings for all skill levels across all of our teams. Learn more about our engineering culture at https://klaviyo.tech

Klaviyo operates a real-time data platform built for massive scale on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Engineers come to Klaviyo with experience in a variety of languages and from a number of disciplines.

Responsibilities

The Data Automation team builds tooling that helps our Data Platform engineers provision and use infrastructure to power core Klaviyo functionality and generate data-driven insights. You will work with a cross functional team to write technical design documents, create system infrastructure, write high quality code, and operate large scale systems in production.   • DynamoDB
  • MySQL
  • Kafka
  • Spark
  • Flink

  • 7+ years of experience in a software engineering discipline
  • Highly skilled in using at least one modern programming language
  • Experience provisioning infrastructure using Terraform or a similar infrastructure as code tool
  • Experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems in a cloud computing environment
  • Experience using Linux operating systems
  • Experience with OLTP and OLAP databases
  • Experience with high volume data processing and storage systems
  • Able to communicate well, both verbally and in writing
  • Able to work with others on a team
  • Able to learn continuously and adapt to a high growth environment
  • Able to stick with and solve difficult problems

About the role

Klaviyo is a public company with more than $1.5 billion in annual revenue. Enterprise is our fastest growing segment, where global brands are consolidating their marketing and customer data onto Klaviyo and spending over seven figures a year with us. We have expanded beyond retail into hospitality, media, healthcare, and business services.

You will go after some of the largest brands in the world, including Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, prospecting your way in and taking full responsibility for your pipeline target.

Most of these companies run separate tools for email, SMS, customer data, and service. We win by bringing it all onto one platform and getting the customer to results faster. Once they are live, you will keep growing the account and lead the renewal.

What you will do

  • Prospect your own territory. Research every account, find a way in, and build relationships where Klaviyo has none today. BDR, marketing, and partner leads add to the pipeline you build.
  • Be the CEO of your territory. Build a plan for every named account, create and prospect into a relationship map, and pull in solutions engineering, value management, partners, and marketing at the right time.
  • Run business-value discovery. Find the real problem, put a number on it with the customer, and build a business case for the full platform that their finance team will support.
  • Sell to the full buying committee. Get to the CMO, CFO, CIO or CDO. Build champions and test them.
  • Win the competitive deals. Displace the incumbent, hold your price, and have a clear answer on why Klaviyo and why now.
  • Close and forecast with discipline. Run the mutual action plan, security and legal review, and procurement. Forecast against what the customer has agreed to.
  • Grow and renew. Expand into more products and teams, spot risk early, and negotiate renewals that make room for growth.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in enterprise software sales, with 7+ years selling to C-level executives from a field sales position
  • A proven hunter who has built pipeline from scratch through your own research and outreach, and closed new logos from it
  • Experience selling into organizations above $1B in revenue
  • A track record of closing annual contracts of $1M or more
  • At or above quota in at least two of the last three years, on a multi-million dollar target
  • Experience leading complex deals from start to finish, coordinating your internal team and the customer's decision makers
  • Experience running several complex deals that can last between nine and eighteen months
  • Multi-product platform selling, with more than one product sold into the same account
  • A deep understanding of MEDDPICC and a value-based selling methodology, including building business cases
  • Domain experience in MarTech, CDPs, customer engagement platforms, ecommerce, or an adjacent data platform
  • Partner-led selling experience, and a record of winning competitive deals against existing platforms
  • Experience growing existing accounts through expansion and renewal
  • Strong executive presence, and fluency in CRM, forecasting, conversation intelligence, and AI tools

Travel

This role requires approximately 30 to 40 percent travel for customer meetings, executive briefings, partner work, and industry events.

descriptionHtml:

Klaviyo is looking for a Lead Customer Intelligence Analyst to join our growing Customer Insights & Analytics team. In this role, you will partner closely with CX stakeholders and data scientists to design new measurement systems, lead ambiguous analytical investigations, and help build the connected customer-intelligence layer behind Klaviyo's health scoring, personas, and experience-impact work. This role is instrumental in building — not just maintaining — the analytics infrastructure that CX leadership uses to prioritize and measure its biggest initiatives.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by building something rather than running an established process.

How you will make a difference:

  • Design and build the Goals Measurement Frameworks & Benchmarks for initiatives and pilots across the CX org - providing a standard way to define, baseline, and track goal attainment across programs.
  • Lead end-to-end one-off investigations — scoping an ambiguous business question, pulling and analyzing the data, and delivering a decision-ready answer with minimal oversight.
  • Stand up new dashboards and reporting (journey health, CX theme-and-impact, QBR/MBR inputs, NPS/OKR baselines) and corresponding documentation to allow handoffs to operational reporting teams once stable.
  • Partner with data scientists on health-score and forecasting work — contributing exploratory analysis, segmentation, and validation to support modeling decisions.
  • Build reusable data products (Snowflake-backed tools, automated pulls) that let insight delivery scale beyond manual reporting.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CX leadership, data science, and operational reporting teams to keep new builds well-documented and handoff-ready.

Who you are:

  • 5–8 years of experience owning analytical problems end-to-end: from framing the business question, through analysis, to influencing stakeholders and operationalizing the solution.
  • You have strong, daily-use SQL and Python skills, not just familiarity.
  • You have a track record of scoping ambiguous problems yourself and driving them to a clear answer, with minimal hand-holding.
  • You have enough applied statistics/ML literacy to be a credible thought partner to a data scientist, without needing to own the full model lifecycle.
  • You communicate findings clearly to non-technical and senior stakeholders.
  • Tableau, Snowflake/Streamlit, customer analytics experience, and prior measurement framework work is a plus.

The Lifecycle Marketing Team at Klaviyo is a Center of Excellence that delivers seamless scalable customer-facing experiences across all owned channels, and servicing all segments and geographies. This is a senior individual contributor role, and as our Lead Lifecycle Marketer for EMEA within the global Lifecycle Marketing team, you’ll own lifecycle marketing across the region, partnering with EMEA Marketing and Sales to identify opportunities and deliver programs that support regional growth and business priorities.

You’ll also partner with the global Lifecycle Marketing team to localise and scale global programs for EMEA, ensuring lifecycle experiences are relevant to local markets, audiences, and customer needs. This is a hands-on execution-focused role combining optimisation, strategy, and cross-functional collaboration.

EMEA Lifecycle Programs

  • Native/ fluent English (essential). Fluent French/ German/ Spanish/ Italian a bonus. 

Tools & Tech:

  • Experience with lifecycle and CRM technologies including: HubSpot (essential), Salesforce (essential), Smartling (nice to have) and other localisation and marketing automation platforms advantageous
  • Monday board or similar

Cross-functional/stakeholder 

  • Strong cross-functional operator, able to align stakeholders across regional/ global Marketing, Sales, Growth, Product, Operations teams across different timezones 

Work style

  • Execution and delivery focused: Hands-on across strategy, analysis, managing multiple projects and trade-offs in a fast-paced, shifting environment

title: Order to Cash Track Lead, Finance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

At Klaviyo, we know that building a great company starts with building a great team. We welcome candidates from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we care as much about your trajectory and potential as we do about direct, one‑to‑one matches with every requirement.

About the team

Klaviyo went public in 2023 and is scaling fast. This is a rare chance to lead and build the Order to Cash (O2C) foundation for a company at this inflection point. The Finance Technology Systems team is part of G&A Systems within Global Technology Solutions (GTS). This group designs, operates, and continually improves the applications and workflows that power how Klaviyo manages money, risk, and financial reporting at scale.

The team partners closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Internal Audit, as well as adjacent technology teams like Corporate IT, Data, and GTM Systems, to ensure our back‑office stack is reliable, well‑integrated, compliant, and ready for a public, AI‑forward SaaS business. We own the roadmap, health, and governance of platforms including our ERP and financial systems (e.g., NetSuite/Oracle), procure‑to‑pay (e.g., Coupa), revenue and billing systems, and related integrations and automation.

This role reports to the Director, G&A Systems and leads the team responsible for Finance Technology Solutions across Klaviyo.

What You'll Do

As the Order to Cash (O2C) Lead, Finance Systems, you will be the accountable technology leader for Klaviyo’s O2C application landscape and core financial workflows. You will lead Enterprise and International Expansion capabilities that will provide revenue uplift for Klaviyo.

Own the O2C track

  • Execute on the roadmap for Klaviyo’s O2C stack aligned to the company priorities by translating business requirements into functional and technical design. Bring first principles thinking to your design.
  • Integrate CPQ to NetSuite and ensure that all Enterprise capabilities are delivered with scale.
  • Look at O2C systems landscape and provide recommendations to set Klaviyo for the future
  • Ensure we deliver with the highest code quality by thoroughly thinking through test cases and applying rigorous build and test.

Own SOX, controls, and audit readiness for Finance systems

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of IT General Controls (ITGCs) and other key controls across O2C applications, in partnership with Internal Audit, Security, and external auditors.
  • Continually simplify and automate controls and evidence collection so audits are reliable and predictable, with fewer deficiencies and lower friction for Finance and GTS teams.

Drive AI-native transformation across Finance 

  • Lead Klaviyo's push to make Finance one of the most automated, insight-driven functions in the company. You'll identify and deliver high-value AI use cases across the O2C workflow. 
  • You'll partner directly with Klaviyo's AI and data platform teams and Finance Engineering  to embed AI into core Finance processes with clear guardrails, measurable productivity gains, and the rigor expected of a public company. This isn't a future-state vision, it's work already underway, and you'll own it from a Product standpoint.

Design and optimize core Finance processes and systems

  • Have a leader mindset and partner with Controllership, Tax, Treasury  leaders to improve and continuously refine end‑to‑end O2C workflows ensuring systems and processes are tightly aligned.
  • Ensure our ERP and other SaaS O2C applications are configured, integrated, and operated to support accurate, timely close, scalable revenue and billing, and high‑quality financial data that downstream teams can trust.

Act as a strategic partner and communicator

  • Serve as the primary technology partner for Controller, and Finance leadership team on systems, data, and process topics; 
  • As needed, represent Finance Technology Systems in executive forums, planning cycles, and cross‑functional initiatives, ensuring O2C needs are anticipated and built into wider GTS and company roadmaps.

Who You Are

You've spent your career at the intersection of Finance and Technology and you've moved beyond just keeping systems running. You think in product design, roadmaps, outcomes, and partnerships. You know what a well-run O2C  function looks like, and you know how to build one.

You've worked in  teams through real complexity: ERP and other transformations, SOX audits, billing system overhauls, or the messy work of integrating Finance systems across a growing company. You don't need a perfect environment to do great work, you create structure where there isn't any, and you bring Finance and engineering stakeholders along with you.

Specifically, you likely bring:

  • 10+ years in enterprise or business systems, with meaningful ownership of Finance technology at a tech or SaaS company; 4+ years in O2C, responsible for order-to cash
  • Understanding  of practical SOX ITGC experience and a clean track record working with Internal Audit and external auditors
  • Solid understanding of enterprise-led growth, international expansion and system features required to enable moving upmarket
  • Hands-on in  ERP and Finance application architecture (NetSuite/Oracle, Avalara, Zuora, or similar), integration patterns, and how Finance data flows across a modern tech stack
  • Deliver business outcomes by partnering  strong engineering team with AI build-first mentality 
  • Personally built or scaled AI and automation in Finance workflows - reconciliations, invoice processing, forecasting prep and can speak to what worked and what didn't
