About the role

Klaviyo is a public company with more than $1.5 billion in annual revenue. Enterprise is our fastest growing segment, where global brands are consolidating their marketing and customer data onto Klaviyo and spending over seven figures a year with us. We have expanded beyond retail into hospitality, media, healthcare, and business services.

You will go after some of the largest brands in the world, including Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, prospecting your way in and taking full responsibility for your pipeline target.

Most of these companies run separate tools for email, SMS, customer data, and service. We win by bringing it all onto one platform and getting the customer to results faster. Once they are live, you will keep growing the account and lead the renewal.

What you will do

  • Prospect your own territory. Research every account, find a way in, and build relationships where Klaviyo has none today. BDR, marketing, and partner leads add to the pipeline you build.
  • Be the CEO of your territory. Build a plan for every named account, create and prospect into a relationship map, and pull in solutions engineering, value management, partners, and marketing at the right time.
  • Run business-value discovery. Find the real problem, put a number on it with the customer, and build a business case for the full platform that their finance team will support.
  • Sell to the full buying committee. Get to the CMO, CFO, CIO or CDO. Build champions and test them.
  • Win the competitive deals. Displace the incumbent, hold your price, and have a clear answer on why Klaviyo and why now.
  • Close and forecast with discipline. Run the mutual action plan, security and legal review, and procurement. Forecast against what the customer has agreed to.
  • Grow and renew. Expand into more products and teams, spot risk early, and negotiate renewals that make room for growth.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in enterprise software sales, with 7+ years selling to C-level executives from a field sales position
  • A proven hunter who has built pipeline from scratch through your own research and outreach, and closed new logos from it
  • Experience selling into organizations above $1B in revenue
  • A track record of closing annual contracts of $1M or more
  • At or above quota in at least two of the last three years, on a multi-million dollar target
  • Experience leading complex deals from start to finish, coordinating your internal team and the customer's decision makers
  • Experience running several complex deals that can last between nine and eighteen months
  • Multi-product platform selling, with more than one product sold into the same account
  • A deep understanding of MEDDPICC and a value-based selling methodology, including building business cases
  • Domain experience in MarTech, CDPs, customer engagement platforms, ecommerce, or an adjacent data platform
  • Partner-led selling experience, and a record of winning competitive deals against existing platforms
  • Experience growing existing accounts through expansion and renewal
  • Strong executive presence, and fluency in CRM, forecasting, conversation intelligence, and AI tools

Klaviyo in APAC:

We are starting small but have big plans for Klaviyo in APAC. Our Sydney team began to take shape throughout 2022 and has now built out our go to market teams in sales, customer success, partnerships, marketing, recruiting and product support. As the team grows we will see a continued expansion of Klaviyo’s customer base and the building of a fantastic working culture in line with what we see elsewhere in Klaviyo but with its own local identity within our Sydney based team. This is your unique opportunity to join us at an very early stage and help to shape our future Klaviyo in APAC.

One of our values as a company is ‘always learning’ and you can feel that in APAC. People are looking to grow and develop and Klaviyo provides a great platform to do so. As we are still relatively early in our journey in APAC this means there is a lot of headroom to grow and develop within your role - we are looking for the leaders of the future. At Klaviyo generally managers are often promoted up into their roles and people are regularly being promoted or moving into new functional areas - it really is an education through experience here.

Account Executives at Klaviyo are given a tremendous opportunity to have a huge impact on Klaviyo’s prospects, on Klaviyo’s trajectory and as a result, on themselves.  At Klaviyo, AEs pride themselves on being product experts who focus on closing deals the right way -- with the right customers whom they set up for success.  AEs at Klaviyo run the entire sales cycle -- from qualification to demo to driving the buying process to close, all while managing dozens of prospects at once.  The best AEs are able to close over 80% of their opportunities, forecast their business with accuracy, and proactively manage and extract value from their territory long term.

Join us, and let's build the future of marketing technology together.

Klaviyo’s Headquarters are based in Boston, US. This current role is hybrid and based out of our Sydney office. 

How You’ll Make a Difference:

  • Seek and qualify new opportunities across the Enterprise segment
  • Actively manage pipeline and develop a strategy for long-term sustained success
  • Collaborate with cross functional team members in product, engineering, partnerships and customer success to  improve cross-departmental efforts for upmarket clients
  • Support the success of your peers
  • Exhibit Klaviyo’s values of accountability and effort
  • Provide guidance and support to new Account Executives

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years sales experience 
  • 8+ years experience in SaaS or Martech sales in a new logo acquisition role
  • Ability to build relationships with internal (business development, marketing, ops and enablement partnerships, etc.) and external (clients, prospects, agencies etc.) stakeholders.
  • In line with our value of always learning, you define yourself as an energetic self-starter who is results-oriented and works effectively in an entrepreneurial environment.
  • Experience and interest in working with strategic accounts with multiple stakeholders
  • Proven strategic pipeline management experience to ensure long term success.
  • Track record of using data to inform decision making.
  • Track record of working with leadership to define and implement successful new programs
  • Strategic mindset to define and execute sales strategies.
  • A results oriented, highly motivated, enthusiastic attitude and the ability to work independently.
  • A deep understanding of SaaS and sales economics.
  • You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.
  • Eligible to work in Australia without restrictions

Soft-skills:

  • Exemplary presentation and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision making skills.
  • Detail-oriented and persuasive.
  • Strong sense of curiosity with a bias towards action.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, and Gong.
  • Use of, implementation and understanding of sales process and methodologies.

Klaviyo in APAC:

We are “1% done” but have big plans for Klaviyo in APAC. Our Sydney team began to take shape throughout 2022 and has now built out our go to market teams in sales, customer success, services, partnerships, marketing, employee experience and product support. We opened our Singapore Hub in late 2025 and are scaling fast. As the team grows we will see a continued expansion of Klaviyo’s customer base and the building of a fantastic working culture in line with what we see elsewhere in Klaviyo but with its own local identity within our Sydney based team. This is your unique opportunity to join us at an early stage and help to shape our future Klaviyo in APAC.

One of our values as a company is ‘always learning’ and you can feel that in APAC. People are looking to grow and develop and Klaviyo provides a great platform to do so. As we are still early in our journey in APAC this means there is a lot of headroom to grow and develop within your role - we are looking for the leaders of the future. At Klaviyo we aim to hire within first, Klaviyos (our team members are called Klaviyos) are regularly being promoted or moving into new functional areas - it really is an education through experience here.

descriptionHtml:

We're looking for a Head of Global Compensation to build the next generation of our compensation strategy. Someone who understands how to design programs that reinforce our culture, reward exceptional performance, and support the ambitious people who choose Klaviyo for the work we're doing and the impact they can have.

Reporting directly to the VP of Total Rewards, you'll have the opportunity to challenge conventional thinking, rethink established practices, and create compensation programs that reflect the company we're becoming. You'll help shape our broader Total Rewards strategy, lead and develop a talented team, and partner directly with leaders on how we recognize, reward, and invest in our people..

We're looking for someone who loves the craft of compensation, thinks like a business leader, and gets excited about building something better.

What You'll Do: 

1. Compensation Strategy & Architecture

  • Lead the evolution of our global compensation philosophy, job architecture, leveling, and pay structures to support a high-performance organization.
  • Bring a strong point of view on compensation investment, balancing market dynamics, internal equity, business priorities, and long-term financial sustainability.
  • Help shape our broader Total Rewards strategy, ensuring compensation works alongside benefits, recognition, and the overall employee experience.

2. Equity & Long-Term Rewards

  • Own our equity compensation strategy, including new-hire grants, refresh programs, long-term incentives, and retention approaches.
  • Own the  multi-year equity models and budget,  taking into consideration burn rate, dilution, and future investment needs.
  • Shape senior leadership compensation strategy and support Compensation Committee preparation, governance, and decision-making.

3. Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to People Leaders on critical hiring decisions, retention challenges, organizational changes, and compensation investments.
  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition to ensure our compensation approach supports the talent we want to attract and reinforces what makes Klaviyo a compelling place to grow a career.

4. Team Leadership & Operating Model

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing compensation team, strengthening technical capabilities, business judgment, and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Rethink how compensation work gets done, using technology, automation, and AI to simplify processes, improve insights, and increase the team's impact.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of progressive compensation experience, including significant leadership responsibility within a high-growth technology company.
  • 3+ years of proven success leading and developing a compensation team
  • Demonstrated experience designing, transforming, or meaningfully evolving global compensation strategies and programs within a publicly traded company.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including equity modeling, burn rate, dilution, long-term incentive design, and compensation budget planning.
  • Experience with executive compensation, Compensation Committee support, public-company governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • A strong understanding of pay equity and evolving pay transparency requirements.
  • Experience extending compensation frameworks into new markets as a company scales, balancing global consistency with local market realities.
  • Hands-on experience with compensation systems, market data platforms, and analytics, along with demonstrated experience in using AI and automation to improve how work gets done.
  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

  • Manage relationships: Nurture a portfolio of 40 partner relationships, serving as a trusted advisor

Experience:

  • 2+ years in Partnerships, Channel, Account Management, or Commercial Customer Success roles within SaaS (preferably in MarTech or working with eCommerce-focused accounts)
  • Experience working with digital marketing agencies and/ or systems integrator partners
  • Proven ability to manage multiple accounts and relationships in a high-velocity, high-volume environment with a focus on driving partner productivity

Languages:

  • Fluent in English and Spanish (written and verbal), essential
  • Business-fluent Italian (written & verbal), a bonus!

Skills:

  • Exceptional influencing and relationship-building abilities across all levels of seniority, with the capacity to navigate complex organizational structures
  • Adept at identifying and aligning partner goals with Klaviyo’s platform capabilities

Mindset:

  • Collaborative, strategic thinker with a creative approach to problem-solving
  • Passionate about building strong partnerships and delivering value
  • You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.

Other Requirements:

  • Willing and able to travel across the UKI and Europe as needed

descriptionHtml:

Klaviyo is looking for a Global Services Operations Lead to join our Customer Experience Operations team. This role keeps the Global Services–comprised of Professional Services, Customer Education, and Onboarding–operating engine running day to day– managing the variety of projects, systems, and cross-functional initiatives that support resourcing, service delivery, and reporting for the services organization. You’ll partner closely with the Senior Manager of Professional Services Operations and stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Partners to execute operational initiatives, build and maintain the automations and processes the team relies on, and bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional problems.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys rolling up their sleeves: managing multiple concurrent projects, orchestrating enhancements or building hands-on in tools like Salesforce, Tableau, Snowflake, and driving process improvements without a team behind them. You’ll bring independent judgment to how you get things done.

How You’ll Make a Difference:

Program & Project Management

  • Independently manage a portfolio of operational projects and initiatives for Global  Services Strategy & Operations, balancing multiple short- and mid-term priorities at once.
  • Translate ambiguous asks from stakeholders and cross-functional partners into clear project plans, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Keep initiatives on track by coordinating across Sales, Customer Success, Support, Partners, IT, and Product — flagging risks and proposing solutions before they become blockers.

Process & Systems Ownership

  • Build, document, and maintain the systems and automations that support services reporting, alerting, and workflow needs.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline manual or error-prone processes and design more scalable, repeatable solutions.
  • Own documentation for operational processes so they’re auditable and easy to hand off or scale.

Reporting & Insights

  • Support the development and upkeep of operational metrics and dashboards (e.g., attach rate, pipeline, resourcing, service delivery health) that inform PS Operations and leadership decisions.
  • Partner with analysts and stakeholders to ensure the data feeding these reports is accurate and timely.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a go-to point of coordination for internal and external partners solving problems that span multiple functional areas.
  • Evangelize new tools, processes, and ways of working across PS, Sales, and CS stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships that create coordination across groups, both internal and external (e.g., implementation partners).

Who You Are:

  • 4–6 years of experience in professional services operations, program/project management, revenue operations, or a related operational role, ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or technology company.
  • Proven ability to independently manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities, exercising sound judgment on how to drive results.
  • Hands-on experience with systems like Salesforce, Tableau, Google Sheets/Apps Script, Zapier, or similar automation and reporting tools. SQL experience is a plus. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills–comfortable evaluating ambiguous situations and data to design creative, effective solutions.
  • Excellent communicator who builds trust with stakeholders across functions and levels, from individual contributors to leaders.
  • A builder’s mindset: energized by creating new approaches, processes, and tools rather than only maintaining existing ones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a Professional Services, Customer Success, or Support organization specifically.
  • Familiarity with professional services automation (PSA) tools and project management systems.
  • PMP or other project/program management certification.

About the team and role:

Klaviyo is building the future of CRM, and the Industry Advisor will accelerate our expansion in Hospitality, specifically Hotels & Travel and Entertainment & Recreation businesses. This role sits at the intersection of industry expertise, value consulting, and go-to-market execution. The Industry Advisor acts as a trusted resource and executive-level proxy in Hospitality prospect conversations to drive opportunity progression and closed-won ARR.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role. You’ll work closely with Account Executives (AEs) and Solutions Engineers (SEs), and collaborate with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Enablement to make sure what we learn from customers is operationalized. The result is a hospitality motion that is compelling, repeatable, and scalable. You’ll operate at both the deal and systems level, supporting high-impact opportunities while identifying patterns that can be scaled across the field.

If you’ve spent your career in hospitality — either in-house, at an agency, or with a tech platform serving the industry — and you’re excited by the idea of applying that experience at scale, this is a rare opportunity to do exactly that. You’ll work directly with sales teams and customers, shaping deals in motion, while also influencing how Klaviyo shows up in the market. Your insights won’t just live in a slide deck — they’ll guide deal strategy, inform product conversations and drive partner engagements

How you’ll make a difference:

Executive Advisory & Verticalized Deal Support

  • Partner with AEs and SEs to advance hospitality opportunities, bringing vertical-specific positioning, real-world use cases, and a deep understanding of prospects’ operational realities.
  • Join strategic sales calls to build buyer confidence, reinforce Klaviyo’s long-term commitment to the hospitality industry, and help teams navigate complex objections around data, integrations, and organizational change.
  • Develop direct relationships with high-potential prospects, industry influencers, and partner-aligned accounts—using those relationships to both progress deals and inform Klaviyo’s broader go-to-market strategy
  • Develop direct relationships with high-potential prospects, industry influencers, and partner-aligned accounts to progress deals and inform Klaviyo’s broader go-to-market strategy.

Value Consulting & Executive Translation

  • Translate Klaviyo’s platform into business outcomes for CMOs, CDOs, CEOs, and other executive decision-makers.
  • Partner with prospects to build business cases for platform value creation and revenue impact.

  • Define the economic buyer KPIs that anchor each value case.
  • Feed hospitality-specific value benchmarks (e.g., lift from lifecycle marketing on direct bookings, loyalty, guest retention) back to the Value Consulting and Product Marketing teams.

Thought Leadership, Field Intelligence & Product Feedback

  • Continuously synthesize insights from customer conversations, market research, and industry news into clear, actionable guidance for sellers.
  • Synthesize patterns from recent wins and losses into vertical playbooks that help sellers and educate Partnerships and Product on the integrations and features that matter most.
  • Own a recurring Hospitality Field Intelligence memo that carries customer needs and competitive gaps to Product, Product Marketing, and Customer Success.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to shape hospitality-specific messaging and GTM motions, and deliver insights that inform sales plays for Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Enablement, and Sales Leadership.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on hospitality campaigns and thought leadership content, facilitate CMO/CXO roundtables, and support case studies and storytelling assets that reflect authentic hospitality success stories.
  • Represent Klaviyo at industry events, executive forums, customer advisory boards, webinars, regional events, and co-branded partner programs to generate pipeline and establish credibility in the hospitality community.
  • Serve as a feedback loop between the field and Product and Engineering, surfacing customer needs, competitive gaps, and platform direction based on real-world usage and enterprise requirements.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Who you are:

  • Deep applied experience in hospitality marketing, with the credibility to advise both colleagues and customers.
  • Experienced in advising or presenting to executive stakeholders (CMO, CDO, CEO) and translating platform capabilities into business outcomes and value cases.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex industry insights actionable and clear.
  • Skilled at working cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships and influencing without authority.
  • A natural teacher, coach, and strategist who brings structure to ambiguity and builds credibility with customers and colleagues.
  • A strategic thinker with vision, dedicated to the growth and evolution of the hospitality motion.
  • A force multiplier who brings operational discipline and motivates the broader Sales team to meet exceptionally high standards of performance.

Education and Experience:

  • 7-10+ years of hospitality marketing experience, either in-house, at an agency, or with a tech platform.
  • An additional 1-3 years of B2B SaaS experience in cross-functional roles that touch Sales is preferred but not required.
  • Familiar with the hospitality ecosystem, including platforms like Oracle Opera, Guesty, Mews, Cloudbeds, Mindbody, and Zenoti.

Commercial | EMEA | German Speaking

At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo brings to our workplace every day. About the Opportunity

Solutions Engineers at Klaviyo are technical sellers at the heart of our revenue motion. We don't just demo software. We work as trusted advisors, helping fast-growing commercial businesses understand how Klaviyo can solve their real challenges, and then we prove it.

We're looking for a Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer to join our EMEA Commercial team, covering the Entrepreneur and SMB segment. This is a role for someone who can move quickly through a sales cycle, run sharp discovery, design practical solutions, and deliver demos that actually land. You'll be comfortable talking to both developers and marketers, and you know how to adapt on the fly.

You'll work closely with Account Executives across the German-speaking market and wider EMEA region, owning the technical side of deals from first call through to close. You bring structure and momentum to the sales cycle without slowing it down.

What We Do as Solutions Engineers

We're technical sellers who drive revenue by winning Commercial deals. Our job is to own the technical win. That means building champions, demonstrating clear value, and making sure prospects choose Klaviyo.

We work directly with customers to architect solutions that integrate into their existing tech stacks, taking a consultative approach that builds confidence and secures buy-in from technical and business stakeholders alike.

Our team builds beyond the day-to-day too. Recent projects include AI-powered demo data generators, a Chrome extension for troubleshooting API calls, web SDK injectors, and templatised mobile apps to showcase our SDK capabilities. If you're someone who builds things to solve problems, you'll fit right in.

How You'll Make a Difference

Own the Technical Win

  • Partner with Account Executives to lead the technical side of Commercial opportunities from qualification through to close.
  • Run focused technical discovery to understand a prospect's goals, current stack, data flows, and constraints.
  • Design solution architectures that make the most of Klaviyo's platform, APIs, and integrations to meet customer needs and best practices.
  • Deliver tailored demos and presentations to both business and technical audiences, clearly connecting capabilities to real customer outcomes.
  • Scope and lead proofs of concept where needed, defining success criteria and keeping things on track.
  • Handle objections confidently, navigate competitive situations, and bring clear strategic thinking to deal with conversations.

Be a Trusted Advisor

  • Act as a go-to resource for prospects on topics like data strategy, integrations, implementation approach, and long-term scalability.
  • Bring subject matter expertise across marketing technology, eCommerce, CDPs, and customer data.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support on RFPs, security reviews, and deeper technical evaluations.
  • Stay close to the competitive landscape and bring that intelligence into deals in a way that's useful, not just informational.

Build and Contribute

  • Contribute to repeatable assets like demo narratives, reference architectures, playbooks, and templates that help the broader team move faster.
  • Use AI tools and automation to scale your own impact and improve how you work.
  • Provide clear feedback loops to Product and GTM teams on feature gaps, market trends, and what SMB customers are actually asking for.
  • Support partner and channel teams where relevant, helping them position and implement Klaviyo effectively for commercial customers.

Who You Are

Required

  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken.
  • 3+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Solid understanding of web technologies, APIs, and data integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, and ecommerce or marketing platforms.
  • Comfortable engaging with both technical stakeholders (developers, architects) and business stakeholders (marketing, operations, leadership).
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to make complex concepts feel simple and relevant.
  • Able to run live product demos and adjust in real time based on the conversation.
  • Experience working with commercial customers, with an appreciation for their pace, constraints, and how to design practical solutions that fit.
  • A bias toward action and solid problem-solving instincts in fast-moving sales cycles.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with JavaScript, Python, or SQL for light technical validation, data exploration, or integration work.
  • Background in marketing technology, CDPs, or customer engagement platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) and how to use them to move faster.
  • Experience with ecommerce technology stacks such as Shopify, Magento, or custom storefronts.
  • Experience working with partners or consultancies that serve SMB customers.

What Sets You Apart

  • You've used AI to genuinely scale your effectiveness, whether that's through automation, research, demo prep, or light development.
  • You roll up your sleeves and become the expert on whatever you need to know.
  • You bring competitive intelligence into deals without it feeling like a script.
  • You contribute to the team through the assets, playbooks, and feedback you leave behind.
  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment and don't need everything mapped out to get started.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Technical win rate and contribution to overall win rate in the Commercial segment.
  • Quality and consistency of solution designs and handoffs to implementation and Customer Success teams.
  • Impact on repeatable assets, team enablement, and process improvements for the broader go-to-market team.
  • Feedback quality delivered back to Product and GTM on segment-specific needs.

At Klaviyo, we're Built Different: a company of builders who take ownership, operate with candor, and believe we're 1% done. That extends to how we tell our own story, both inside and out.

We're seeking a Senior Employer Brand Specialist to own recruitment marketing execution across every channel candidates meet us in: social, our career site, and job boards. You'll bring Klaviyo's employer brand narrative to life in the channels that matter for hiring – turning strategy defined by our Internal Communications team into campaigns, content, and a career site experience that actually convert.

This role reports into the Internal Communications team and partners closely with them on Klaviyo's broader employer brand narrative. You own bringing that story to candidates: the channels, the campaigns, and the performance behind them. You'll also be the person with the closest read on the market and our own hiring funnel, and you'll use that to help shape what the team writes about next, not just execute what's already decided.

We need someone who's built recruitment marketing or employer brand programs before and can set the operating model, not just run one someone else has already defined.

The ideal candidate is an experienced recruitment marketer who's comfortable owning a budget and vendor relationships, producing content and lightweight design work, and using performance data to sharpen what's working. You'll have real latitude to run channels and a budget, and you'll be looked to for judgment on how this function should operate day to day.

How You'll Make a Difference

  • Own recruitment marketing strategy execution across channels: social, career site, and job boards.
  • Bring an established point of view on how recruitment marketing should run here, since this function is new to the team. Set the operating rhythm rather than waiting for one to be defined for you.
  • Analyze what's happening in the market and within Talent Acquisition — hiring trends, candidate sentiment, competitive employer brand moves, and funnel data — and partner with the internal communications and experience teams to help shape what we write about and when.

title: Senior Machine Learning Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:

At Klaviyo, we believe the future of software lies not in productivity tools for human users but in software that can run and optimize itself based on outcome or reward metrics. We’ve built the infrastructure and application that serve as the interface between businesses and consumers. We now have over 167,000 customers, billions of consumer profiles, and hundreds of billions of customer messages and follow-on conversion data. We are building state-of-the-art AI and machine learning technologies at Klaviyo to power Composer, as well as personalization products such as smart send time, audience optimization and product recommendations.

As a Senior Machine Learning Platform Engineer, you will help build the core platforms, tools, and infrastructure that ML and AI engineers rely on to create advanced agents and models powering Klaviyo’s products. You will drive key technical initiatives for training and deploying models, unifying and standardizing feature data, and scaling systems that must operate reliably at Klaviyo’s data and traffic scale.

This is a backend-heavy, hands-on technical individual contributor role. You will lead technical execution, conduct code and design reviews, author high-impact code for critical system paths, and collaborate closely with product, ML, data science, and infrastructure partners to deliver durable, high-leverage platforms that accelerate AI development across Klaviyo.

This role is based in Boston.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Enable AI / ML teams across Klaviyo to ship new models and ML-powered features faster, more safely, and more reliably.
  • Evolve our ML and LLM platform architecture so teams can build, evaluate, and operate production ML systems with consistent patterns and best practices.
  • Improve reliability, observability, and cost efficiency of ML training, inference, and other ML workloads that serve features like smart send time, audience optimization and product recommendations.
  • Raise the bar on engineering and operational excellence for systems that support 167K+ customers and billions of events.
  • Architect and scale systems supporting feature storage and real-time retrieval for training and inference datasets

What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with AI & ML application teams to design seamless workflows for continuous model training, inference, and monitoring
  • Lead technical execution, conduct code and design reviews, and author high-impact code for critical system paths.
  • Mentor engineers across the organization, promoting engineering excellence, best practices, and strong design standards.
  • Drive architectural design and technical direction for core components of the ML and Feature platforms.
  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define the ML Platform roadmap.

Learn more about the team’s work in our blogs on Ray Jobs & Ray Tune.

Who You Are

We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not meet all the qualifications listed. ML Platform and MLOps are rapidly evolving spaces and we are all constantly learning.

  • 7+ years of experience as a software engineer, ML platform engineer, or similar, building backend or distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and launching AI/ML systems in production at scale
  • Strong proficiency in Python (or a similar backend language such as Go, Java, or Scala).
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and platform fundamentals (AWS, kubernetes):
  • Familiarity with data-intensive systems: streaming or batch processing, data modeling, and designing systems with large-scale data in mind (spark, ray-data).
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional technical partners (ML, product, infra, security).
  • Strong communication skills and a track record of driving technical excellence across teams.

What to Expect in Your First 90 Days

30 Days

  • Complete Klaviyo boot camp and onboarding for the AI & Analytics organization.
  • Build strong context on our AI/ML stack, platform components, and roadmap.
  • Meet your team, engineering peers, and key stakeholders across product, ML, infra, and security.
  • Onboard to existing technical workstreams and gain familiarity with production ML deployment pipelines.

60 Days

  • Deliver high-impact architectural enhancements or core features across the ML Platform end-to-end.
  • Conduct deep technical dives into platform architecture and mentor peers through detailed code and design reviews.
  • Partner with staff/principal engineers and product leaders to establish technical standards and design patterns for feature platform components.
  • Partner with product and technical leaders to shape the next 2–3 quarters of roadmap at a high level.

90 Days

  • Own accountability for delivery, reliability, and operational health of key ML Platform systems in your area.
  • Have multiple features or platform capabilities shipped that are in active use by ML/AI product teams.
  • Participate fully in on-call and incident management for your team’s services.
  • Contribute to broader AI/ML strategy and platform direction, influencing how Klaviyo builds and operates models at scale.

About the role

Klaviyo is a public company with more than $1.5 billion in annual revenue. Enterprise is our fastest growing segment, where global brands are consolidating their marketing and customer data onto Klaviyo and spending over seven figures a year with us. We have expanded beyond retail into hospitality, media, healthcare, and business services.

You will go after some of the largest brands in the world, including Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, prospecting your way in and taking full responsibility for your pipeline target.

Most of these companies run separate tools for email, SMS, customer data, and service. We win by bringing it all onto one platform and getting the customer to results faster. Once they are live, you will keep growing the account and lead the renewal.

What you will do

  • Prospect your own territory. Research every account, find a way in, and build relationships where Klaviyo has none today. BDR, marketing, and partner leads add to the pipeline you build.
  • Be the CEO of your territory. Build a plan for every named account, create and prospect into a relationship map, and pull in solutions engineering, value management, partners, and marketing at the right time.
  • Run business-value discovery. Find the real problem, put a number on it with the customer, and build a business case for the full platform that their finance team will support.
  • Sell to the full buying committee. Get to the CMO, CFO, CIO or CDO. Build champions and test them.

  • Close and forecast with discipline. Run the mutual action plan, security and legal review, and procurement. Forecast against what the customer has agreed to.
  • Grow and renew. Expand into more products and teams, spot risk early, and negotiate renewals that make room for growth.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in enterprise software sales, with 7+ years selling to C-level executives from a field sales position
  • A proven hunter who has built pipeline from scratch through your own research and outreach, and closed new logos from it
  • Experience selling into organizations above $1B in revenue
  • A track record of closing annual contracts of $1M or more

Travel

descriptionHtml:

About the team and role:

Klaviyo’s Internal Audit (IA) function leverages industry best practices and adds value by developing consultative partnerships with operational leaders throughout the organization to monitor and improve internal controls, processes, and drive operating efficiencies. We’re building an AI-first audit function, using AI and automation across the audit lifecycle. Klaviyo is looking for an experienced Manager, IT SOX who will lead our IT SOX program and technology audits. This person will report to the VP of Internal Audit & Compliance, manage and coach the Sr. IT Internal Auditor day to day, and work directly with key stakeholders across IT, Security, Business Intelligence, Finance, Accounting, Legal, People Operations, Engineering & Global Technology Solutions within the company. The primary focus of the role is IT SOX controls (including IT General Controls, IT application controls, and key reports) across our homegrown and third-party systems, along with leading risk-based technology audits. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who develops others, uses AI in their day-to-day work, thrives on building companies and enjoys working in an exciting, fast paced and evolving environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Day-to-day management and coaching of the Sr. IT Internal Auditor, including setting priorities, reviewing workpapers, and providing feedback and development
  • Oversight of co-sourced IT testing, including review of workpapers for quality and consistency

How you'll make a difference:

IT SOX program

  • Own the annual IT SOX plan, including risk assessment, scoping of in-scope systems, and alignment with our external auditor on reliance and timing
  • Scale and rationalize IT SOX scope as Klaviyo’s systems and business evolve
  • Lead end-to-end execution of the IT SOX program across ITGCs (logical access, change management including CI/CD, IT operations), IT application controls, system interfaces and integrations, key reports/IPE, and segregation of duties (SOD), across homegrown applications and third-party SaaS
  • Maintain the ITGC risk and control matrix within Optro, our SOX project management system
  • Review SOC 1 reports, complementary user entity controls, and bridge letters for in-scope vendors
  • Evaluate IT deficiencies, including root cause and severity, and drive remediation with control owners through closure
  • Coordinate with co-sourced third party providers, external auditors, and internal business partners to ensure alignment and timely execution of IT SOX work
  • Provide ongoing SOX readiness advisory to business partners on new system implementations and significant changes, including SDLC controls, while maintaining IA’s independence from implementing or operating controls
  • Train and enable control owners on IT SOX expectations
  • Provide regular status reporting on IT SOX progress, risks, and remediation to IA leadership and key stakeholders
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

Technology audits

  • Lead risk-based technology audits (e.g., cloud security, cybersecurity, data governance, AI governance), with accountability for planning, scoping, execution, and reporting
  • Contribute to the IT audit plan, with the opportunity to own it over time

AI-enabled audit

  • Set standards for how the team uses AI across the audit lifecycle, including how AI-assisted work is reviewed, validated, and documented so our external auditor can rely on it
  • Build reusable prompts, workflows, and automations, and coach the Sr. IT Internal Auditor on building and using them
  • Support automated control testing and continuous monitoring, using SQL or Python for full-population analysis where it adds value
  • Assess the risks of AI tools and agents in the financial reporting environment, including access, data handling, and change management
  • Advise on control design for AI-driven processes, including AI agents and automated workflows that affect financial reporting
  • Monitor and stay current on technical literature, emerging trends and best practices in IT audit and AI

Who you are:

  • A hands-on leader who coaches and develops others: sets clear priorities, gives direct and timely feedback, and reviews work for quality
  • An AI-fluent auditor who can share concrete examples of using AI to do audit work faster or better, and who understands its limits (accuracy, confidentiality, over-reliance)
  • Curious about how AI is reshaping both the risks we audit and how we audit them
  • Strong understanding of SOX 404, PCAOB Auditing Standards, COSO 2013, COBIT, US GAAP, and Internal Audit Standards
  • Deep understanding of ITGCs, IT application controls, interfaces, key reports, segregation of duties, and SOC 1 reviews for homegrown and off the shelf applications and cloud environments (e.g., AWS)
  • Experience auditing modern engineering environments, including CI/CD pipelines, access defined in code, and automated data pipelines
  • Experience leading planning, scoping, testing and reporting for a full year IT SOX program
  • Experience leading technology audits (e.g., cloud, cybersecurity, data governance)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to drive influence and to discuss technical concepts to other stakeholders in a simple but informative manner
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with great attention to details, and an investigative mindset to get to the root cause
  • Excellent project management skills with cross functional teams
  • Data analytics skills with experience in SQL, Python, Tableau, or any other data analytics or visualization tools
  • Experience in using SOX GRC tools such as Optro (formerly AuditBoard) and ERP systems e.g. NetSuite is strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of AI governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) or AI audit credentials (e.g., ISACA AAIA) is a plus
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high growth environment

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Business, or other relevant field
  • 8+ years of IT audit experience in public accounting (i.e. Big 4 Accounting firms) and/or industry, including IT SOX controls testing, ideally in a Tech/SaaS environment
  • Experience managing or coaching auditors and/or co-sourced resources
  • Professional audit relevant certification - CISA preferred; CPA, CIA, or CISSP a plus

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Occasional travel

title: Global Mobility and Immigration Program Lead
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Klaviyo is growing fast, and our people are moving with it: across borders, across offices, and sometimes across the world. You’ll run the global mobility program that makes that possible. That includes visas, relocations, secondments, and international assignments. You’ll be the go-to expert on the compliance side and the friendly face for every Klaviyo who’s about to uproot their life. The goal is a program that’s airtight on the guardrails and feels easy and human to the people going through it.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Build the program. You are the subject matter expert for Klaviyo on all things mobility and immigration. You’ll partner with leadership to design the program and advise on best practices - understanding risk and balancing compliance with laws, regulations, policies, and procedures, etc. All while providing a remarkable experience for all of our Klaviyos.
  • Own immigration end to end. Drive US visa petitions from kickoff to approval. You will be the connective tissue between internal stakeholders, outside counsel, and Klaviyo teammates. You will stay up to date on federal, state, and local HR, compensation laws. Handling time sensitive documentation and data across various processes.
  • Keep things moving. Monitor the evolving immigration landscape and track relevant updates for our employee base so that work statuses stay compliant - but more importantly to get ahead of questions our teammates will inevitably have. We want you to weigh the risks at hand, shaping the strategy for each case, and communicating with our employee population about what this means for them.
  • Manage vendors. Partner with relocation and service partners to deliver a smooth move for employees and their families. We want you to be the go-to person that our teammates trust during a big move. 
  • Use mobility to grow our people. Develop a process for US and international assignments, with career development as the north star. You will help teammates stretch into new roles and markets, bring those skills back, and give the business a deeper global bench. 

What we are looking for:

  • 8+ years in corporate immigration and/or global mobility. Corporate relocation experience is a plus.
  • Understanding of the tax side of mobility and employment well enough to spot issues early.
  • Someone who communicates clearly in writing and in conversation, whether you’re explaining a visa timeline to an employee or a risk tradeoff to the leadership team.
  • A self-starter who’s comfortable in a fast-moving, scrappy environment. You move quickly without cutting corners on accuracy or data integrity.
  • A strong project, program, and vendor manager who prioritizes well and delegates when it makes sense.
  • Customer-service energy. You like making people’s lives easier, even when the situation is stressful.
  • Handling of sensitive information with discretion, tact, and integrity. 
  • Other related duties, as assigned.

Klaviyo’s Internal Audit (IA) function leverages industry best practices and adds value by developing consultative partnerships with operational leaders throughout the organization to monitor and improve internal controls, processes, and drive operating efficiencies. We’re building an AI-first audit function, using AI and automation across the audit lifecycle. Klaviyo is looking for an experienced Manager, IT SOX who will lead our IT SOX program and technology audits. This person will report to the VP of Internal Audit & Compliance, manage and coach the Sr. IT Internal Auditor day to day, and work directly with key stakeholders across IT, Security, Business Intelligence, Finance, Accounting, Legal, People Operations, Engineering & Global Technology Solutions within the company. The primary focus of the role is IT SOX controls (including IT General Controls, IT application controls, and key reports) across our homegrown and third-party systems, along with leading risk-based technology audits. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who develops others, uses AI in their day-to-day work, thrives on building companies and enjoys working in an exciting, fast paced and evolving environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Day-to-day management and coaching of the Sr. IT Internal Auditor, including setting priorities, reviewing workpapers, and providing feedback and development
  • Oversight of co-sourced IT testing, including review of workpapers for quality and consistency

How you'll make a difference:

IT SOX program

  • Own the annual IT SOX plan, including risk assessment, scoping of in-scope systems, and alignment with our external auditor on reliance and timing
  • Scale and rationalize IT SOX scope as Klaviyo’s systems and business evolve
  • Lead end-to-end execution of the IT SOX program across ITGCs (logical access, change management including CI/CD, IT operations), IT application controls, system interfaces and integrations, key reports/IPE, and segregation of duties (SOD), across homegrown applications and third-party SaaS

  • Train and enable control owners on IT SOX expectations

  • Build reusable prompts, workflows, and automations, and coach the Sr. IT Internal Auditor on building and using them
  • Support automated control testing and continuous monitoring, using SQL or Python for full-population analysis where it adds value
  • Assess the risks of AI tools and agents in the financial reporting environment, including access, data handling, and change management

  • Monitor and stay current on technical literature, emerging trends and best practices in IT audit and AI

  • A hands-on leader who coaches and develops others: sets clear priorities, gives direct and timely feedback, and reviews work for quality
  • An AI-fluent auditor who can share concrete examples of using AI to do audit work faster or better, and who understands its limits (accuracy, confidentiality, over-reliance)
  • Curious about how AI is reshaping both the risks we audit and how we audit them
  • Strong understanding of SOX 404, PCAOB Auditing Standards, COSO 2013, COBIT, US GAAP, and Internal Audit Standards
  • Deep understanding of ITGCs, IT application controls, interfaces, key reports, segregation of duties, and SOC 1 reviews for homegrown and off the shelf applications and cloud environments (e.g., AWS)
  • Experience auditing modern engineering environments, including CI/CD pipelines, access defined in code, and automated data pipelines
  • Experience leading planning, scoping, testing and reporting for a full year IT SOX program
  • Experience leading technology audits (e.g., cloud, cybersecurity, data governance)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to drive influence and to discuss technical concepts to other stakeholders in a simple but informative manner
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with great attention to details, and an investigative mindset to get to the root cause
  • Excellent project management skills with cross functional teams

  • Working knowledge of AI governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) or AI audit credentials (e.g., ISACA AAIA) is a plus
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high growth environment

  • 8+ years of IT audit experience in public accounting (i.e. Big 4 Accounting firms) and/or industry, including IT SOX controls testing, ideally in a Tech/SaaS environment
  • Experience managing or coaching auditors and/or co-sourced resources

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Personalization
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

About the team and role:

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the core narrative and innovation for Klaviyo Personalization, which helps brands turn first-party customer data into more relevant, higher-converting experiences across every channel. Personalization combines predictive models and AI, including Predicted CLV, RFM, Next Best Product, personalized send time, audience optimization, and personalized content and offers, and puts them to work in segments, flows, and campaigns. As Klaviyo leads the shift to AI-driven, autonomous marketing, Personalization is a key differentiator and growth priority.

You’ll be the dedicated PMM partner to the Personalization product team. You’ll shape the roadmap with market and customer insight, lead launches that drive adoption, attach, and revenue, and turn complex data science into clear, compelling value for marketers and executives. You’ll work closely with Platform PMM, Integrated Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Enablement, and GTM Ops to bring it to market.

If you love making complex technology simple, thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, and want to show how intelligent, personalized experiences drive growth, this role is built for you.

How you'll make a difference:

  • Positioning & Storytelling: Define the value proposition, messaging, and positioning for Personalization and its place in Klaviyo’s broader platform and AI narrative.
  • Product Launches: Lead go-to-market strategy and launch plans for new features and packaging, aligning Product, Sales, Customer Success, Enablement, Integrated Marketing, Support, and GTM Ops.
  • Packaging & Pricing: Partner with Product on how Personalization is packaged relative to the core platform, making it easy to buy, sell, and expand.
  • Roadmap Influence: Be the voice of the customer and market with Product; synthesize research, beta feedback, win/loss data, and field input to shape priorities.
  • Adoption & Revenue Growth: Develop campaigns, proof points, ROI models, and cross-sell playbooks that drive attach, usage, and retention.
  • Sales Enablement: Build GTM assets (decks, one-pagers, ROI calculators, demos, training) and serve as the Personalization SME for Sales, Customer Success, and Partners.
  • Customer Evidence & Thought Leadership: Develop customer stories, benchmarks, and data-driven content that show the impact of personalization, and represent Klaviyo at events and with analysts and press.
  • Measurement: Define success metrics for launches and programs, report on results, and iterate.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned to support the K:Marketing PMM organization and the Personalization business.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS product marketing, with a track record of leading successful product launches from positioning through adoption.
  • Experience marketing data-, analytics-, or AI/ML-driven products, and the ability to turn technical concepts into clear, differentiated messaging for marketers and executives.
  • Marketing technology and/or e-commerce experience is a significant plus.
  • Examples of great positioning and messaging that cut through the noise and differentiated your product or service.
  • Know what great work looks like: you bring proven launch frameworks and playbooks, and know when to create your own to move fast.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data to size opportunities, measure impact, and tell a persuasive story.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, including with senior leaders.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and influence skills; able to lead without authority across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Curiosity about customers and a passion for going deep into a technical product.
  • Love and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least five years of related experience required, including product marketing at a software company.
  • Experience with sales enablement and working with Sales and Customer Success teams is preferred.
  • Experience with AI/ML, analytics, CDP, or marketing automation products is preferred.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS product marketing, sales enablement, or field marketing, with experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Proven track record of building sales plays, programs, and enablement that measurably improved field performance.
  • Experience working directly with sales and customer success teams, and credibility with sellers and CSMs.
  • Experience building enablement for, or marketing through, channel or ecosystem partners is a plus.
  • Marketing technology and/or e-commerce experience is a plus.
  • Strong analytical mindset: able to translate pipeline, revenue, adoption, and usage data into practical strategy.
  • Clear communicator who simplifies complex products into business value.
  • Influential cross-functional partner who can drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Strong program management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize across many stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.
  • Self-starter with an owner mindset, accountable for business results and not only deliverables.
  • Love and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least five years of related experience required, including product marketing, sales enablement, or field marketing at a software company.
  • Experience with sales and CS enablement platforms and CRM tools is preferred.

title: Lead IT Program Manager
descriptionHtml:

About the team

Klaviyo's Corporate IT team, part of Global Technology Solutions (GTS), provides technology systems, administration, and support to Klaviyos worldwide. Our goal is to give every Klaviyo a strong technology foundation to do great work. We solve problems with technology, embrace automation and AI, and support Klaviyo's continued scalability in a rapidly evolving environment.

Corporate IT brings together IT Support (SearchBar), IT Systems, IT Network, and IT Strategy & Operations. Our team works with modern DevOps practices and is moving toward configuration as code, infrastructure as code, and automating everything it can. The IT Strategy & Operations team develops and refines our work management systems, drives organizational change, coordinates cross-functional programs, and aligns Corporate IT initiatives with the broader GTS vision, working closely with every Corporate IT team, Information Security, and the broader Klaviyo organization.

About the role

As a Lead IT Program Manager, you will be the operational backbone of Corporate IT. You will deliver our largest cross-functional initiatives, own how we plan and prioritize our portfolio, run our OKR process, and make the team run better through consistent Agile practices, continuous process improvement, and strong vendor management. You are AI-first in how you work: you use AI every day to move faster and help the teams around you do the same. You will report to the Director of Corporate IT and partner with IT leaders, Engineering, Security, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Business Operations.

How you'll have an impact

Lead our largest strategic initiatives

  • Own end-to-end delivery of key, large-scale, cross-functional programs across IT Support, IT Systems, and IT Network: scope, plan, coordinate supporting teams, track progress, and adjust schedule and resourcing to meet business objectives.
  • Partner with IT Systems on programs that use DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code and automation, understanding the concepts well enough to plan realistically, spot risks, and represent the work to leadership.
  • Perform risk analysis, build contingency plans, and proactively raise critical issues so leaders can make timely prioritization and trade-off decisions.
  • Establish success metrics for each program and report on adoption, delivery, and business impact.
  • Lead vendor evaluation and selection: gather requirements, run RFI/RFP processes, define scoring criteria, coordinate demos and proofs of concept, and make build-vs-buy recommendations.
  • Work with Procurement, Accounting, Security and Legal to manage program budgets and contingencies.

Own OKRs and contribute to IT strategy

  • Partner with the Director of Corporate IT to establish quarterly objectives and key results (OKRs) for Corporate IT, aligned with GTS and company goals.
  • Run the quarterly OKR cadence: drafting and alignment with team leads, regular check-ins, scoring, and retrospectives.
  • Track and report progress on OKRs to Corporate IT and GTS leadership, highlighting what is on track, at risk, and needs a decision.
  • Support strategic planning, including roadmaps, annual and quarterly planning cycles, and leadership and cross-functional communications.

Own and optimize the IT portfolio

  • Partner with IT leadership to manage and influence the backlog: project selection, intake, prioritization, and a healthy pipeline of future work.
  • Lead and grow the portfolio structure in Linear so every project traces back to an OKR or strategic opportunity.
  • Lead capacity planning across Corporate IT and analyze trends across projects, tying work back to goals.

Mature Agile practices and Drive process improvements

  • Own Agile ways of working across Corporate IT: define and align practices for planning, sprint and Kanban cadences, estimation, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and definition of done.
  • Coach teams and leads on Agile principles, tailoring practices to each team's type of work (project, operations, and support) rather than imposing one model.
  • Help drive our migration from Jira to Linear, and configure and evolve workflows, views, and metrics (velocity, cycle time, throughput) so teams and leaders have a consistent, trustworthy view of work.
  • Lead improvement initiatives from idea to adoption, including documentation, change management, and measuring results.

Lead with AI

  • Use AI daily to run programs: drafting plans and status reports, synthesizing meetings and decisions, analyzing portfolio and OKR data, and surfacing risks earlier.
  • Build AI-assisted and automated workflows for program operations, such as automated status reporting, backlog hygiene, intake triage, and OKR tracking, to remove manual work.
  • Champion AI adoption across Corporate IT processes: identify high-value use cases, pilot them with teams, and share playbooks for what works.
  • Model responsible use of AI, including privacy, security, and human-in-the-loop review.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of experience in program or project management, operational leadership, or strategic consulting, ideally in IT, infrastructure, or technical environments.
  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing and coaching Agile practices (Scrum, Kanban) across multiple teams, with the judgment to adapt them pragmatically to different kinds of work.
  • Experience establishing, running, and reporting on OKRs or a similar goal-setting framework with senior leaders.
  • Track record of leading process improvement: diagnosing inefficiencies, redesigning workflows, and driving adoption.
  • Experience scoping, planning, and delivering large, multi-team technical programs, including programs with budgets over $1M and close work with finance and procurement.
  • Working understanding of DevOps and CI/CD concepts (such as infrastructure as code and automated deployments) and how they shape planning and delivery. Hands-on experience is not required.
  • Experience leading vendor evaluations and RFP processes, through contract and performance management.
  • AI-native way of working: you use AI tools (LLM assistants, AI search, agents) every day and can show concrete examples of how they changed how you plan, communicate, and deliver.
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or automations (for example, prompts, agents, or low-code automation) to remove manual work for yourself and your teams.
  • Excellent communicator who balances persuasiveness with active listening, and can tailor messaging from engineers to executives.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you can lead cross-functional work with loosely defined plans and objectives, shift priorities, and bring others along.
  • Strong hands-on experience with a modern Agile work management tool (Linear, Jira, or similar). Linear experience is a plus.

Nice to have

  • PMP, Agile (PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe), or Lean/process improvement certification.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS ecosystems (Okta, Slack, Workday, Jamf), network programs, or security and compliance programs.
  • Familiarity with low-code automation or workflow tools.
  • Experience mentoring or informally leading other project managers.

descriptionHtml:

Software Engineer, Conversational Products & Agent Workflows
Customer Agent

About the Role

At Klaviyo, we believe the future of software lies not only in tools that help people work more efficiently, but in intelligent systems that can take action, learn from outcomes, and improve customer experiences over time.

Klaviyo serves more than 167,000 customers and processes billions of consumer profiles, messages, interactions, and conversion signals. This creates a unique opportunity to build state-of-the-art AI systems that help businesses create and execute better customer experiences at scale.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer, Conversational Products & Agent Workflows to join the Customer Agent team, Klaviyo’s AI-native conversational platform. You’ll help build scalable backend systems and AI-powered product experiences that enable agents to retrieve context, use tools, and take reliable action on behalf of customers.

This is a backend-heavy role with opportunities to contribute to user-facing experiences. You’ll independently own meaningful pieces of larger systems, contribute to technical decisions, and continue developing your depth across backend engineering, applied AI, and production reliability.

How You Will Make a Difference

  • Build and improve reliable backend systems and APIs that power AI-driven customer experiences.
  • Develop production agentic features involving tool use, context management, retrieval, structured outputs, orchestration, and multi-step workflows.
  • Contribute to solving applied AI problems across retrieval and RAG, grounding, hallucination mitigation, model selection, and choosing between LLM-based, deterministic, or hybrid approaches.
  • Build and use evaluation approaches including representative datasets, automated and human evaluation, regression testing, qualitative error analysis, and production signals.
  • Improve system reliability through guardrails, retries, fallbacks, observability, monitoring, and thoughtful failure handling.
  • Build asynchronous and distributed processing workflows that support AI workloads at scale.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and help diagnose, mitigate, and learn from production incidents.
  • Work with external customers and cross-functional partners to understand workflows, identify pain points, and translate feedback into product improvements.
  • Monitor shipped experiences and use quality metrics, system performance, and customer feedback to guide iteration.

Who You Are

  • You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with experience building backend systems or distributed applications.
  • You have hands-on experience building or contributing to generative AI or agentic AI applications, ideally used by real users or in production environments.
  • You are proficient in Python and have experience with modern backend frameworks such as FastAPI or Django.
  • You have experience with asynchronous processing or distributed task/event systems such as Celery, Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ, or Redis.
  • You have working knowledge of databases, data modeling, APIs, and persistence patterns used in production systems.
  • You are comfortable working in cloud environments and have experience with technologies such as AWS, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, or CI/CD systems.
  • You can reason about tradeoffs among quality, latency, cost, reliability, and implementation complexity, and know when to seek additional technical context.
  • You are comfortable working through ambiguity, breaking larger problems into smaller pieces, and making progress without every requirement being fully specified.
  • You have experience with, or strong interest in, working directly with external customers to understand problems and improve products.
  • You care about shipping useful, reliable products and are motivated to deepen your engineering judgment in a rapidly evolving technical space.

Nice to Have

  • Experience training, fine-tuning, distilling, or otherwise adapting machine learning or language models.
  • Experience with reinforcement learning or feedback-driven optimization.
  • Experience with evaluation infrastructure such as LLM-as-judge systems, evaluator calibration, benchmark datasets, or AI quality tooling.
  • Experience operating AI systems at meaningful production scale or optimizing inference cost, latency, or throughput.

title: Order to Cash Track Lead, Finance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

At Klaviyo, we know that building a great company starts with building a great team. We welcome candidates from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we care as much about your trajectory and potential as we do about direct, one‑to‑one matches with every requirement.

About the team

Klaviyo went public in 2023 and is scaling fast. This is a rare chance to lead and build the Order to Cash (O2C) foundation for a company at this inflection point. The Finance Technology Systems team is part of G&A Systems within Global Technology Solutions (GTS). This group designs, operates, and continually improves the applications and workflows that power how Klaviyo manages money, risk, and financial reporting at scale.

The team partners closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Internal Audit, as well as adjacent technology teams like Corporate IT, Data, and GTM Systems, to ensure our back‑office stack is reliable, well‑integrated, compliant, and ready for a public, AI‑forward SaaS business. We own the roadmap, health, and governance of platforms including our ERP and financial systems (e.g., NetSuite/Oracle), procure‑to‑pay (e.g., Coupa), revenue and billing systems, and related integrations and automation.

This role reports to the Director, G&A Systems and leads the team responsible for Finance Technology Solutions across Klaviyo.

What You'll Do

As the Order to Cash (O2C) Lead, Finance Systems, you will be the accountable technology leader for Klaviyo’s O2C application landscape and core financial workflows. You will lead Enterprise and International Expansion capabilities that will provide revenue uplift for Klaviyo.

Own the O2C track

  • Execute on the roadmap for Klaviyo’s O2C stack aligned to the company priorities by translating business requirements into functional and technical design. Bring first principles thinking to your design.
  • Integrate CPQ to NetSuite and ensure that all Enterprise capabilities are delivered with scale.
  • Look at O2C systems landscape and provide recommendations to set Klaviyo for the future
  • Ensure we deliver with the highest code quality by thoroughly thinking through test cases and applying rigorous build and test.

Own SOX, controls, and audit readiness for Finance systems

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of IT General Controls (ITGCs) and other key controls across O2C applications, in partnership with Internal Audit, Security, and external auditors.
  • Continually simplify and automate controls and evidence collection so audits are reliable and predictable, with fewer deficiencies and lower friction for Finance and GTS teams.

Drive AI-native transformation across Finance 

  • Lead Klaviyo's push to make Finance one of the most automated, insight-driven functions in the company. You'll identify and deliver high-value AI use cases across the O2C workflow. 
  • You'll partner directly with Klaviyo's AI and data platform teams and Finance Engineering  to embed AI into core Finance processes with clear guardrails, measurable productivity gains, and the rigor expected of a public company. This isn't a future-state vision, it's work already underway, and you'll own it from a Product standpoint.

Design and optimize core Finance processes and systems

  • Have a leader mindset and partner with Controllership, Tax, Treasury  leaders to improve and continuously refine end‑to‑end O2C workflows ensuring systems and processes are tightly aligned.
  • Ensure our ERP and other SaaS O2C applications are configured, integrated, and operated to support accurate, timely close, scalable revenue and billing, and high‑quality financial data that downstream teams can trust.

Act as a strategic partner and communicator

  • Serve as the primary technology partner for Controller, and Finance leadership team on systems, data, and process topics; 
  • As needed, represent Finance Technology Systems in executive forums, planning cycles, and cross‑functional initiatives, ensuring O2C needs are anticipated and built into wider GTS and company roadmaps.

Who You Are

You've spent your career at the intersection of Finance and Technology and you've moved beyond just keeping systems running. You think in product design, roadmaps, outcomes, and partnerships. You know what a well-run O2C  function looks like, and you know how to build one.

You've worked in  teams through real complexity: ERP and other transformations, SOX audits, billing system overhauls, or the messy work of integrating Finance systems across a growing company. You don't need a perfect environment to do great work, you create structure where there isn't any, and you bring Finance and engineering stakeholders along with you.

Specifically, you likely bring:

  • 10+ years in enterprise or business systems, with meaningful ownership of Finance technology at a tech or SaaS company; 4+ years in O2C, responsible for order-to cash

descriptionHtml:
