About the role

Klaviyo’s customers in Asia Pacific and Japan are growing fast, and this leader will build the customer success function that grows with them. You will own retention, adoption, expansion, and customer experience across the region, lead a team of managers and CSMs, helping to shape the global Customer Success strategy as a core member of the CS Senior Leadership Team. 

You will work directly with senior leaders, including the C-suite, on customer performance, trends, and risk. As a strategic leader, you will solve for both the customer experience and the employee experience. 

You build trust with customers and your team through humility and open-mindedness, and you give your team a clear vision, direction, and sense of purpose so they can help customers own their growth. 

Success is measured against retention, cross-sell, platform adoption, and advocacy for the APJ region.

You are collaborative and innovative, with a track record of relentless and effective execution. You use data to make decisions and want to tackle some of Klaviyo’s most challenging opportunities to improve the customer experience.

What you’ll do

Lead the region and the function

  • Be a core member of the Customer Success Senior Leadership Team, helping guide the future of the department and the wider business.
  • Work with CX leadership to set goals, objectives, execution plans, and team metrics, and make sure goals cascade to every CSM.
  • Review key metrics with CX leadership, covering highlights, lowlights, risks, and opportunities across your customer base.
  • Be a key leader in APJ, shaping the culture of the region and creating an inclusive team culture by leading with humility, integrity, and openness to feedback.
  • Develop a cost-efficient organization that maintains a high standard of excellence in customer support.

Build and develop your team

  • Manage multiple Customer Success teams, likely across more than one location, including hiring, performance management, and development.
  • Hire and develop managers, coaching them on effective 1:1s, team meetings, accountability, stretching top talent, and performance management.
  • Build a candidate pipeline and bring new talent into the organization with clear expectations.
  • Assign accounts and distribute work for optimal customer coverage and team balance.

Drive customer outcomes

  • Hold your teams accountable for KPIs on platform adoption, renewal, expansion, and advocacy, and set success metrics for ROI.
  • Guide your team in managing clients across the lifecycle, understanding their evolving business and technical goals, and continuously demonstrating value.
  • Keep the customer journey at the center of decisions and identify opportunities to improve and scale the customer experience, including mitigating customer risk at scale.
  • Act as an escalation point for managers and customers across your portfolio.
  • Be a public presence for Klaviyo, building executive relationships with Economic Buyers and Champions in key accounts and representing Klaviyo at public events.
  • Advocate customer business use cases to Product development.

Partner across the business

  • Partner closely with senior Sales, Services, Support, Onboarding, Finance, Product, and Marketing leaders to align on customer experience and commercial outcomes, and build the upmarket and regional engagement model.
  • Influence and gain buy-in from others in sensitive situations without damaging relationships.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to design efficient processes and working practices, and drive continuous improvement in process, reporting, and materials.

Use data and AI

  • Use data and objective measures to make key business decisions, with visibility into cross-functional impact.
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Glean, ChatGPT) to strengthen complex account strategies, identify high-impact use cases, and share best practices.
  • Develop advanced prompt frameworks for complex, multi-step tasks, train team members on prompt strategy, and use predictive AI signals to inform renewal and expansion strategy.

Education and experience

  • 12+ years of experience, including 7+ years managing managers or team leads of a Customer Success team (CSM or Onboarding Specialists) in a high-growth SaaS company.
  • Experience in marketing or advising customers on marketing strategy. SaaS MarTech experience is a plus.
  • High school diploma required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.


Klaviyo in APAC

The Sydney team has been built out since 2022 across sales, CS, partnerships, marketing, recruiting and product support, with a growing Singapore presence. This is still an early-stage APAC business with significant headroom — a team established across the region today, and a leadership bench largely promoted from within.

You'd be joining at a genuinely formative moment: the country model for ANZ is new, the operating systems are being built now, and the person in this seat will shape how Klaviyo runs this market for years rather than inheriting someone else's design.

Senior Payroll Specialist – EMEA & APAC

📍Location: Dublin, Ireland | Hybrid (3 days per week in office)

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist to join our Global Payroll team and help deliver accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll across our growing international footprint.This role will have  primary responsibility for UK & Ireland payroll, while supporting additional EMEA and APAC countries through our global partners. Beyond day-to-day payroll delivery, we're looking for someone who brings strong payroll expertise, takes ownership, proactively identifies risks, and enjoys finding better ways of working.

You'll work closely with our International Payroll Lead and cross-functional partners to strengthen payroll controls, standardize processes, and support automation initiatives as we continue to scale our global operations.

What You’ll Do

Payroll Operations & Compliance

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing for the UK and Ireland, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.
  • Support payroll review and coordination across additional countries, including France, Germany, Switzerland, Singapore, and Australia, as assigned.
  • Review payroll inputs, calculations, variances, and final outputs to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Partner with CloudPay and local payroll providers to resolve discrepancies and manage payroll-related issues.
  • Support statutory reporting, tax compliance, and month-end and year-end payroll requirements.

Controls & Operational Excellence

  • Perform payroll reconciliations, validation checks, and documented controls.
  • Maintain accurate payroll records and audit-ready documentation.
  • Develop and maintain payroll SOPs, calendars, checklists, and country-specific process documentation.
  • Identify payroll risks, raise concerns proactively, and recommend solutions.
  • Support cross-training and backup coverage to ensure business continuity.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to simplify manual processes and improve payroll accuracy and efficiency.
  • Support automation initiatives using Workday, CloudPay, AI, and other available tools.
  • Help standardize payroll processes and controls across countries.
  • Participate in system enhancements, integrations, testing, and payroll-related projects.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with People Operations, Benefits, People Tech, Finance, and other internal partners.
  • Provide clear and timely communication on payroll matters, deadlines, risks, and resolutions.
  • Partner with the International Payroll Lead to support operational priorities and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing and process improvements.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of progressive payroll experience, ideally within a multinational organization.
  • Strong hands-on UK and Ireland payroll experience is essential.
  • Experience managing payroll across multiple countries and working with third-party payroll providers.
  • Strong understanding of payroll compliance, statutory reporting, reconciliations, and controls.
  • Experience with Workday and CloudPay or comparable HRIS and global payroll platforms.
  • Ability to independently manage payroll deadlines, investigate discrepancies, and resolve complex payroll issues.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance competing priorities.
  • Proactive mindset with a focus on process improvements and operational efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and regions.
  • Comfortable working in a changing environment and taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Nice to Have

  • Payroll experience in France, Germany, Switzerland, Singapore, or Australia.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, integrations, or transformation projects.
  • Experience developing payroll SOPs, controls, and standardized processes.
  • Familiarity with automation, AI tools, or data analytics within payroll operations.
  • Experience supporting internal or external payroll audits.

Why Join

  • Be part of a growing Global Payroll team supporting an expanding international business.
  • Take ownership of key international payroll operations while working alongside experienced payroll professionals.
  • Help shape how we improve and scale our global payroll processes.
  • Work with modern payroll technology and contribute to automation and innovation.
  • Build your expertise across multiple countries and develop your career within a collaborative global team.

Klaviyo is building an AI-first company—and that starts with how we support and scale our people.

We’re looking for a Senior Lead AI Finance Technology Engineer to be the first dedicated AI engineer within our Finance Technology (G&A FinTech) team. As an early leader in this space, you’ll reimagine how our Finance teams operate in an AI-first world by shaping our architecture, standards, and long-term vision.

You’ll partner across all Finance functions - Accounting, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Internal Audit, as well as adjacent technology teams like Corporate IT, Data, and GTM Systems, to ensure our back‑office stack is reliable, well‑integrated, compliant, and ready for a public, AI‑forward SaaS business. We own the roadmap, health, and governance of platforms including our ERP and financial systems (e.g., NetSuite/Oracle), procure‑to‑pay (e.g.,Zip), revenue and billing systems, and related integrations and automation. This role is not just about applying AI it’s about defining how AI becomes embedded into the Finance at Klaviyo.

What You’ll Be Doing

AI-First Finance Systems & Architecture

  • Reimagine core Finance workflows (accounting, procurement, deal desk approvals, revenue, ME/QE close cycle etc., ) through an AI-first lens, not just incremental automation
  • Design and build AI-powered workflows, copilots, and agents that automate and augment Finance processes
  • Architect and implement systems that integrate across SaaS such as NetSuite, Zip, Zone Advanced Billing, Avalara/Vertex to name a few
  • Partner with our internal IT AI team and establish best practices for:
    • Prompt engineering and evaluation
    • LLM system design and orchestration
    • Versioning, testing, security, and observability of AI systems
  • Enable AI Use Cases (copilots, assistants, automated workflows) that drive faster execution and better decision-making for Finance teams
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable AI solutions

Driving an AI-First Operating Model

  • Identify high-leverage opportunities to replace manual workflows with AI-native solutions
  • Define and track success metrics tied to efficiency gains, time savings, and operational effectiveness
  • Act as a thought partner to Finance leadership on what’s possible with AI, not just what’s requested
  • Responsible AI, Privacy & Governance: Design systems that handle sensitive financial data with security, privacy, and trust at the core

  • Enable Finance teams to leverage AI by building:
    • Reusable frameworks and workflows
    • Playbooks and training materials
  • Help non-technical stakeholders confidently use and iterate on AI-powered tools

Technical Leadership

  • Advocate for scalable, well-governed AI systems that integrate cleanly into Klaviyo’s broader tech ecosystem
  • Act as a key voice in shaping how Klaviyo becomes AI-first internally, starting with Finance systems

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Passion and Curiosity to experiment and reimagine Finance workflows
  • Minimum 5+ years of engineering or data engineering experience, with 2+ years building AI/ML or LLM-powered delivering tangible business outcomes
  • Proven ability to set technical direction and build 0→1 systems with meaningful organizational impact
  • Strong experience with but not limited to:
    • React, JSON, Python, SQL, and modern APIs
    • LLM platforms (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
    • Designing AI-powered workflows, agents, or copilots
    • Integrating to Finance Systems through Runlayer and MCPs
  • Experience integrating with enterprise Financial SaaS systems
  • Experience designing scalable and secure systems, automation frameworks, and internal tools
  • Experience working with sensitive data and implementing responsible AI practices
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable technical solutions

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Financial systems - NetSuite, Zip, Avalara/Vertex, Zone Advanced Billing  or equivalent systems
  • Familiarity with SOX & ITGCs
  • Familiarity with middleware automation platforms (e.g., n8n, Workato, Zapier)
  • Experience in high-growth SaaS environments
  • Contributions to AI governance, internal AI platforms, or experimentation frameworks

Why This Role Matters at Klaviyo

This is a foundational role in defining how Klaviyo becomes an AI-first company from the inside out.

You won’t just be implementing AI you’ll be:

  • Shaping how Finance  teams operate with AI
  • Defining standards for responsible, scalable internal AI systems
  • Building the blueprint for how AI is embedded across the business

If you’re excited about building from scratch, influencing across functions, and applying AI to core business workflows, this role offers a unique opportunity to have outsized impact.

Klaviyo's GTM Systems team builds and runs the systems that power marketing, sales, partnerships, customer success, and services. We're looking for a Lenior Technical Project Manager with 8+ years of experience delivering complex SaaS GTM and revenue systems programs, who understands both how the systems work and how the business runs on them, and who is excited to bring AI into how we plan, deliver, and operate.

About the team

Our GTM Systems team sits at the center of Klaviyo's GTM engine, connecting Salesforce, CPQ, billing and finance systems, customer success and support platforms, and professional services tooling. We own the roadmap that lets our teams move quickly, trust their data, and focus on helping customers grow. As we scale, we're rebuilding parts of that stack around AI and agentic workflows as the operating model, not a bolt-on experiment, and we need a program leader who can deliver that change reliably.

About the role

As Lead Technical Project Manager, you own delivery of our highest-impact, highest-complexity GTM systems programs from intake through hypercare. Think CPQ replacement, quote-to-cash changes, customer success and support platform upgrades, and AI-enabled workflows that cut across Sales, Customer Success, Services, Finance, and Internal Audit. You turn ambiguous business goals into clear plans, sequence work across many teams shipping into the same core systems, and keep leadership informed with an honest view of commitments, risks, and progress.

You'll work hands-on with business systems analysts, developers, architects, vendors, and finance and audit partners, and you'll regularly present to senior and executive leadership. You use AI yourself to run programs faster and better, and you help bring it into the way our teams work.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own program delivery end to end: intake, prioritization, scoping, sequencing, status, and operating cadence for a multi-quarter GTM systems roadmap, from discovery through launch and hypercare.
  • Lead cross-functional programs at scale: manage dependencies across Sales, Deal Desk, RevOps, Customer Success, Services, Finance, Legal, Security, and Engineering, including teams that don't report to you.
  • Drive technical decisions with engineers and architects: weigh trade-offs, build-vs-buy calls, integration patterns, and vendor evaluations, and make sure decisions are documented and defensible.
  • Deliver with controls built in: partner with Finance, Internal Audit, and Security on revenue-impacting systems work (SOX/ITGC, access, change management, audit traceability) so controls are designed in, tested, and evidenced.
  • Manage vendors and implementation partners: run joint project plans, steering committees, decision logs, and risk reviews, and hold partners to commitments.
  • Bring AI into GTM and into how we deliver: help scope and ship AI and agentic workflows into production, and use AI tooling to improve planning, status reporting, testing, and documentation.
  • Build the operating model: establish intake, planning, release management, and reporting practices that hold up as the portfolio grows, and mentor teammates on program craft.
  • Communicate with clarity: give GTM Systems, GTM, Finance, and executive leaders a crisp view of scope, timeline, cost, risk, and decisions needed, in the room and in writing.

What makes you a great fit

  • 8+ years of technical program or project management, business systems delivery, or GTM/revenue systems experience at a SaaS company, with a track record of owning large, multi-team programs end to end.
  • Deep working knowledge of GTM systems and processes: lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, renewals and amendments, customer success and support, and professional services delivery, and how objects, data, and approvals flow between Salesforce, CPQ, billing/ERP, contracting, and support tools.
  • Experience delivering in a Salesforce-centric environment where multiple teams ship into a shared core system on a common release process.
  • Experience partnering with finance, audit, or compliance functions on revenue-impacting systems and controls.
  • Strong technical fluency: you can read an architecture diagram, discuss integration and data-model trade-offs with developers, and spot delivery risk early.
  • Hands-on curiosity about AI: you use LLM tools in your own work, can talk credibly about where AI and agents help GTM workflows and where they need guardrails, and want to help teams adopt them responsibly.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication; comfortable driving outcomes through influence in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with CPQ implementations or replacements, quote-to-cash redesign, or billing/ERP integrations (for example NetSuite).
  • Experience with customer success, support, or services platforms (for example Gainsight, Zendesk, Certinia) and contracting tools (for example Ironclad).
  • Familiarity with SOX ITGC, revenue controls, or SOC reporting for vendor-hosted systems.
  • Experience standing up release management or CI/CD for a Salesforce org.
  • Exposure to agentic AI frameworks or MCP-based integrations in a business systems setting.
  • PMP, Salesforce, or similar certifications (or equivalent demonstrated experience).
  • Prior experience at a high-growth software or AI company.

Why this role matters at Klaviyo

  • Your programs directly affect how Klaviyo sells, bills, renews, and supports customers, with real visibility to senior GTM, Finance, and executive leadership.
  • You'll lead work that sits at the intersection of GTM systems, finance controls, and AI, a combination that is rare and increasingly valuable.
  • You'll help shape an AI-first delivery and operating model for GTM Systems, setting practices that outlast any single project.

descriptionHtml:

Klaviyo is building an AI-first company—and that starts with how we support and scale our people.

We’re looking for a Senior Integrations Engineer to manage our integrations within our Finance Technology (G&A FinTech) team. As an early leader in this space, you’ll reimagine how our Finance teams operate in an AI-first world by shaping our architecture, standards, and long-term vision.

You’ll partner across all Finance functions - Accounting, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Internal Audit, as well as adjacent technology teams like Corporate IT, Data, and GTM Systems, to ensure our back‑office stack is reliable, well‑integrated, compliant, and ready for a public, AI‑forward SaaS business. We own the roadmap, health, and governance of platforms including our ERP and financial systems (e.g., NetSuite/Oracle), procure‑to‑pay (e.g.,Zip), revenue and billing systems, and related integrations and automation. This role is not just about using integration platforms but with an AI & Automation mindset. 

What You’ll Be Doing

AI-First Finance Systems & Architecture

  • Design & Integrate using Workato supporting all  business critical projects
  • Support all business critical integrations resolving ME/QE and operational issues
  • Lead SOX audits and drive it to closure
  • Pursue other automation opportunities that elevate business productivity
  • Reimagine core Finance workflows (accounting, procurement, deal desk approvals, revenue, ME/QE close cycle etc., ) through an AI-first lens, not just incremental automation
  • Design and build AI-powered workflows, copilots, and agents that automate and augment Finance processes
  • Enable AI Use Cases (copilots, assistants, automated workflows) that drive faster execution and better decision-making for Finance teams
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable AI & Automation solutions

Driving an AI-First Operating Model

  • Identify high-leverage opportunities to replace manual workflows with Automation and AI-native solutions
  • Define and track success metrics tied to efficiency gains, time savings, and operational effectiveness
  • Partner with Internal Audit, Security, Legal, and Global IT to ensure compliant and ethical AI deployment

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work closely with Security, Global IT, and GTM Systems to align on shared infrastructure and standards
  • Enable Finance teams by democratizing Workato and to leverage AI by building:
    • Reusable frameworks and workflows
    • Playbooks and training materials
  • Help non-technical stakeholders confidently use and iterate Workato and other platform tools

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Passion and Curiosity to experiment and reimagine Order to Cash, Procure to Pay and Record to Report workflows
  • Minimum 5+ years of engineering or data engineering experience, with 2+ years building Workato, AI/ML or LLM-powered delivering tangible business outcomes
  • Proven ability to set technical direction and build 0→1 systems with meaningful organizational impact
  • Strong experience with but not limited to:
    • Workato or other comparable platform
    • Python, SQL, and modern APIs
    • LLM platforms (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
    • Designing AI-powered workflows, agents, or copilots
    • Integrating to Finance Systems through Runlayer and MCPs
  • Experience integrating with enterprise Financial SaaS systems
  • Experience designing scalable systems, automation frameworks, and internal tools
  • Experience working with sensitive data 
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable technical solutions

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Financial systems - NetSuite, Zip, Avalara/Vertex, Zone Advanced Billing  or equivalent systems
  • Familiarity with SOX & ITGCs
  • Familiarity with middleware automation platforms (e.g., n8n, Workato, Zapier)
  • Experience in high-growth SaaS environments
  • Contributions to AI governance, internal AI platforms, or experimentation frameworks

Why This Role Matters at Klaviyo

This is a foundational role in defining how Klaviyo becomes an AI-first company from the inside out.

You won’t just be implementing AI you’ll be:

  • Shaping how Finance  teams operate with AI
  • Defining standards for responsible, scalable internal AI systems
  • Building the blueprint for how AI is embedded across the business

If you’re excited about building from scratch, influencing across functions, and applying AI to core business workflows, this role offers a unique opportunity to have outsized impact.

descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. Full-time permanent contract

About the Team and Role

As an Associate Growth Specialist, you are the first human touchpoint for a high volume of inbound demo requests and free Klaviyo accounts. You provide fast, high‑quality first interactions with Klaviyo’s smallest accounts to create a seamless experience from first touch through purchase.

This team sits within the Marketing organization as part of the Growth motion and partners closely with Sales, Business Development, Product, and Customer Success. The primary goal of this role is to acquire as many high‑quality new logos as possible while maintaining an exceptional customer experience.

You will:

  • Field inbound demand (demos, trials, free accounts, and product inquiries) via phone, email, and other channels.
  • Run consultative, decision‑driven demos focused on one‑call closes whenever possible for smaller opportunities.
  • Do targeted business discovery to understand goals, urgency, and fit.
  • Qualify in or out efficiently, so you know where to double‑down and where to quickly move on.
  • Own and work a high‑velocity pipeline, using strong prioritization and time management to maximize new logo acquisition.

This role is a proven stepping stone into Account Executive and other closing roles in sales, while also opening doors into other go-to-market paths such as customer success, partnerships, marketing, enablement, or operations.

Your Impact

  • Drive new logo acquisition as a primary objective, maximising the number of high-quality new customers while maintaining an exceptional customer experience
  • Contribute to broader Growth team goals across free-to-paid conversion, logo count, ADS, and other core growth metrics
  • Navigate a high volume of incoming product and sales related inquiries via phone and email
  • Consult with customers to advise and design solutions based on ecommerce best practices and optimal utilization of Klaviyo’s platform to drive customer value
  • Conduct consultative qualification of prospects, and provide demonstrations of the platform
  • Identify and deliver best next steps and/or resources to persuade prospects to purchase and/or activate subscriptions
  • Collaborate cross-functionally and with marketing and sales management to improve our overall customer experience, including creating a structured feedback loop on product, web experience, onboarding experience, and other key customer touchpoints
  • Demonstrate substantive knowledge of e-commerce, SMS, and email marketing
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Who You Are

  • Fluent English AND German language skills (written and spoken), essential
  • 6 months+ business development experience within a SaaS environment, deal-closing experience a bonus
  • Comfortable operating in a fast paced, high volume environment where you're managing multiple conversations and priorities simultaneously
  • A natural communicator who genuinely enjoys talking to customers, understanding their needs and helping them make confident decisions
  • Consultative in your approach, you ask the right questions, listen well and can quickly identify where there is a fit and where there isn't.
  • Motivated by targets and energised by hitting and exceeding them 
  • A self starter who takes initiative, brings energy to the team and is always looking to learn and improve.
  • Proficient with Google Suite and Salesforce or similar a bonus

descriptionHtml:

Lead Product Data Scientist, Forecasting

About the Team

Klaviyo's Product Data Science team plays a critical role in shaping how we understand, measure, and improve business performance. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that inform product strategy, financial planning, and long-term growth.

As Klaviyo continues to scale its platform, expand its product portfolio, and introduce new AI-powered capabilities, the ability to accurately forecast business outcomes and understand the drivers behind them has never been more important.

Our team combines rigorous statistical modeling, advanced analytics, and deep business understanding to help leaders make better decisions. We believe data science should be embedded in the product development lifecycle, influencing strategic investments, identifying opportunities, and enabling teams to move quickly and confidently.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead Product Data Scientist, Forecasting to own and advance Klaviyo's forecasting capabilities, combining deep technical expertise with strong business judgment to influence some of our most important product and strategic decisions.

This is a highly visible, hands-on technical leadership role at the intersection of data science, product strategy, and business performance. You'll lead the development of sophisticated revenue forecasting models, establish rigorous evaluation standards, and help the organization better understand how customer behavior, product investments, pricing decisions, and market dynamics influence business outcomes.

This isn't just about building accurate models or reporting on historical trends. We're looking for someone who can connect advanced statistical methods to real business questions, challenge assumptions, investigate unexpected outcomes, and translate complex findings into clear recommendations that shape decisions.

You'll work closely with Product, Finance, Engineering, and Go-to-Market leadership to build scalable forecasting systems and self-service analytical capabilities. You'll also help define the technical direction of forecasting at Klaviyo, mentor other data scientists, and establish the methodologies and standards that make forecasting a trusted, repeatable practice across the company.

How You'll Make a Difference

  • Own revenue forecasting end to end, from problem framing and data preparation through model development, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing monitoring, ensuring forecasts serve as trusted inputs to business planning and product decisions.
  • Build sophisticated forecasting models across multiple time horizons and levels of granularity, leveraging hierarchical forecasting, probabilistic and Bayesian methods, classical time series techniques, machine learning, and emerging time series foundation models.
  • Establish forecasting standards and governance by defining how the organization measures accuracy, bias, calibration, and uncertainty, creating consistent and rigorous approaches to model evaluation and performance.
  • Lead the technical direction of forecasting, evaluating modeling approaches, reviewing technical designs, mentoring other data scientists, and raising the bar for statistical methodology, code quality, and analytical rigor.
  • Connect forecasting to business strategy by partnering with Product, Finance, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams to support scenario planning, evaluate strategic investments, and translate ambiguous business questions into actionable analytical plans.
  • Uncover drivers of customer and product performance through advanced statistical research, including mixed effects models, clustering, time series analysis, and other techniques that reveal meaningful patterns and inform product strategy.
  • Lead root cause investigations when actual business performance diverges from forecasts, identifying whether changes stem from data quality, model limitations, customer behavior, product or pricing decisions, or external factors.
  • Build scalable root cause analysis frameworks through repeatable methodologies, templates, and dashboards, enabling other data scientists and business stakeholders to investigate performance consistently and efficiently.
  • Develop self-service forecasting and analytics capabilities that empower product managers and cross-functional leaders to explore business trends, evaluate scenarios, and make informed decisions independently.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to build reliable data pipelines and dbt models that provide clean, well-structured, and trustworthy data for forecasting and downstream analysis.
  • Evaluate emerging AI and forecasting technologies, identifying opportunities to leverage new modeling techniques, time series foundation models, and AI-powered tools to improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision support.
  • Influence decisions across the organization by communicating complex statistical findings and business implications clearly and persuasively to stakeholders ranging from individual contributors to executive leadership.

Who You Are

  • You have 10+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, applied statistics, or a related quantitative discipline, including significant hands-on experience building and deploying forecasting solutions in production.
  • You bring deep expertise in time series forecasting, statistical modeling, and model evaluation, with experience applying methods such as hierarchical forecasting, probabilistic or Bayesian approaches, and machine learning to complex business problems.
  • You're highly proficient in SQL and Python or R, with experience developing production-quality analytical solutions and familiarity with dbt and modern analytics engineering practices.
  • You've demonstrated technical leadership by setting direction on complex projects, mentoring other data scientists, reviewing modeling approaches, and influencing technical standards across teams.
  • You combine statistical rigor with strong business intuition and understand how product development, customer behavior, pricing, and strategic investments translate into measurable financial and business outcomes.
  • You're comfortable owning complex analytical problems from initial exploration through production deployment, ongoing monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • You can translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined analytical approaches, establish meaningful success metrics, and deliver actionable recommendations.
  • You're a compelling communicator who can explain sophisticated statistical concepts and modeling tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives.
  • You thrive in cross-functional environments and enjoy partnering with Product, Finance, Engineering, and business leaders to influence strategic decisions and improve customer outcomes.
  • You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, move with urgency, and know how to balance analytical rigor with the speed and iteration required in a high-growth product environment.
  • You bring an AI-first mindset, with curiosity and familiarity around emerging technologies such as time series foundation models, LLMs, and agentic tools that can improve forecasting, analytical workflows, and decision support.
  • You have a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline, or an MBA with a quantitative emphasis. Equivalent hands-on experience in applied forecasting or statistical modeling is equally valued.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building and scaling forecasting capabilities in a high-growth B2B SaaS or product-focused technology company.
  • Experience with revenue forecasting, financial modeling, scenario planning, or business performance analysis in a subscription-based business.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms, distributed processing systems, and modern data engineering infrastructure.
  • Experience applying advanced statistical methods, including mixed effects models, clustering, and probabilistic modeling, to understand customer behavior and product performance.
  • Experience building self-service analytics tools, dashboards, or forecasting platforms used by cross-functional business stakeholders.
  • Hands-on exposure to emerging time series foundation models, LLMs, or agentic AI applications for forecasting and decision support.
  • Experience establishing forecasting governance, model evaluation frameworks, or standardized root cause analysis practices across an organization.

Why This Role Matters

Forecasting is fundamental to how Klaviyo evaluates business performance, makes strategic investments, and plans for the future. As our business and product portfolio become more sophisticated, the ability to understand not just what is happening, but what is likely to happen next and why, is increasingly important.

In this role, you'll help establish forecasting as a core organizational capability, shaping the models, methodologies, and analytical standards that inform critical product and business decisions. Your work will directly influence how leaders evaluate growth opportunities, understand customer behavior, measure the impact of product investments, and respond to changing business conditions.

This is an opportunity to combine deep technical ownership with meaningful strategic influence, working alongside a highly collaborative data science team to build scalable capabilities that have a lasting impact on Klaviyo's growth and decision-making.

Lead Product Data Scientist, Agents

About the Team

Klaviyo's Product Data Science team plays a critical role in shaping how we understand, measure, and improve product and business performance. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that inform product strategy, customer experience, and long-term growth.

As Klaviyo continues to expand its AI-powered capabilities, intelligent agents are becoming central to how businesses engage with their customers. Composer, Klaviyo's AI marketing agent, helps marketers analyze, build, and execute their marketing strategies, while Customer Agent enables brands to engage shoppers and answer questions across channels including chat, email, SMS, and WhatsApp.

These products are evolving rapidly, creating new opportunities and challenges in understanding agent performance, measuring customer value, and connecting AI-driven experiences to meaningful business outcomes.

Our team takes an AI-first approach to data science, leveraging emerging technologies and agentic tools to accelerate analytical workflows, improve decision-making, and focus our efforts on the complex questions that matter most to customers and the business.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead Product Data Scientist, Agents to own and advance Klaviyo's measurement and data science strategy across Composer and Customer Agent, combining deep technical expertise with strong product and business judgment to influence some of our most important AI investments.

This is a highly visible, hands-on technical leadership role at the intersection of data science, AI product development, and business strategy. You'll define how we measure the adoption, engagement, quality, cost, and business impact of our AI agents, establishing the analytical foundations that help teams understand what creates meaningful customer value.

This isn't just about building dashboards or tracking traditional product metrics. We're looking for someone who can tackle emerging measurement challenges, develop rigorous approaches to evaluating agent performance, and determine whether AI-powered experiences are genuinely improving customer outcomes. You'll combine experimentation, causal inference, and advanced analytics to help leaders make informed decisions in an environment where established measurement frameworks are still evolving.

You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership to shape product strategy, evaluate pricing and monetization opportunities, and translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations. You'll also help define the technical direction of agent analytics at Klaviyo, mentor other data scientists, and establish the shared metrics, methodologies, and data foundations that enable teams to make confident, data-driven decisions.

How You'll Make a Difference

  • Own agent measurement end to end across Composer and Customer Agent, developing comprehensive measurement frameworks that connect adoption, engagement, agent performance, customer value, and revenue impact.
  • Define what successful agent performance looks like by partnering with Product and Engineering to establish meaningful measures of agent effectiveness, task completion, customer outcomes, failure rates, and the trade-offs between quality, cost, and business value.
  • Build scalable agent evaluation frameworks by combining conversation data, agent traces, tool-call outcomes, human evaluation, and LLM-based classification to assess quality, identify failure patterns, and understand how changes to models and agent behavior influence product performance.
  • Measure causal impact and incremental value through experimentation and advanced statistical methods, including quasi-experimental approaches such as difference-in-differences, matched comparisons, staged rollouts, and synthetic controls, to determine how AI agents influence customer behavior, retention, and revenue.
  • Connect agent performance to business strategy by partnering with Finance and Product teams to evaluate usage-based pricing, packaging, credit economics, model costs, conversion, and the financial implications of product investments.
  • Establish trusted metrics and analytical standards by defining consistent measurement methodologies, governed data models, and evaluation practices that enable teams to make informed decisions as AI products and underlying technologies evolve.
  • Lead with an AI-first approach to analytics, leveraging coding agents, LLMs, and emerging tools to accelerate SQL development, data modeling, dashboard creation, conversation classification, and analytical workflows while maintaining rigorous validation and quality standards.
  • Build scalable, self-service analytics capabilities that empower product managers and cross-functional stakeholders to independently explore agent performance, evaluate customer outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Engineering and Analytics Engineering to develop reliable instrumentation, data pipelines, and dbt models that capture agent interactions, support robust evaluation, and maintain data quality as new capabilities are introduced.
  • Lead the technical direction of agent analytics, reviewing analytical approaches, mentoring other data scientists, establishing best practices, and raising the bar for statistical rigor, measurement quality, and AI-native ways of working.
  • Influence product and executive decisions by translating complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations, aligning cross-functional stakeholders on meaningful metrics, and communicating uncertainty and trade-offs effectively.
  • Shape the future of AI product measurement by continuously evaluating emerging methodologies, challenging existing assumptions, and prioritizing the analytical questions that matter most as Klaviyo's agents and AI strategy evolve.

Who You Are

  • You have 10+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, applied statistics, or a related quantitative discipline, including recent hands-on experience measuring AI, machine learning, or LLM-powered products in production.
  • You bring deep expertise in product measurement, experimentation, statistical modeling, and causal inference, with the ability to select and defend rigorous analytical approaches when traditional randomized experiments aren't feasible.
  • You have experience evaluating AI systems in production, including designing evaluation frameworks, analyzing agent interactions or conversations, leveraging human labeling or LLM-as-judge methodologies, and understanding how model, prompt, and tool changes influence product outcomes.
  • You're highly proficient in SQL and Python or R, with experience developing production-quality analytical solutions and familiarity with dbt and modern analytics engineering practices.
  • You take an AI-first approach to your work, actively leveraging coding agents, LLMs, and emerging tools to accelerate analytical workflows while understanding their limitations and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of their outputs.
  • You've demonstrated technical leadership by setting direction on complex analytical initiatives, mentoring other data scientists, reviewing methodologies, and influencing technical standards across teams.
  • You combine statistical rigor with strong product and business intuition, understanding how customer engagement, AI product performance, usage-based pricing, and unit economics translate into meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • You're comfortable tackling ambiguous, emerging problems where established metrics or methodologies may not yet exist, and can develop practical frameworks that balance analytical rigor with business needs.
  • You have a track record of influencing senior stakeholders, aligning cross-functional teams around shared definitions and priorities, and translating complex findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You're a compelling communicator who can explain sophisticated analytical concepts, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate uncertainty and trade-offs with confidence.
  • You thrive in fast-moving product environments, adapt quickly as priorities evolve, and know how to balance analytical depth with the urgency and iteration required to build and improve AI-powered products.
  • You have a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline, or an MBA with a quantitative emphasis. Equivalent hands-on experience in applied data science is equally valued.

Nice to Have

  • Experience measuring and optimizing AI agents, conversational AI, or LLM-powered products in a high-growth B2B SaaS or product-focused technology company.
  • Hands-on experience with agent observability and evaluation platforms such as Braintrust, LangSmith, or Arize, including working with agent traces, tool-call data, and evaluation pipelines.
  • Experience with usage-based or consumption-based pricing, credit models, AI infrastructure costs, or LLM unit economics.
  • Experience building governed metrics, semantic layers, metric trees, or standardized measurement frameworks used across multiple product teams.
  • Experience applying classification, clustering, or other advanced analytical methods to large volumes of unstructured text, customer conversations, or agent interactions.
  • Experience developing internal AI agents or AI-powered analytics tools that improve team productivity and decision-making.
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution, incremental measurement, or evaluating the impact of AI-driven customer engagement.
  • Background in marketing technology, ecommerce, CRM, customer-service software, or other data-driven SaaS products.

Why This Role Matters

AI agents are central to Klaviyo's product strategy and the future of how businesses engage with their customers. As Composer and Customer Agent become increasingly sophisticated, understanding whether these products are delivering meaningful value, how effectively they perform, and where to invest next will be critical to their long-term success.

In this role, you'll help establish how Klaviyo measures the effectiveness and business impact of AI agents, developing the frameworks, methodologies, and analytical foundations that inform some of our most important product, pricing, and investment decisions. Your work will directly influence how we improve agent quality, understand customer outcomes, and connect AI innovation to measurable business value.

This is an opportunity to combine deep technical ownership with meaningful strategic influence, working alongside a highly collaborative, AI-first data science team to solve emerging measurement challenges and shape how Klaviyo builds, evaluates, and scales its next generation of intelligent products.

title: Principal Engineer, Enterprise Scalability
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. Here’s a rewrite that uses the structure and tone of the Axon example, adapted for Klaviyo’s senior technical IC role. It makes ownership clearer, keeps the hands-on expectations prominent, and separates candidate qualifications from measures of success.

At Klaviyo, we help businesses build stronger relationships with their customers. As our customers grow, our platform needs to support greater data volumes, more demanding workloads, and increasingly complex operations—with the performance and reliability they depend on.

Engineering at this scale takes technical depth, sound judgment, and close collaboration. You’ll work across teams to solve challenging problems, turn architectural improvements into production results, and help build a platform ready for our largest customers.

Your Impact

We are seeking a senior technical leader to own Klaviyo’s approach to enterprise scalability, performance, reliability, and multi-region readiness. Reporting to a VP of Engineering, you will be a senior individual contributor with no direct reports. You will lead through technical expertise, hands-on engineering, and influence, partnering across teams to deliver improvements that matter to our customers.

You will identify and remove major bottlenecks, drive platform-wide architectural changes, and establish clear measures of readiness for our largest tenants and most demanding workloads. Your work will span system design, profiling, implementation, and production rollout. You will also help teams adopt practical tools and repeatable patterns that make performance and reliability part of everyday engineering.

This role suits an experienced engineer who can move between deep technical investigation and clear executive communication, make and defend architectural decisions, and build alignment across teams.

Reports to: VP of Engineering
Direct reports: None

What You’ll Do

  • Define what scale readiness means. Establish measurable targets for latency, throughput, error rates, and capacity. Build a shared scorecard and align teams on service-level objectives, error budgets, and performance expectations for critical enterprise workloads.

  • Remove the bottlenecks that matter most. Use production data, profiling, and reproducible benchmarks to identify constraints. Partner with service owners to implement fixes and verify improvements under representative workloads.

  • Drive architectural change. Design and implement sharding, partitioning, caching, back-pressure, and workload isolation strategies. Advance multi-region readiness and build safe paths for high-volume data migrations.

  • Make scale engineering repeatable. Create lightweight benchmarks, profiling harnesses, and test environments that teams can use independently. Pair with engineers to turn successful fixes into reusable patterns.

  • Build readiness into delivery. Lead scalability reviews and establish clear, proportionate release gates that surface risks early and help teams ship confidently.

  • Turn incidents into lasting improvements. Lead technical deep dives, identify systemic causes, and work with teams to deliver and validate fixes that reduce recurring incidents.

  • Apply AI where it improves outcomes. Use AI-assisted profiling, workload modeling, synthetic traffic, anomaly detection, and guided runbooks to improve investigation and response. Establish explicit guardrails, evaluate results, and measure operational impact.

  • Connect engineering decisions to customer needs. Communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and results clearly to engineers and executives, tying technical investments to customer experience, enterprise growth, and operating efficiency.

What You’ll Bring

  • Deep experience scaling multi-tenant SaaS. You bring 12+ years of relevant engineering experience, with a track record of removing significant bottlenecks and demonstrating measurable production impact.

  • Strong performance and distributed systems expertise. You have hands-on experience with performance engineering, capacity planning, sharding and partitioning, caching, back-pressure, tenant isolation, multi-region architectures, and large-scale migrations.

  • Engineering depth from diagnosis through delivery. You can investigate unfamiliar systems, test hypotheses, write production code, and work with service owners to roll out changes safely.

  • Sound technical judgment. You use evidence to weigh architectural tradeoffs and know when to address an immediate constraint versus invest in a broader platform change.

  • Leadership across organizational boundaries. You align teams around shared outcomes, clarify ownership, and build practical standards that help engineers move faster.

  • Clear communication. You explain complex technical decisions and their business implications to both engineering and executive audiences.

  • Practical AI fluency. You have applied AI tools or automation to engineering work and can evaluate their usefulness, limitations, and operational risks. You are curious about new approaches and disciplined about validating them.

What Success Looks Like in 6–12 Months

  • A company-wide scale scorecard is adopted and reviewed regularly, with agreed targets and clear ownership for critical enterprise workloads.

  • Two to three high-impact bottlenecks are removed, with reproducible benchmarks demonstrating sustained improvements.

  • Our largest customer workloads show measurable improvements in tail latency, throughput, and error rates.

  • Multi-region readiness and high-volume migration plans have clear priorities, tested assumptions, and actionable next steps.

  • Teams use shared benchmarks and readiness checks to catch regressions earlier, and repeat P0 incidents decline.

  • AI-assisted tools demonstrate measurable value in investigation or incident response, such as faster regression isolation or fewer noisy alerts, with appropriate controls and observability.

title: Customer Success Operations Analyst
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

About the role

Our Customer Success Managers and Renewals Specialists do their best work when the plan, data, and rhythm behind them are solid. This role builds and runs all three. You'll own the numbers and mechanics that tell us who covers which customers, how much capacity we have, and how the book is performing, then turn them into reporting our leaders actually use.

You'll sit between CS leadership, Sales Ops, Finance, and Data. Some weeks you'll be modeling territory options before a quarter starts. Other weeks you'll be building the renewal ops view the team checks every morning. If you like work where the answer ships and people use it, you'll like this job.

What you'll do

Capacity, coverage, and assignments

  • Maintain headcount and capacity models, and keep them current as hiring, attrition, and book growth change the picture.
  • Support account assignment and territory planning for CS leadership: model options, run quarterly rebalancing, and carry out reassignments when someone leaves or a customer's needs change.
  • Keep assignment data clean and consistent across Salesforce, Gainsight, and reporting, so what the field sees matches what leadership sees.
  • Flag where coverage doesn't match customer value or risk, and recommend how to fix it.

Business reviews and performance reporting

  • Build and run the data behind weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews (QBR/MBR), delivering inputs on time and with a clear point of view.
  • Own renewal ops reporting: upcoming renewals, renewal status and activity, at-risk accounts, and retention outcomes. Forecast and pipeline are owned elsewhere; you'll use the same definitions.
  • Create and maintain CS dashboards and reports that CSMs, managers and LT rely on to run their books.
  • Help drive and maintain rhythm of business reporting across all CS and Renewals segments

Analysis and improvement

  • Answer ad hoc questions from leaders with a recommendation, not a spreadsheet dump.
  • Spot patterns in the data (churn drivers, coverage gaps, capacity strain) and bring them to the team before they're asked for.
  • Automate recurring pulls and reports, and document the process so it doesn't live in one person's head.
  • Work with Sales Ops, Finance, and Data teams to make sure definitions and numbers match across the company.

Who you are

  • 3-5 years in Customer Success Ops, Sales/Revenue Ops, FP&A, or an analytics role supporting a go-to-market team, ideally at a SaaS company.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in Tableau or a similar BI tool.
  • Salesforce and Gainsight experience
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills. You can build a capacity model that someone else can pick up and trust.
  • Experience with territory design, account assignment, or capacity planning is a big plus.
  • You explain data clearly to people who don't live in it, and you can tell a CSM, a director, and a VP what a number means for them.
  • You're careful with details and still move fast. Reporting that's late or wrong doesn't help anyone.
  • You're curious about why the number moved, not just what it is.
  • You build tools and processes you'd want to inherit, not just ones that get you through this week.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting renewals or retention teams.
  • Familiarity with health scoring or segmentation work.
  • Python or Snowflake experience.

title: Lead, Customer Experience Strategy and Operations (High-Touch)
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

About the role

Our high-touch customers are where the relationship, the stakes, and the revenue are biggest. This role makes sure that book is run like a business: clear on who we serve and how, deliberate about the experience we create, and measured on what it delivers.

This is half strategy, half operator. You'll design customer experiences and programs for our highest-value accounts, and you'll build the operating rhythm, metrics, and processes that keep the high-touch team effective as it grows. You'll work directly with CS leadership, CSMs, Sales, Support, Product, and Marketing, and you'll have room to shape how we serve our biggest customers.

What you'll do

Shape the high-touch customer experience

  • Design and pilot the moments that matter for high-touch customers: onboarding to value, executive engagement, business reviews, renewal and expansion plays.
  • Define what high-touch should mean: which customers qualify, what they get, and what outcome each touchpoint should create.
  • Turn customer feedback and data into specific changes to programs, playbooks, and engagement models.
  • Work with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to close gaps that customers feel across teams.

Run the high-touch business

  • Own the operating model for the high-touch segment: coverage, capacity, cost to serve, and how the model changes as the customer base grows.
  • Set the metrics that tell us whether it's working, such as adoption, retention, expansion, and customer sentiment, and build the cadence to review them.
  • Lead the planning cycles for the segment, and make the case for where to invest and where to automate or pool.
  • Build the playbooks, workflows, and tooling the team uses, and keep them current.

Lead projects across teams

  • Manage a portfolio of strategic and operational projects from ambiguous idea to launched, measured program.
  • Translate leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, timelines, and success measures.
  • Bring structure to cross-functional problems, flag risks early, and drive adoption of new ways of working.
  • Prepare clear, decision-ready materials for leadership, with a recommendation attached.

Who you are

  • 5-8 years in Customer Success, CS Operations, strategy, or program management, ideally in SaaS, with time close to enterprise or high-touch customers.
  • You've designed a customer program or operating model and can show what changed because of it.
  • You think in outcomes first. You can say what problem you're solving, how you'll know it worked, and what you'd stop doing to make room.
  • You're comfortable with data. You can build the analysis yourself in tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, Tableau, or Snowflake, or ask sharp questions of someone who can.
  • You influence without authority, and people across Sales, Support, Product, and CS want you in the room.
  • You write and present clearly, and you can lead with the answer for executives.
  • You like building new things and also making them stick.
  • Experience using AI or automation to scale customer engagement and CSM efficiency

Nice to have

  • Experience with customer segmentation, health scoring, or customer journey design.
  • Program or project management certification.

title: Director, Mid Enterprise Sales
descriptionHtml:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

Klaviyo is building the next phase of our Mid-Large Enterprise business in APAC, and we’re looking for a Director of Sales to lead this critical growth engine from Sydney.

Reporting to the ANZ Country Sales Leader, you’ll own the strategy, execution, and development of our Mid-Large Enterprise sales organization for Australia and New Zealand. This role sits at the intersection of people leadership, go-to-market strategy, and operational excellence — with responsibility for people development, driving predictable revenue, and shaping how Klaviyo wins upmarket in APAC.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who has successfully built and scaled sales teams in fast-growing SaaS environments and thrives in ambiguity, acceleration, and change.

What You’ll Do

Lead & Scale the Mid-Large Enterprise Business

  • Own the vision, strategy, and execution for Klaviyo’s Mid and Large Enterprise segment in ANZ
  • Translate growth objectives into clear operating plans, priorities, and execution rhythms
  • Lead a team of high performing Account Executives.

Build Exceptional Teams

  • Hire, develop, and retain best-in-class sales and talent
  • Coach and develop your team, setting a high bar for leadership, performance, and accountability.
  • Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development frameworks to support long-term growth
  • Lead cross-functionally to ensure that your extended team is aligned, motivated and engaged through creating clarity, building trusted relationships and modelling Klaviyo’s values and behaviours.

Drive Revenue Predictability & Performance

  • Own forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and performance management across the Mid-Enterprise org
  • Use data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities — turning insights into action
  • Set and uphold rigorous standards for deal quality, inspection, and execution

Shape Strategy & Influence the Business

  • Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Business Development, Partnerships, Enablement, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success to drive regional growth
  • Serve as a thought leader for the Enterprise segment, influencing go-to-market strategy and investment decisions
  • Help define and evolve Klaviyo’s upmarket motion, including account strategy, sales methodology, awareness and customer engagement models

Operational Excellence & Change Leadership

  • Introduce and optimize tools, processes, and playbooks to improve efficiency and effectiveness
  • Lead change management as the business scales — helping teams adapt while maintaining performance
  • Put AI and automation at the center of how the team operates, building smarter and more scalable ways of working

Customer-Centric Leadership

  • Champion a customer-first mindset, ensuring strategies and execution improve the end-to-end customer journey
    Support teams in navigating complex, multi-stakeholder deals with confidence and credibility
  • Build executive relationships in key clients to support your team, leveraging and transferring your credibility to your team to help them succeed.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Team & Culture

  • Set the tone for a high-performing, inclusive, and energized sales culture
  • Run regular tactical and developmental 1:1s with managers and leaders
  • Balance ambition with sustainability — pushing for excellence while investing in people

Leadership

  • Provide strategic direction and influence across the APAC sales organization
  • Collaborate deeply across functions and geographies, including close partnership with global stakeholders
  • Inspire the next generation of Klaviyo sales leaders

Operational Rigor

  • Leverage internal and external data to guide strategy and execution
  • Clearly communicate performance trends, risks, and opportunities to senior stakeholders

Who You Are

  • 8+ years leading Mid-Enterprise or Large Enterprise sales teams, ideally including a transition upmarket from SMB / Commercial
  • Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing SaaS sales teams
  • Strategic thinker who can zoom out to define direction — and zoom in to drive execution
  • Strong coaching philosophy grounded in growth, accountability, and development You create the safety and guardrails for your team to thrive, ensuring belonging and trust while holding a high performance bar.
  • Data-driven leader with experience using metrics to inform decisions and drive outcomes
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-growth, and evolving environments
  • Deep understanding of SaaS sales economics, forecasting, and pipeline management
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or similar enterprise sales methodologies
  • Experience influencing cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders

Soft Skills

  • Clear, confident communicator with strong executive presence
  • Analytical, structured, and decisive
  • High ownership mindset over annual and quarterly planning
  • Curious, adaptable, and biased toward action
  • Proficient with Salesforce and modern sales tech stacks (e.g. Gong, Outreach)

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling MarTech, eCommerce, or PLG-adjacent solutions
  • Exposure to scale-ups or businesses transitioning upmarket
  • Experience operating in APAC or global sales environments

Klaviyo in APAC:

We are starting small but have big plans for Klaviyo in APAC. Our Sydney team began to take shape throughout 2022 and has now built out our go to market teams in sales, customer success, services, partnerships, marketing, recruiting and product support. As the team grows we will see a continued expansion of Klaviyo’s customer base and the building of a fantastic working culture in line with what we see elsewhere in Klaviyo but with its own local identity within our Sydney based team. This is your unique opportunity to join us at an early stage and help to shape our future Klaviyo in APAC.

One of our values as a company is ‘always learning’ and you can feel that in APAC. People are looking to grow and develop and Klaviyo provides a great platform to do so. As we are still relatively early in our journey in APAC this means there is a lot of headroom to grow and develop within your role - we are looking for the leaders of the future. At Klaviyo generally managers are often promoted up into their roles and people are regularly being promoted or moving into new functional areas - it really is an education through experience here. 

We use Covey as part of our hiring and / or promotional process. For jobs or candidates in NYC, certain features may qualify it as an AEDT. As part of the evaluation process we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound on April 3, 2025.

Please see the independent bias audit report covering our use of Covey here

Our salary range reflects the cost of labour in the country where the job post is advertised. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility. 

Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE  range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
